paper.title: No Gaussian Required: Contrastive Inverse Dynamics for JEPA World Models
paper.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting future embeddings, but the objective admits a trivial solution of a constant encoder, so every practical system adds an anti-collapse mechanism (LeCun, 2022; Assran et al., 2023; Bardes et al., 2022; 2024). LeWorldModel (LeWM) prevents collapse with SIGReg, a regularizer that forces the latent distribution to match an isotropic Gaussian: the representation is stabilized by prescribing what it must look like, indepe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 JEPA 类世界模型的表示坍塌问题。具体目标是在不强行规定 latent 分布为高斯、不改变测试时规划流程的前提下，让模型从动作转移数据中获得反坍塌信号。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接关系不强，但对自监督建模目标设计有参考价值。它讨论的是预测式 latent 模型如何避免常数表示，以及反坍塌约束应来自外部分布先验还是来自数据中的可辨识结构。这个问题与 masked prediction、joint embedding、视频/机器人世界模型、跨模态预训练中的 representation collapse 有共通性。
summary.technical_approach: 作者保留 LeWM 的前向 latent prediction：编码当前像素观测，结合动作预测未来 latent。不同之处在于训练时加入一个 inverse-dynamics 分支。该分支读取相邻 latent pair，生成 action query，并通过 Action-NCE 在 batch 中识别真实动作。若 encoder 坍塌为常数表示，所有转移产生相同 query，动作识别只能接近随机水平，因此坍塌不再是可接受解。这个反坍塌压力来自环境转移本身，而不是像 SIGReg 那样要求 embedding 的一维投影匹配各向同性高斯。测试时 inverse head 被丢弃，部署模型仍使用同样的 encoder、autoregressive predictor、latent distance 和 CEM planner。论文还比较了非对比 inverse regression 版本 MTM-MSE，以及 contrastive forward prediction 版本 AC-CPC。
summary.experiments: 实验在 5 个 pixel-control 任务上做三种随机种子比较，包括 TwoRoom、Reacher、PushT、OGBench-Cube 和更难的 OGBench Visual Scene。AC-MTM 在标准四任务中没有坍塌，整体与 SIGReg 接近：两个任务更好，一个任务相当，在 PushT 上较弱。Scene 任务上差距更明显：SIGReg 三种子均值为 58.0%，AC-MTM 为 80.0%，三个 seed 的提升分别为 24、20、22 个百分点；随机策略 50 episode 的估计基线为 52%。MTM-MSE 在 Scene 上也达到 75.3%，说明动力学来源的 inverse 信号本身有效。但 MTM-MSE 在 Reacher 的 3 个 seed 中有 2 个坍塌，Action-NCE 更稳定。PushT 上 inverse-dynamics 信号不如 SIGReg，原因是动作识别会低估弱控制物体状态的信息。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Background，明确 LeWM、SIGReg 和 AC-MTM 的差异。然后看 Action-NCE 的定义和坍塌只能达到 chance-level 的论证，这是主要技术点。实验部分优先看五个任务的主表、Scene stress test、MTM-MSE 消融和 PushT 失败分析。对预训练研究更有用的是反坍塌信号来源的取舍：分布正则更通用但可能限制 latent 几何，inverse dynamics 更贴合转移结构但会忽略动作难以控制的状态变量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses representation collapse in JEPA-style world models. The goal is to prevent a constant encoder without imposing a Gaussian latent prior and without changing the test-time planning pipeline.
summary_en.importance: The connection to LLM pretraining is indirect, but the objective-design lesson is relevant. The paper studies whether anti-collapse pressure should come from an external distributional constraint or from identifiable structure in the data. That question also appears in masked prediction, joint-embedding learning, video world models, robotics pretraining, and multimodal representation learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model keeps LeWM's forward latent-prediction objective: encode the current pixel observation, condition on the action, and predict the next latent. AC-MTM adds a training-only inverse-dynamics branch. Given an adjacent pair of latents, the inverse head produces an action query and uses an InfoNCE-style Action-NCE loss to identify the true action among other actions in the batch. A collapsed encoder maps all transitions to the same query, so action identification cannot beat chance. This makes collapse incompatible with the inverse task. Unlike SIGReg, which pushes one-dimensional projections of embeddings toward an isotropic Gaussian, AC-MTM derives its anti-collapse signal from transition data. At evaluation time, the inverse head is removed; the planner still uses the same encoder, autoregressive predictor, latent distance, and CEM procedure as LeWM. The paper also includes MTM-MSE, a non-contrastive inverse-regression ablation, and AC-CPC, a contrastive forward-prediction alternative.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses five pixel-control tasks with three training seeds: TwoRoom, Reacher, PushT, OGBench-Cube, and the harder OGBench Visual Scene. On the standard four-task suite, AC-MTM does not collapse and is broadly comparable to SIGReg: it wins two tasks, ties one, and loses on PushT. The Scene task shows the clearest difference. Under the matched trajectory-goal MPC protocol, SIGReg reaches a three-seed mean of 58.0%, while AC-MTM reaches 80.0%, with gains of 24, 20, and 22 points across the three seeds. A 50-episode random-policy run gives a 52% baseline estimate. MTM-MSE also performs well on Scene at 75.3%, suggesting that the dynamics-derived inverse signal is important. However, MTM-MSE collapses on two of three Reacher seeds, while Action-NCE is more reliable. On PushT, inverse-dynamics anti-collapse trails SIGReg because action identification underweights weakly controlled object state.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25 to 35 minutes. Read the introduction and background first to understand the contrast between LeWM, SIGReg, and AC-MTM. Then focus on the Action-NCE objective and the chance-level collapse argument, which are the central technical pieces. In the experiments, prioritize the main five-task table, the Scene stress test, the MTM-MSE ablation, and the PushT failure analysis. The useful lesson for pretraining is the trade-off between distributional regularization and data-native anti-collapse: the former is broadly applicable but can constrain latent geometry, while the latter is more aligned with dynamics but may ignore state factors weakly controlled by actions.

recommendation.zh: 为自监督表示学习（特别是 JEPA 架构）提供了一种优雅的反坍塌机制，用对比逆动力学替代了生硬的高斯正则化，对探索非自回归预训练目标的稳定性有启发。
recommendation.en: Provides an elegant anti-collapse mechanism for self-supervised representation learning (especially JEPAs), replacing rigid Gaussian regularization with contrastive inverse dynamics, offering insights for stabilizing non-autoregressive pretraining objectives.

paper.title: An Omitted Mode Is a Rare Rule: The Sampling-Verification Danger Law in Continuous Code World Models
paper.abstract: In the Code World Model paradigm an LLM synthesizes an executable world model that a classical planner searches, and the model is accepted when it reproduces sampled transitions. We ask what that acceptance certifies in continuous control. We define the pipeline's danger as an expected risk and isolate its exact factor: the probability that N i.i.d. gate rollouts all miss a critical event of probability r is exactly (1-r)^N; an independent acceptance sample adds its budget to the exponent. On th

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 生成可执行世界模型后，仅用采样轨迹验证模型是否可靠，在连续控制和混合系统里会漏掉哪些危险模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析和风险刻画。它把 Code World Model 管线中的验证失败风险明确写成采样遗漏概率，并说明稀有事件一旦被规划器利用，可能导致接近最大可达回报的 regret。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义了采样-验证管线的 danger 作为期望风险，给出关键因子：N 次独立 rollout 全部错过概率为 r 的关键事件时，遗漏概率精确为 (1-r)^N；独立验收样本会把预算加到指数上。还证明了一个边界点附近的 localization budget：Lipschitz 模型若在一点差异为 eta，则在一定体积区域内会超过容差 eps；但不连续 reset mode 不满足这种保护。
summary.experiments: 实验使用三个 hybrid instruments，展示被接受的 mode-blind 模型会被 planner 卡在 mode boundary，产生接近全可达回报的 regret。摘要还提到用真实 LLM 合成时，GPT-5.x 在一维 clamp 遗漏场景中进行修复，但给定摘要的统计数字被截断，无法确认完整成功率或样本量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies what sampled transition verification actually certifies when an LLM synthesizes executable world models for continuous-control planning.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a theoretical risk analysis. It isolates the probability that rare but safety-critical modes are missed by sampling, and shows that an accepted world model can still be exploited by a planner near mode boundaries.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes pipeline danger as expected risk and derives the exact miss probability: N independent gate rollouts miss a critical event of probability r with probability (1-r)^N; an independent acceptance set simply increases the exponent. It also proves a localization budget for Lipschitz models around boundary points, while noting that discontinuous reset modes evade that protection.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical part uses three hybrid instruments and shows that an accepted mode-blind model can pin the planner at a mode boundary with regret close to the whole attainable return. The abstract also mentions real LLM synthesis with GPT-5.x on an omitted 1D clamp, but the provided text truncates the full statistic.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；作为 LLM 生成世界模型的验证反例留档，核心只看 (1-r)^N 和边界 exploit。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; keep it as a verification counterexample for LLM-written world models, mainly the (1-r)^N miss law and boundary exploit.

paper.title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
paper.abstract: Interactive world models must support persistent memory, responsive interaction, and long-horizon generation, yet these requirements place conflicting demands on the model. Maintaining history in the denoiser context or key-value cache incurs growing cost, forcing a trade-off between session length and retained memory, while low-latency interaction relies on few-step generation whose capabilities are bounded by its teacher. Evoke addresses both limitations by externalizing persistent world state

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式视频世界模型在长会话中同时保持持久记忆、低延迟响应和长程一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成系统与长程交互建模方法。它把持久世界状态从 denoiser 上下文或 KV cache 中移出，试图缓解长序列生成中记忆成本随会话长度增长的问题；对 LLM 研究员的价值主要在外部状态记忆和检索式上下文控制，而不是语言预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Evoke：用 camera-indexed world state bank 保存场景几何和历史世界状态，每次生成只检索当前视角相关的信息，使 denoiser 上下文保持有界；同时重新设计 teacher，用 chunk-wise grouping、远帧检索和 linear-attention global state 做稀疏注意力，以支持长程监督和少步交互生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练数据量或量化提升。已知评估目标包括长程交互生成、历史一致性、响应延迟和 teacher-student few-step generation 能力；具体 baseline 与指标需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how interactive video world models can maintain persistent memory, low-latency response, and long-horizon consistency within a bounded generation context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a long-horizon multimodal generation system rather than an LLM pretraining method. Its relevance comes from the externalized memory design and retrieval-bounded context, which are useful analogies for long-context generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evoke stores scene geometry in a camera-indexed world-state bank and retrieves only view-relevant information during generation, keeping the denoiser context bounded. The teacher model is redesigned for long-horizon supervision with chunk-wise grouping, selected distant-frame retrieval, and a linear-attention global state.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, or exact gains. The evaluation appears to focus on long-horizon interactive generation, consistency, latency, and few-step student generation under a long-context teacher.

recommendation.zh: 不必细读生成效果，只看外部 world-state bank 和 teacher 稀疏注意力；这是长程记忆工程的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skip the visual results; read the external world-state bank and sparse-teacher design as a weak signal for long-horizon memory engineering.

paper.title: A Unifying Perspective on Causal World Models: From Observations to Representations to Structure
paper.abstract: World Models (WM) are increasingly seen as a foundation for intelligent agents that can predict, plan, and act beyond their training distribution. In this paper, we study WMs from a causal perspective across multiple levels of abstraction, ranging from perceptual observations to building a conceptual representation of the structure governing the environment dynamics. We argue that useful WMs must go beyond generative capabilities alone: they should also capture entity properties, entity-to-entit

summary.core_problem: 从因果角度重新定义 world model：一个有用的世界模型不应只会生成观测，还应捕捉实体属性、实体交互和环境动力学结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是观点与框架整合。它把 world model、causal representation learning、object-centric learning、causal discovery、structural causal models 和 model-based decision-making 放到同一个问题表述里。对 LLM 预训练的直接方法贡献有限，但对 agentic pretraining、环境模型、长程规划表示有概念参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Causal World Models 的形式化定义，并按抽象层级组织问题：从感知观测，到可用于预测和规划的表示，再到支配环境动力学的结构。它强调 world model 的任务依赖性，即模型需要支持预测、解释、干预和决策，而不只是拟合生成分布；同时讨论可识别性条件，说明何时能从观测中恢复 world model 的组件。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看这是立场/综述型论文，没有报告训练模型、数据规模、baseline 或定量结果。主要产出是概念框架和与既有文献的连接。

summary_en.core_problem: Reframe world models through a causal lens: useful WMs should capture entity properties, interactions, and environment dynamics rather than merely generate observations.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a conceptual synthesis. It connects world modeling with causal representation learning, object-centric learning, causal discovery, structural causal models, and model-based decision-making. It is not a direct pretraining method, but it is relevant to agentic pretraining, environment modeling, and planning-oriented representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a formal definition of Causal World Models and organizes the problem across abstraction levels: observations, representations, and causal structure. It argues that a WM should support prediction, explanation, intervention, and decision-making, not just density modeling. It also discusses identifiability conditions for recovering WM components from data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests a position or survey-style paper with no trained model, dataset scale, baselines, or quantitative results. The main output is a formal framing and literature synthesis.

recommendation.zh: 可看定义和 identifiability 段落；它不会给训练 recipe，但能校准 world model 讨论里常被混用的目标。
recommendation.en: Read the definitions and identifiability discussion; it offers no recipe, but helps separate goals often conflated in world-model work.

paper.title: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
paper.abstract: Automating empirical research is a long-standing direction of AI. Recent automatic research (AutoResearch) agents bring this goal within reach, as modern LLMs show the capability to independently implement solutions and learn from the execution outcomes. Behind these gains, post-training (especially RL) plays a central role. In this paper, we identify a fundamental tension when scaling RL for these agents: the two components of every AutoResearch trajectory (agent generation and environment exec

summary.core_problem: 用 RL 扩展 AutoResearch agent 时，agent 生成可以通过 batching 摊薄成本，但每条轨迹的环境执行（沙箱、真实 GPU 上跑实验）独占资源、线性增长，成为训练瓶颈。能否用可扩展的世界模型替代真实环境，并控制其预测偏差和噪声对策略收敛的影响？
summary.importance: 对 agentic RL 的 post-training 扩展有实际启发，尤其是执行成本远高于生成成本的任务（SWE、数据科学、VLA、AutoResearch）。核心观察——生成与执行的成本缩放不对称——是通用的；用 world model 做可 batching 的廉价奖励信号，并在 policy gradient 收敛界里显式建模 bias/noise、给出 debiasing 和 inverse-variance denoising，对设计大规模 agent RL 管线有参考价值。与基座预训练的直接关系较弱，主要落在 post-train/RL 信号质量这一侧。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WMRL：训练一个 world model，接收环境信息与 agent 解，输出对真实执行结果的模拟，用几次前向传播替代沙箱执行，从而像生成一样跨轨迹 batching。把 world model 的不完美建模为奖励上的 bias b（|b|≤B）和零均值噪声 ξ（标准差 σ），在 GRPO 风格的 policy gradient 收敛界中导出 O(B²) 和 O(σ²) 两个额外误差项。对应设计 Online Debiasing 机制重标定 world model 输出以抵消偏差，以及 Inverse-Variance Denoising 机制按方差加权以最小化噪声；定理证明两者同时启用时收敛保证严格改进。
summary.experiments: 在多个 AutoResearch 任务、两种 agent 规模上验证：world model 替代真实环境使整体训练加速约 3–4×；加上 Online Debiasing 和 Inverse-Variance Denoising 后，加速训练的性能追平甚至超过使用真实环境的 RL 训练；并扩展到 VLA post-training 任务以验证通用性。论文未在摘录中给出具体任务分数和模型规模细节，需看正文第 5 节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Introduction 中关于生成与执行成本缩放不对称的问题刻画，第 3.2 节 world model 如何接入 GRPO 奖励链路，第 3.3 节 bias/noise 两个修正机制，以及第 4 节收敛界中 O(B²)、O(σ²) 两项如何被对应机制消掉。实验部分关注 3–4× 加速与性能持平/反超的具体任务设置。预计 45–60 分钟。做 agentic RL 基础设施的人值得读方法和定理，做纯预训练的人了解问题设定即可。

summary_en.core_problem: When scaling RL for AutoResearch agents, agent generation amortizes cheaply through batching, but each trajectory's environment execution (sandboxed, real-GPU experiment runs) consumes exclusive resources and grows linearly, becoming the training bottleneck. Can a scalable world model replace the real environment, and how can its prediction bias and noise be controlled so policy convergence is preserved?
summary_en.importance: Practically relevant to scaling agentic post-training, especially where execution cost dwarfs generation cost—SWE agents, data-science agents, VLA, and AutoResearch. The core observation about asymmetric cost scaling between generation and execution is general. Using a world model as a batchable, cheap reward signal, then explicitly modeling its bias and noise in a policy-gradient convergence bound and pairing them with debiasing and inverse-variance denoising, offers a useful template for large-scale agent RL pipelines. Direct relevance to base pretraining is limited; the main value is on the post-train / RL-signal-quality side.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes WMRL: a world model takes environment information and the agent's solution and simulates the execution outcome in a few forward passes, replacing sandbox runs so the cost batches across trajectories like generation. Imperfection is modeled as a reward bias b (|b|≤B) plus zero-mean noise ξ (standard deviation σ). Tracing both through a GRPO-style policy gradient yields two extra terms in the convergence bound, O(B²) and O(σ²). Online Debiasing recalibrates world-model outputs to offset bias, and Inverse-Variance Denoising weights signals to minimize variance; a theorem shows that applying both strictly improves the convergence guarantee.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple AutoResearch tasks at two agent scales, replacing the real environment with the world model accelerates overall training by roughly 3–4×. With Online Debiasing and Inverse-Variance Denoising, the accelerated training matches or exceeds RL trained against the real environment. The method is also extended to VLA post-training to show generality. Concrete task scores and model sizes are not in the excerpt; see Section 5 of the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the introduction's characterization of the generation-versus-execution cost asymmetry, Section 3.2 for how the world model plugs into the GRPO reward path, Section 3.3 for the two correction mechanisms, and Section 4 for how the O(B²) and O(σ²) terms in the convergence bound are addressed. In the experiments, look at the task setup behind the 3–4× speedup and parity-or-better claim. Budget 45–60 minutes. Those building agentic RL infrastructure should read the method and theorems closely; pure-pretraining readers can stop at the problem framing.

recommendation.zh: 看 § 方法和成本分解即可；它把 Agent RL 的瓶颈从 token 生成挪到执行时间，这个 prior 对训练系统设计有用。
recommendation.en: Read the method and cost decomposition; the useful prior is that agent-RL scaling is often execution-bound rather than token-generation-bound.

paper.title: Sekai2: From World Exploration to Interactive World Modeling
paper.abstract: Video world models must capture how scenes evolve over time and across viewpoints. Training them for long-horizon generation and camera control therefore benefits from long videos paired with camera trajectories and temporally grounded semantics. Existing corpora rarely offer the three together: large-scale web video provides broad visual diversity but no trajectories or time-aligned text, while pose-annotated datasets are typically short-range or reconstruction-oriented. We introduce Sekai2, a

summary.core_problem: 为长时程、可控相机运动的交互式视频世界模型提供同时包含长视频、相机轨迹和时间对齐语义标注的数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态/世界模型预训练数据集。它补齐了 web 视频缺少轨迹、pose 数据集又短且偏重重建的问题，对训练可交互视频生成模型和具身世界模型有直接数据价值。
summary.technical_approach: Sekai2 汇集多源真实世界视频，面向持续观察场景做数据加权；每个 clip 发布相机轨迹，并提供层级语义标注，使模型可同时学习时间演化、视角变化和语义条件。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 128,892 个 clip、总计 2,826 小时，来自 10,428 个源视频，覆盖 113 个国家或地区；按 120 秒片段分解时，43,594 个片段达到完整两分钟，占全部时长 51.4%。摘要主要描述数据规模和属性，未给出下游模型训练收益数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper provides data for interactive video world models that need long videos, camera trajectories, and temporally grounded semantic annotations at the same time.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal/world-model pretraining dataset contribution. It addresses the gap where web videos are diverse but lack trajectories, while pose-annotated datasets are short and reconstruction-oriented.
summary_en.technical_approach: Sekai2 aggregates multi-source real-world videos and deliberately weights the corpus toward sustained observation. Each clip includes a released camera trajectory and hierarchical annotations, enabling joint learning of temporal evolution, viewpoint change, and semantic conditioning.
summary_en.experiments: The release contains 128,892 clips totaling 2,826 hours from 10,428 source videos across 113 countries or regions. Under a 120-second decomposition, 43,594 segments reach the full two minutes and account for 51.4% of all footage. The abstract focuses on dataset statistics rather than model-training gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是数据资产而非方法论文；预训练研究员应看数据构成、轨迹标注和长片段比例，判断能否补内部 video-world 数据短板。
recommendation.en: This is a data asset, not a method paper; inspect the mixture, trajectory annotations, and long-clip distribution for video-world-model pretraining.

paper.title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
paper.abstract: The world evolves following its dynamics, i.e., its laws of motion. However, leading video diffusion models largely fit the pixels without modeling how the pixels transit over time. Thus, they render visually plausible frames but may not accurately obey the laws. To capture the dynamics purely from pixels, we introduce Latent Dynamics Reasoning (LDR). LDR casts the latent transition as an explicit kinematic integration, where the lower-order dynamics are integrated numerically and the model regr

summary.core_problem: 如何让视频生成模型（世界模型）真正学习到物理规律（动力学），而不仅仅是拟合像素，从而实现更好的外推能力？
summary.importance: 提出了一种在隐空间进行显式运动学积分的方法（LDR），试图解决当前视频扩散模型在物理规律外推上的缺陷，为构建更符合物理规律的世界模型提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 引入隐式动力学推理（LDR），将隐状态转换建模为显式的运动学积分。低阶动力学进行数值积分，模型仅回归驱动展开的三阶及更高阶残差。为了更好地外推，LDR 在结构化的隐变量上运行，而不是密集的卷积特征上。
summary.experiments: 在包含五个任务（匀速运动、抛物线、碰撞、弹跳、逼近）的受控白盒物理基准（PhyWorld）上验证，重点关注分布外（OOD）场景。结果表明 LDR 能够外推学习到的动力学。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自加州大学圣地亚哥分校（UCSD）、Adobe Research 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make video generation models (world models) truly learn physical laws (dynamics) rather than just fitting pixels, thereby achieving better extrapolation capabilities?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a method for explicit kinematic integration in the latent space (LDR), attempting to address the shortcomings of current video diffusion models in extrapolating physical laws, providing a new perspective for building world models that better adhere to physics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Latent Dynamics Reasoning (LDR), which casts latent transitions as explicit kinematic integration. Lower-order dynamics are integrated numerically, and the model only regresses the third- and higher-order residuals that drive the rollout. For better extrapolation, LDR operates on structured latents rather than dense convolutional features.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on a controlled white-box physics benchmark (PhyWorld) spanning five tasks (uniform motion, parabola, collision, bouncing, looming), focusing on out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Results show LDR extrapolates the learned dynamics.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from UCSD, Adobe Research, and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 关注视频生成/世界模型如何学习物理规律的尝试，通过在隐空间引入显式运动学积分来提升 OOD 外推能力，对多模态世界模型研究有启发。
recommendation.en: An interesting attempt on how video generation/world models can learn physical laws, improving OOD extrapolation by introducing explicit kinematic integration in the latent space; inspiring for multimodal world model research.

paper.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
paper.abstract: World models are expected to support imagination over extended temporal horizons, yet most are still trained through local few-step prediction objectives and deployed by recursively rolling out their own predictions. This creates a fundamental mismatch: few-step losses optimize local transition fidelity, while long-horizon prediction depends on how errors and gradients propagate through the entire trajectory. As a result, transitions with different downstream influence on the endpoint are treate

summary.core_problem: 世界模型常用短步预测损失训练、递归 rollout 推理，训练目标和长时域预测目标不一致，导致误差沿轨迹放大。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是建模范式改动：把长时域世界模型从局部 transition fidelity 转向端到端 endpoint prediction。对 LLM 预训练不是直接工作，但对长程信用分配、非自回归未来预测、规划模型训练目标有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Direct Prediction World Model，使用非递归架构把任意长度动作序列压缩成单个 embedding，并在一次前向传播中预测终点观测。核心取舍是放弃逐步模拟每个中间状态，直接优化最终状态误差，从而避免递归误差累积。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 和具体提升数字。可确认实验目标应是比较短步递归世界模型与 DPWM 在长时域 endpoint prediction 上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Most world models are trained with local few-step losses but used through recursive rollout, creating a mismatch that amplifies small transition errors over long horizons.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a modeling-objective change: optimize long-horizon endpoint prediction directly instead of local transition fidelity. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-horizon credit assignment, non-autoregressive future prediction, and planning-oriented model objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the Direct Prediction World Model, a non-recursive architecture that compresses an action sequence of arbitrary length into one embedding and predicts the endpoint observation in a single forward pass. The key design choice is to skip explicit intermediate-state rollout and train directly on the final outcome.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected comparison is between few-step recursive world models and DPWM on long-horizon endpoint prediction accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“直接训终点而不是训局部转移”的 prior shift 值得记，正文可只看 objective 和长程误差分析。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the endpoint-objective shift is worth noting; read only the objective design and long-horizon error analysis.

paper.title: Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs) for Predictive Latent Dynamics
paper.abstract: World models learn latent states that summarize interaction histories, evolve over time, and support prediction, simulation, or planning. Most existing world models represent these states using classical vectors, probability distributions, recurrent hidden states, or transformer activations. In this paper, we introduce Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs), a quantum-inspired framework for predictive world modeling with structured latent states, latent transition operators, and measurement-ins

summary.core_problem: 探索量子启发的复杂值表示和 density-matrix-like latent 是否能为 world model 的预测 latent dynamics 提供更好的结构归纳偏置。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是架构/表示范式探索。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但与 world model、latent dynamics、structured latent representation 有弱相关；当前实验看起来还停留在小规模 toy setting。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Quantum-Structured World Models，把 latent state、transition operator 和 measurement-inspired decoder 按量子结构组织。论文建立 classical inclusion、predictive sufficiency、structured compactness 三个性质，并实例化 complex-valued 与 density-matrix-like 两类 QSWM 变体。
summary.experiments: 实验在 elementary cellular automata 上进行，对比 strong classical baselines。摘要只说明结果支持该方向，但未给出参数量、训练规模、具体 baseline 名称、指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates whether quantum-inspired complex-valued and density-matrix-like latent structures provide useful inductive biases for predictive world modeling.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture and representation exploration. It is only weakly related to LLM pretraining through world models, latent dynamics, and structured latent states, and the reported setting appears to be small-scale and toy-like.
summary_en.technical_approach: Quantum-Structured World Models organize latent states, transition operators, and measurement-inspired decoders using quantum-inspired mathematical structure. The paper establishes three properties—classical inclusion, predictive sufficiency, and structured compactness—and instantiates complex-valued and density-matrix-like QSWM variants.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses elementary cellular automata against strong classical baselines. The abstract does not provide parameter counts, training scale, exact baseline names, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 latent world model 备查即可；量子结构的 prior 还停在 toy CA，别把结论外推到 LM。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a latent-world-model reference; the quantum prior is still tested on toy cellular automata, so do not extrapolate to LMs.

paper.title: Robust-WAM: Bridging Generative Pretraining and Semantic Foresight in World-Action Models
paper.abstract: Mainstream World-Action Models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generation models (VGMs) for robot control, transferring their learned dynamics prior for action prediction. These VGMs are typically trained in a variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. However, the VAE latent space is optimized for pixel reconstruction, which rewards fine appearance detail and leaves the action prediction fragile under visual shifts. Recent works build WAMs in semantic latent space, which are more robust to appea

summary.core_problem: 视频生成模型可为机器人 World-Action Models 提供动态先验，但其 VAE latent 偏向像素重建，导致动作预测在光照、外观变化下脆弱。
summary.importance: 贡献是机器人控制场景下复用大规模视频生成预训练的一种后训练对齐方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对“生成预训练表征如何服务行动模型”有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Robust-WAM，保留原有 VAE latent 中的视频生成路径，同时在动作流上加入轻量的 semantic foresight alignment objective；这样既不丢掉 VAE 空间中已有的大规模视频生成预训练能力，又把动作预测约束到更稳定、对外观变化不敏感的语义动态上。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体参数量、训练数据规模、robotics benchmark 名称或提升幅度；实验重点应是比较 VAE latent WAM、semantic latent WAM 和加入语义前瞻对齐后的鲁棒性，尤其是光照和外观 shift 下的动作预测。

summary_en.core_problem: Video-generation-based World-Action Models can transfer dynamics priors to robot control, but VAE latents optimized for pixel reconstruction make action prediction fragile under visual shifts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training alignment method for reusing large-scale video generation pretraining in action models. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to how generative pretraining representations can be grounded for control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Robust-WAM keeps the VAE-latent generative pathway and adds a lightweight semantic foresight alignment objective on the action stream. The method preserves pretrained video-generation capacity while anchoring actions in more appearance-invariant semantic dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, benchmark names, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation compares VAE-latent WAMs, semantic-latent WAMs, and the proposed aligned variant under illumination and appearance shifts.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和鲁棒性实验即可；它提醒生成预训练 latent 不等于行动可用 latent，但证据仍是机器人小场景。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and robustness tests; it is a useful reminder that generative latents are not action-ready, though the evidence is robotics-bound.

paper.title: SR-JEPA: Learning Predictive Latent State in 3D Scenes
paper.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting latent representations of missing observations, yet many masked JEPAs are evaluated primarily through the encoders they produce. We ask what a trained predictive pathway itself infers when an entire entity is absent from a native 3D scene. We introduce SR-JEPA, a point-native JEPA for scene-scale point clouds whose original frozen predictive pathway can be queried at a supplied location. At evaluation, every point of one object is remo

summary.core_problem: 研究 3D scene JEPA 的预测通路在缺失整个物体时到底推断了什么，而不只是把 JEPA 当作 encoder 表征学习方法来评测。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是自监督预测表征的机制分析与 3D 表征方法。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接方法贡献，但对 latent prediction、world model 和非重构式自监督目标有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SR-JEPA，一个 point-native、scene-scale point cloud JEPA。训练只使用 3D EMA latent target，不使用重建目标、语义标签、语言或 2D lifted features。评测时移除一个物体的所有点，在其质心放入 shape-free 的 32 点 query，并直接查询原始冻结 predictive pathway 生成缺失物体 latent。
summary.experiments: 在 5,953 个 held-out ARKitScenes objects 上，imputed latent 达到 43.13% semantic-identity macro accuracy，比最强 floor 高 22.18 个点。随机化 prediction path 会降低 9.78 个点；用 matched donor context 替代会降低 21.98 个点。在 8,570 个 Sr3D support pairs 上还评估了支持关系相关能力，但摘要截断，完整指标未知。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Boston University 和 Shanghai Jiao Tong University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what a 3D scene JEPA predictive pathway infers when an entire object is missing, rather than evaluating only the encoder representation.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented self-supervised 3D representation study. It is not a direct LLM pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to latent prediction objectives, world-model-style pretraining, and non-reconstructive self-supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: SR-JEPA is a point-native JEPA for scene-scale point clouds. It is trained with 3D EMA latent targets only, without reconstruction, semantic labels, language, or lifted 2D features. At evaluation, all points of an object are removed and replaced by a shape-free 32-point query at the centroid, then the frozen predictive pathway is queried for the missing-object latent.
summary_en.experiments: On 5,953 held-out ARKitScenes objects, the imputed latent reaches 43.13% semantic-identity macro accuracy, 22.18 points above the strongest floor. Randomizing the prediction path removes 9.78 points, while substituting matched donor context removes 21.98 points. The abstract also mentions 8,570 Sr3D support pairs, but the detailed result is truncated.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Boston University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: 不必细读 3D 实验；看缺失物体 probing 设计即可，能借来检查 JEPA/latent world model 是否真的预测状态。
recommendation.en: Do not dwell on the 3D results; the missing-object probing setup is the useful part for testing whether JEPA-like latent world models predict state.

paper.title: Quo Vadis, World Modeling?
paper.abstract: Continually improving agents require dynamic interaction feedback beyond static supervision, yet direct real-environment interaction is costly, slow, unsafe, and hard to parallelize. World modeling offers a natural intermediate proxy that allows agents to query lower-cost, more controllable feedback before committing to real actions. Classical world models instantiate this proxy primarily through future physical-state prediction, a formulation useful yet narrow for agents that require actionable

summary.core_problem: 讨论现有 world model 过度聚焦物理状态预测，难以为持续学习 agent 提供可执行、可验证、可复用的交互反馈。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是概念框架和问题重定义：把 world modeling 从“预测未来物理状态”扩展到“为 agent 提供可用信息转移的交互代理”。对通用 agent、RL 后训练、模拟环境和 verifier 设计有一定参考价值，但不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies 的概念，将世界模型按功能组织为若干类代理反馈源，例如执行结果、检索到的经验或技能、验证信号等。核心是 taxonomy 和设计空间梳理，而不是新的训练算法或模型架构。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看主要是概念性综述或立场论文，未体现明确模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或定量实验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that conventional world models are too centered on physical state prediction and do not provide the actionable feedback needed by continually improving agents.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly conceptual: it reframes world modeling as agent-usable information transitions rather than only future-state prediction. This is relevant to agent training loops, RL-style feedback, simulators, and verifiers, but it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes the notion of Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies and organizes the design space around functional feedback channels such as execution outcomes, retrieved experiences or skills, and verification signals. The main artifact is a taxonomy and framing rather than a new optimization or modeling method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests a conceptual survey or position paper, with no clear model scale, training data, baselines, or quantitative results reported.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 agent 反馈闭环的概念备查；预训练侧只需看 taxonomy，别期待可复现实验信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a conceptual map for agent feedback loops; for pretraining work, skim the taxonomy and do not expect reproducible empirical signals.

paper.title: CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models
paper.abstract: World models must learn the joint dynamics of states, actions, events, and observations, yet existing video, robotics, and simulation datasets usually capture only part of this structure. We introduce CG-World, a large-scale world-state dataset and protocol derived from industrial computer graphics production pipelines. CG-World explicitly records intermediate states, including multimodal semantics, spatial structure, skeletal and controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters,

summary.core_problem: 为 world model 预训练提供同时包含状态、动作、事件、观测和分支关系的大规模时序数据，而不是只提供视频帧或机器人轨迹。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据与协议。它把工业 CG 生产管线中的中间状态显式导出，补齐了现有视频、机器人、仿真数据只覆盖部分因果结构的问题；对多模态 world model、具身模型、反事实学习的数据设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CG-World 从计算机图形生产流程中抽取 temporally aligned samples，记录语义、空间结构、骨骼与控制器状态、运动曲线、相机与光照、物理缓存、接触事件、多通道渲染等中间变量，并将 latent states、observations、relations、events、branch metadata 分层组织。协议还定义 factual trajectories、observation interventions、action interventions、mechanism interventions 和 strict counterfactual branches，用于支持干预和反事实建模。
summary.experiments: CG-World v1 包含约 85 万个 1-5 秒的时间对齐片段。摘要没有给出模型规模、训练 recipe 或具体 benchmark 数字；重点是数据覆盖范围、结构化 schema 和干预分支协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a large-scale temporal dataset for world-model pretraining that exposes states, actions, events, observations, and branch structure instead of only rendered video or robot trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a data and protocol contribution. By exporting intermediate variables from industrial CG pipelines, it addresses the partial-observability problem in common video, robotics, and simulation datasets, and is relevant to multimodal world models, embodied modeling, and counterfactual data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CG-World extracts temporally aligned samples from computer-graphics production pipelines, including semantics, spatial structure, skeleton and controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters, physics caches, contact events, and multi-pass renderings. It separates latent states, observations, relations, events, and branch metadata, and defines factual, observation-intervention, action-intervention, mechanism-intervention, and strict counterfactual lineages.
summary_en.experiments: CG-World v1 contains roughly 850,000 aligned segments of 1-5 seconds. The abstract does not report model scale, training setup, or benchmark numbers; the main evidence is dataset scale, schema coverage, and the intervention protocol.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员可只读数据 schema 和 branch lineage；它提醒 world-model 数据不能再只存 RGB 结果。
recommendation.en: For pretraining work, read the schema and branch-lineage design; the useful signal is that world-model data should not stop at RGB outcomes.

paper.title: Mitigating Compounding Error via Video Representation Regularization
paper.abstract: Video diffusion-based world models enable long autoregressive video generation for robotics, autonomous driving and simulation tasks, yet sliding-window autoregressive inference suffers from severe error accumulation that degrades frame quality over time. Although this phenomenon has been widely observed, the underlying mechanism of compounding error and how to achieve stable long-horizon generation remain largely unresolved. In this paper, we investigate the internal representation dynamics of

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解视频 diffusion world model 在滑窗自回归长 rollout 中逐步漂移、画质和动态一致性恶化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把长时生成的 compounding error 连接到隐藏表示的维度坍缩，并提出 representation regularization 作为稳定长 horizon 生成的训练信号；这对视频世界模型和未来统一多模态 LM 的长程生成稳定性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文分析视频 world model 内部表示动态，用 effective rank 衡量隐藏表示是否保持足够维度；发现生成漂移开始时 effective rank 快速下降。随后提出视频表示正则化，目标是抑制表示坍缩，而不是只靠更多训练数据或更长 rollout 数据覆盖。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验覆盖视频 diffusion-based world model 的长自回归生成，并观察到纯训练数据 scaling 不能显著提升抗漂移能力；具体模型规模、数据量、baseline 名称和提升幅度在摘要中未给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why sliding-window autoregressive inference in video diffusion world models accumulates errors and degrades over long rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is linking long-horizon generation drift to dimensional collapse in hidden representations and using representation regularization to stabilize rollout behavior, which is relevant to multimodal generative pretraining and world-model-style sequence generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors inspect internal representation dynamics and use effective rank as a diagnostic for representation collapse. They report that effective rank drops sharply near the onset of generation drift, then introduce a video representation regularizer to maintain healthier hidden-state geometry rather than relying only on data scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on video diffusion-based world models under long autoregressive generation and claims that pure training-data scaling does not improve resistance to error drift; model size, dataset scale, baselines, and exact gains are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看表示 rank 分析和 data scaling 失效实验；迁移到 LLM 需谨慎，但长程生成稳定性信号值得复查。
recommendation.en: Read the effective-rank analysis and the failed data-scaling ablation; the LLM transfer is not automatic, but the long-rollout stability signal is worth checking.

paper.title: StatePlay: State-Aware Game World Models for Mechanics-Consistent Generation
paper.abstract: Recent game world models can generate visually realistic and interactive environments conditioned on player actions. However, games are not defined by pixels alone; they are governed by explicit mechanics, namely state-dependent rules that control health reduction, skill activation, and game termination. These mechanics depend on precise internal states, such as health points, skill meters, and timers, which are tightly coupled with visual observations and determine how gameplay evolves. Without

summary.core_problem: 让游戏世界模型在生成视觉 rollout 的同时遵守显式游戏机制和内部状态动态。
summary.importance: 贡献是游戏世界模型的生成方法改进。它强调仅做像素级动作条件生成会产生规则不一致问题，因此把 health、skill meter、timer 等状态变量纳入联合预测。对 LLM 预训练不是直接工作，但对多模态世界模型和状态-视觉联合建模有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StatePlay，一个 state-aware game world model。模型采用 mixture-of-transformers 风格架构，保留视觉表征和状态表征的专门化分支，同时允许跨模态交互；训练目标联合预测未来视觉内容和游戏状态，以提高 mechanics-consistent generation。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体游戏环境、模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 或数值提升。实验应围绕视觉质量、动作条件一致性、状态预测精度和规则违反率展开，但给定信息不足以判断效果强度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make game world models generate visual rollouts that remain consistent with explicit game mechanics and internal state dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generation method for game world models. It argues that pixel-only action-conditioned generation can look plausible while violating game rules, so variables such as health, skill meters, and timers should be modeled jointly with visuals. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal world modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: StatePlay is a state-aware game world model using a mixture-of-transformers-style architecture. It keeps specialized visual and state representations while enabling cross-modal interaction, and jointly predicts future frames and game states for mechanics-consistent generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report environments, model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains. The likely evaluation covers visual quality, action consistency, state prediction accuracy, and rule-violation rates.

recommendation.zh: 有用的点是把显式状态作为世界模型的一等变量；只需看架构图和状态一致性指标，别按 LLM 结论外推。
recommendation.en: The useful bit is treating explicit state as a first-class world-model variable; read the architecture and consistency metrics, but do not extrapolate to LLMs.

paper.title: ContactFlow: A video action conditioning that transfers across embodiments
paper.abstract: World models offer a promising route toward robot planning by enabling agents to imagine and verify the consequences of actions before execution. However, current video-based world models often struggle to capture the physical constraints that govern manipulation, particularly contact. Further, their action conditioning is often constrained to specific embodiments such as parallel grippers. We propose \emph{Contact Flow}, an embodiment-agnostic action representation that encodes manipulation thr

summary.core_problem: 让视频 world model 能用跨 embodiment 的动作条件生成物体交互结果，避免动作表示被某一种机器人夹爪或关节空间绑定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是动作表示与视频生成式 world model。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对具身基础模型如何设计 action token / action condition 有参考意义，尤其是从人类演示和机器人执行之间共享条件信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Contact Flow：用 actor 与目标物体之间 3D 接触点的轨迹来编码操作动作，刻意丢弃 actor 外观和具体运动学结构。作者据此把人类交互视频和机器人交互视频放在同一个条件空间中，训练条件视频生成模型预测物理上合理的操作后果，并将该模型接入 propose-and-verify 风格的规划流程。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明使用人类和机器人物体交互视频训练大规模视频生成模型，并用于预测 manipulation outcomes；但没有给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to condition video world models on actions in a way that transfers across embodiments, rather than tying the action space to a specific robot gripper or joint configuration.
summary_en.importance: This is an action-representation and generative world-model contribution. It is not an LLM-pretraining paper, but it is relevant to embodied foundation models and the design of action tokens or action conditions shared between human demonstrations and robot execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Contact Flow represents manipulation by trajectories of 3D contact points between an actor and a target object, deliberately removing actor-specific appearance and kinematics. This creates a shared conditioning signal for human and robot interaction videos, enabling a conditional video generative model to predict physically plausible manipulation outcomes and support a propose-and-verify planning loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that a large-scale video generative model is trained on both human and robotic object-interaction videos and used for manipulation prediction. It does not provide parameter count, dataset size, named baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Contact Flow 定义即可；它像 action tokenizer 设计笔记，实验信息不足，先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the Contact Flow definition; it is useful as an action-tokenizer design note, but the abstract gives too little experimental grounding.

paper.title: Temporally Centered SIGReg Improves Multi-Task LeWorldModel Learning: From Analysis to Method
paper.abstract: Recent work on LeWorldModel (LeWM) has shown that the Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) enables stable end-to-end world-model learning from pixels by regularizing the latent marginal distribution toward an isotropic Gaussian, thereby preventing representation collapse. While effective and elegant in single-task settings, this recipe does not extend reliably to multi-task training, leading to substantially worse downstream behavior-cloning performance. In this paper, we show that m

summary.core_problem: 研究 LeWorldModel 中 SIGReg 在单任务有效、但多任务像素世界模型训练中失效的问题，核心是多任务 latent 表示被高斯边缘正则压缩后产生任务混淆。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是表示学习机制分析和一个针对性正则改法。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对多任务世界模型、latent collapse、正则目标如何改变表征几何有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析认为，原始 SIGReg 把 latent marginal distribution 推向各向同性高斯，会压缩任务相关簇之间的距离，使跨任务状态发生 representation aliasing，并提高对小视觉扰动的敏感性。改法是把 SIGReg 施加在 temporally centered residuals 上，而不是整个 latent 边缘分布上，从而减少对任务簇间分离度的直接惩罚。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕多任务 LeWorldModel 和下游 behavior cloning 展开；摘要说明原始 SIGReg 在多任务设置下导致下游行为克隆显著变差，temporally centered SIGReg 改善多任务训练稳定性和下游行为表现。给定信息中未提供模型规模、数据规模或具体提升数字。
summary.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo 和 Yusuke Iwasawa 来自东京大学相关研究团队，长期关注世界模型、机器人学习和表示学习。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why SIGReg works for single-task LeWorldModel training but becomes unreliable in multi-task pixel-based world-model learning, where Gaussian marginal regularization can collapse task-separating latent geometry.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a representation-learning diagnosis plus a targeted regularization change. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multi-task latent world models and to how regularizers reshape representation geometry.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors argue that applying SIGReg to the full latent marginal distribution compresses distances between task-dependent clusters relative to within-cluster variation, causing representation aliasing and sensitivity to small visual perturbations. They instead apply SIGReg to temporally centered residuals, reducing direct pressure on inter-task cluster separation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on multi-task LeWorldModel learning and downstream behavior cloning. The abstract reports that vanilla SIGReg substantially hurts multi-task behavior-cloning performance, while temporally centered SIGReg improves stability and downstream behavior. Model size, data scale, and exact gains are not available from the provided excerpt.
summary_en.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo and Yusuke Iwasawa are associated with the University of Tokyo research ecosystem and are known for work around world models, robotics, and representation learning.

recommendation.zh: 只看表示几何分析即可；对 LLM 预训练不是直接信号，但能提醒多任务 latent 正则别盲目高斯化。
recommendation.en: Skim only the latent-geometry diagnosis; it is not an LLM-pretraining result, but it is a useful warning against naive Gaussianization in multi-task latents.

paper.title: What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Parameter Identifiability in Multimodal Predictive Representations
paper.abstract: A central premise of latent world models is that predicting the future forces a representation to internalize the physics of its environment. Which physical quantities does a trained latent actually contain, and what decides this? We answer with controlled interventions in POKEWORLD, an interactive environment whose visually identical objects hide mass, drag, and contact stiffness. A certificate-gated protocol first certifies each parameter as recoverable from raw observations, then measures whe

summary.core_problem: 回答 latent world model 的表示到底能不能学到隐藏物理参数，以及哪些训练信号决定参数是否进入 latent。
summary.importance: 这是一个机制分析工作。它用受控环境和可恢复性证书区分“环境中不可观测”和“目标函数没有保留”两种失败原因，对预测式表示学习、world model 训练目标设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 POKEWORLD 交互环境，其中视觉上相同的物体具有隐藏的 mass、drag、contact stiffness。先用 certificate-gated protocol 证明某个物理参数可从原始观测恢复，再检查训练后的 latent 是否包含该参数。分析输入模态、预测目标和预测步长对参数可识别性的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出一个关键结果：contact stiffness 只有在模型被要求预测 touch 时才进入 latent，R^2=0.50；如果同样的触觉信号只是作为输入融合而不是预测目标，R^2=-0.02。摘要还指出，在 single-step prediction 下，vision-only latent 甚至会丢弃原本可从视觉恢复的参数。未提供模型规模和完整 baseline 列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which hidden physical parameters are actually represented inside latent world models, and what training signals determine whether those parameters enter the latent state.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism study. By separating raw-observation recoverability from latent retention, it clarifies whether a missing physical variable is due to the environment or to the predictive objective. The result is relevant to predictive representation learning and world-model objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use POKEWORLD, an interactive environment where visually identical objects hide mass, drag, and contact stiffness. A certificate-gated protocol first verifies that a parameter is recoverable from raw observations, then measures whether the trained latent encodes it. They vary input modalities, prediction targets, and prediction horizon.
summary_en.experiments: One headline result is that contact stiffness enters the latent only when touch is forecast, with R^2=0.50, while merely fusing the same touch signal into the input gives R^2=-0.02. The abstract also reports that under single-step prediction, a vision-only latent can discard parameters that are recoverable from vision. Model scale and full baselines are not available from the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和实验主表即可；它把“输入可见”和“目标保留”拆开，对设计预测式预训练目标有用。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and main result table; the clean separation between observability and target-driven retention is the useful part for predictive pretraining objectives.

paper.title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
paper.abstract: Multi-agent interactive world models should not only generate consistent observations, but also maintain world states that persist across agents and evolve across views. Existing autoregressive video diffusion pipelines carry forward observation history as conditioning context, which makes shared state difficult to maintain in multi-agent and multi-view settings. We present WorldWeaver (W^2), a streaming multi-agent video diffusion model that augments rollout with cross-agent world state registe

summary.core_problem: 现有自回归视频扩散世界模型将观测历史作为条件上下文传递，无法在多智能体、多视角场景下维护一致的共享世界状态。每个生成步都需要从帧历史重新推断世界信息，既难以保证跨智能体的几何与逻辑一致性，也无法覆盖未被观测到的世界状态变化。
summary.importance: 提出在扩散模型内部显式建模持久化世界状态寄存器的思路，对多智能体世界模型、长时序视频生成的一致性问题有直接参考价值。其用Mixture-of-Transformers分离状态更新与帧生成路径的设计，也为统一建模范式下多任务目标冲突的解决提供了可借鉴的方案。
summary.technical_approach: WorldWeaver（W²）是流式多智能体视频扩散模型，核心设计是跨智能体世界状态寄存器：一组可学习的token，存储共享世界信息和单个智能体状态，在每个生成chunk后动态更新，且在所有智能体和rollout步之间持久共享。训练采用三阶段课程：第一阶段双向训练，用全时序上下文的多智能体同步clip微调教师模型，学习跨智能体场景结构；第二阶段因果训练，将教师转为因果学生模型，加入寄存器监督，继续流匹配目标训练；第三阶段Self-Forcing，用模型自身预测的帧和更新后的寄存器做rollout，暴露寄存器漂移问题。架构上采用Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT），给寄存器token和帧token分配独立权重，同时保持联合注意力，缓解帧生成和状态更新两个目标的竞争。监督信号覆盖单个智能体状态、鸟瞰图全局状态、场景文本语义，还支持半监督训练，少量标注数据锚定寄存器语义，无标注数据提升生成效果。
summary.experiments: 当前公开的全文内容未包含完整实验结果。方法部分已完成架构和训练流程的完整设计，从披露信息看，模型在多智能体世界模型设定下验证了世界状态寄存器对跨智能体一致性和长时序生成稳定性的提升作用。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节的世界状态寄存器设计、MoT架构和三阶段训练课程，尤其注意寄存器监督信号的设计逻辑。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing autoregressive video diffusion world models carry observation history as conditioning context, failing to maintain consistent shared world states in multi-agent, multi-view settings. Each generation step requires re-inferring world information from frame history, making it hard to ensure cross-agent geometric and logical consistency, and impossible to account for unobserved world state changes.
summary_en.importance: The work proposes explicitly modeling persistent world state registers inside diffusion models, offering direct reference for consistency problems in multi-agent world models and long-horizon video generation. Its Mixture-of-Transformers design that separates state update and frame generation pathways also provides a reusable solution for resolving multi-task objective conflicts under unified modeling paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldWeaver (W²) is a streaming multi-agent video diffusion model centered on cross-agent world state registers: a set of learnable tokens that store shared world information and individual agent states, are dynamically updated after each generated chunk, and persist across all agents and rollout steps. Training follows a three-stage curriculum: (1) Bidirectional training, which fine-tunes a multi-player teacher on synchronized multi-agent clips with full temporal context to learn cross-agent scene structure; (2) Causal training, which converts the teacher to a causal student, adds register supervision, and continues training with the flow matching objective; (3) Self-Forcing, which rolls out the student on its own predicted frames and updated registers to expose register drift. The architecture uses Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT), assigning separate weights to register tokens and frame tokens while maintaining joint attention, to mitigate competition between the frame generation and state update objectives. Supervision signals cover individual agent status, bird's-eye view global state, and scene text semantics. Semi-supervised training is also supported, where a small labeled subset anchors register semantics while unlabeled videos improve generation quality.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text does not include complete experimental results. The method section presents a complete design of the architecture and training pipeline; disclosed information indicates the model validates improvements in cross-agent consistency and long-horizon generation stability under the multi-agent world model setting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on Section 3 for the world state register design, MoT architecture, and three-stage training curriculum, with particular attention to the design logic of register supervision signals. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 register 更新和 MoT 分工；这类显式 latent state 可能比堆长上下文更适合多视角世界模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the register update and MoT split; explicit latent state may be a cleaner route than just extending context for multi-view world models.

paper.title: Apple-$π$: Benchmarking Thinking with Video Towards Law-Grounded Physical Intelligence
paper.abstract: Modern video generation models are increasingly hailed as emerging world models with an internalized grasp of physical law. Yet existing benchmarks largely evaluate physical plausibility only at the output level, without verifying whether the model arrives there through a faithful, law-grounded reasoning process. We introduce Apple-PI, the first benchmark that anchors video-model evaluation explicitly in physical laws. Apple-PI comprises three components. 1) Orchard: a dataset of 400 videos cove

summary.core_problem: 评估视频生成模型是否真的按物理定律进行可解释推理，而不只是生成看起来合理的视频结果。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频物理推理 benchmark。它把视频生成模型的“世界模型”说法拆成感知、建模、推演三个环节，试图区分输出拟真和 law-grounded reasoning，对多模态预训练和视频生成评测有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Apple-PI，包括 Orchard 数据集、三阶段评测协议和混合评测套件。Orchard 含 400 个经典力学视频，覆盖 10 类任务，并区分单一定律任务和多定律组合任务。协议用带信息图标注的首帧进行 chain-of-frames prompting，将生成视频视为模型外显推理轨迹，再结合 MLLM 打分和物理规则检查。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整被测模型列表和数值结果，只说明该 benchmark 面向现代视频生成模型，关注物理可行性、定律表述和推导过程的一致性。规模上数据集为 400 个视频、10 个经典力学任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether video generation models reason according to physical laws, rather than merely producing visually plausible outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a benchmark contribution for video physical reasoning. It decomposes the “world model” claim into perception, formulation, and deduction, which is useful for evaluating multimodal and video-generation pretraining systems beyond surface-level realism.
summary_en.technical_approach: Apple-PI contains the Orchard dataset, a three-stage scientific-reasoning protocol, and a hybrid evaluation suite. Orchard has 400 videos across 10 classical-mechanics tasks, separating single-law cases from multi-law generalization cases. The protocol uses infographic-annotated first frames and chain-of-frames prompting, treating generated videos as visible reasoning traces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide a full model list or quantitative leaderboard. The stated scale is 400 videos over 10 mechanics tasks, with evaluation focused on perception, law formulation, and deduction consistency.

recommendation.zh: 作为视频世界模型评测备查即可；核心假设是“生成轨迹可当推理轨迹”，这个假设有用但需要警惕。
recommendation.en: Useful as a video-world-model eval reference; the key assumption that generated trajectories expose reasoning is interesting but fragile.

paper.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
paper.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) are emerging as a promising foundation for embodied control: rather than predicting actions alone, they learn representations that couple action generation with future world prediction. This coupling is often viewed as a source of robustness, interpretability, and safety, as a robot's action can in principle be checked against its imagined future. In this paper, we show that this assumption is fragile. We introduce BadWAM, a unified framework for modeling and evaluatin

summary.core_problem: 研究世界-动作模型中“预测未来看起来合理，但执行动作已经偏离任务”的安全脆弱性。
summary.importance: 贡献是对具身世界模型的攻击面分析，指出把未来预测和动作生成耦合并不自动带来可验证性或安全性；对通用agent和world model研究有一定警示，但不是LLM预训练核心论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BadWAM框架定义World-Action Drift Attack，用小幅视觉扰动破坏模型想象未来与实际动作之间的对齐；攻击按强度和隐蔽性建模，包括直接让动作失败的action-only攻击，以及更隐蔽的漂移攻击设置。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体机器人任务、模型规模、数据集、baseline或攻击成功率；只能确认其面向WAM的攻击建模与评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode where world-action models imagine plausible futures while executing task-failing actions.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an attack-surface analysis for embodied world models, challenging the assumption that coupling future prediction with action generation yields reliable safety checks. It is relevant to agent/world-model safety, but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: BadWAM formalizes World-Action Drift Attacks, using small visual perturbations to break alignment between imagined futures and executed actions. The framework characterizes attacks by strength and stealthiness, including action-only disruption and stealthier drift variants.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify robot tasks, model scale, datasets, baselines, or attack success rates; it mainly establishes the attack formulation and evaluation framing.

recommendation.zh: 只看威胁模型定义即可；它提醒world model的预测头不能当安全证据，但离LLM预训练较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the threat-model definition; it usefully warns that a predictive head is not a safety certificate, but it is far from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency
paper.abstract: Autoregressive diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation, yet their sequential nature inherently suffers from error accumulation. In long-horizon video synthesis, minor prediction deviations compound over time, inevitably leading to unconstrained generative drift, structural collapse, and severe visual degradation. To address this, we propose Cycle-World, a novel framework designed for stable and temporally consistent long-video generation. Our approach tackles error drift by e

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成中误差逐步累积、导致结构漂移和画质退化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成方法创新。它把长时序生成的稳定性问题形式化为可逆性约束问题，对 AR 生成和世界模型的误差传播有一定参考价值，但主要仍是视频生成范畴。
summary.technical_approach: Cycle-World 引入反向预测模型，在训练阶段通过 reverse-prediction cycle consistency 约束正向生成器，使生成序列能够被反向模型重建；推理阶段复用冻结的反向模型，对正向生成过程施加一致性约束，从而压制时间漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、训练数据、具体 baseline 或数值结果。实验主张面向长时视频合成，改善自回归 diffusion video model 的漂移、结构崩塌和视觉退化。
summary.authors_note: 作者中包括 Dacheng Tao，他在计算机视觉、生成模型和机器学习方向有长期代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error accumulation in autoregressive diffusion-based long-video generation, where small prediction errors compound into temporal drift and visual collapse.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level advance for video generation. It is relevant to researchers thinking about sequential generative drift and world-model stability, but it is not directly about language-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cycle-World adds a reverse-prediction model and enforces cycle consistency between forward generation and backward prediction. During training, the reverse model injects a reversibility constraint into the forward generator; during inference, the frozen reverse model is reused to constrain generation and reduce drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains. The claimed evaluation setting is long-horizon video synthesis, with improvements in temporal consistency and reduced structural degradation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Dacheng Tao, a well-known researcher in computer vision, generative modeling, and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 只看可逆性约束怎样压住长时漂移；它对 AR 误差传播有类比价值，但不必按 LLM 方法读。
recommendation.en: Skim the reversibility constraint for long-horizon drift control; it has analogies to AR error propagation, but it is not an LLM method paper.

paper.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
paper.abstract: Despite the recent promise in robot control, video generative models suffer from a domain mismatch due to their primary focus on content creation. For example, their design inherently prioritizes visual fidelity and creativity over computational efficiency and physical realism. In this work, we present LingBot-Video, a DiT-based video pretraining paradigm specifically tailored for embodied intelligence. From the architecture perspective, we adopt the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), instead of dense, f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的视频生成质量问题，而是“视频基础模型怎样更像可用于具身智能的世界模型”。作者指出现有视频扩散模型主要围绕画质、文本对齐和审美优化，缺少对物理可行性、交互一致性、长时状态演化和任务完成信号的建模；同时，视频模型在算力上又普遍采用稠密计算，容量扩展成本高。论文试图同时补三块短板：一是用 MoE 提升视频 DiT 的可扩展性和推理效率，二是把互联网视频与机器人/第一视角/操作数据统一进预训练语料，三是把训练目标从“看起来像”推进到“行为和动力学也更合理”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它把 MoE 从文本 LLM 更明确地带到视频扩散预训练里，关注的是容量—计算解耦、单流架构下的稀疏激活和大规模训练可行性，这对多模态基座模型的扩展路径有参考价值。第二，它把“具身数据混入通用视频预训练”当成数据配比与目标设计问题来处理，而不是只做下游机器人微调，这一点更接近预训练研究。影响量级上，这篇更像一个方向性系统工作：它提出了较完整的 recipe，但从给出的内容看，真正最有启发的是统一输入形式、单流 DiT + MoE 的工程取舍，以及数据重配和奖励设计如何服务于物理一致性，而不是某个单点算法突破。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三个部分组成。第一部分是任务统一的单流扩散 Transformer。作者把文本条件、图像条件和视频 latent patch 全部投到同一 hidden space，沿序列维拼接成一个统一 token 序列，用 3D MM-RoPE 给条件 token 和视觉 token 分配不重叠的时间坐标区间。这样 T2I、T2V、I2V 都能落在同一个生成框架里，图像被视为 T=1 的特殊视频。与双流结构相比，单流设计的理由很明确：参数复用更高，跨模态交互在每层自然发生，GEMM 更大更整齐，减少频繁 split/concat 带来的 memory-bandwidth 开销，也更适合 sequence parallel 下的分布式训练。

第二部分是稀疏 MoE 扩展。虽然截取内容没有完整展开路由和 expert 细节，但从引言和方法组织可以看出，MoE 被放在 DiT 扩展的核心位置，目标不是改变扩散建模本身，而是在时空建模复杂度上引入条件计算：不同 token/时刻激活不同 expert，以更低激活参数成本换取更大总容量。这和文本 LLM 中 MoE 的动机一致，但视频场景更难，因为 token 结构同时带有空间、时间和条件模态耦合，路由稳定性、负载均衡和时空一致性都会更敏感。作者选择单流 backbone 后再做 MoE，隐含的好处是避免双流下 expert 划分进一步放大通信和负载不均。

第三部分是数据与训练信号。作者构建了 robot-augmented corpus，不是简单拼接，而是通过 data profiling engine 对异构视频源做分析、过滤和重平衡，把互联网视频的视觉多样性与机器人操作、导航、egocentric 数据的交互先验结合起来。训练目标上又加入 multi-dimensional reward system，除了常规感知质量和文本对齐，还强调 physical plausibility 与 task-level success。这里的思路更接近 post-train 对生成模型的对齐，但服务对象仍是预训练视频基础模型：希望模型学到的不只是外观分布，还包括更合理的交互动力学。
summary.experiments: 从已给全文片段里，实验部分没有完整展开，因此无法可靠给出参数量、训练 token/frame 数、具体 benchmark 分数和提升幅度。能确认的是，作者把系统定位为大规模开源 MoE 视频基础模型，并展示了 T2I 与 T2V 的可视化样例，强调视觉保真度、细节和文本对齐。按引言中的主张，实验大概率围绕三类问题展开：一是 MoE 相对稠密 DiT 的效率—质量权衡；二是加入具身数据后的物理交互与动作语义改善；三是多维奖励对任务成功和物理合理性的影响。真正值得核对的是消融是否分别验证了单流设计、数据重配和奖励系统的独立贡献，以及 MoE 是否在相同激活 FLOPs 下优于 dense baseline。如果正文后半部分给出了 load balance、MFU、吞吐、采样延迟或长时一致性指标，这些会比单纯生成样例更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点看方法设计逻辑，不必在视觉样例上停留太久。建议先看 Introduction，抓住作者定义的问题：为什么“高质量视频生成”不等于“可用于具身智能的世界模型”。然后看 2.1 的 Unified Input Formulation、Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer 和 3D positional design，这部分最有预训练方法上的信息量。接着重点找 MoE 具体实现：expert 放在哪些层、top-k 路由如何做、是否有 auxiliary load balancing loss、训练和推理的激活参数规模分别是多少。再看数据 profiling engine：数据源构成、过滤标准、重配比例、是否有课程式采样。最后看奖励系统与消融，判断它更像 RL-style alignment、reweighting，还是额外监督头。预计 25–40 分钟能抓住主线；如果只关心基座预训练启发，优先读架构和数据部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about making video generations look better. It asks a harder question: how to turn a video foundation model into something closer to a world model for embodied intelligence. The authors argue that current video diffusion models are optimized for perceptual quality, text alignment, and aesthetics, but not for physical feasibility, interaction consistency, or long-horizon state evolution under intervention. At the same time, most large video models remain densely computed, which makes scaling expensive. The work tries to address all three gaps together: sparse scaling with MoE, embodiment-aware pretraining data, and training signals that go beyond appearance.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mostly methodological. First, it pushes MoE more explicitly into video diffusion pretraining, with the familiar promise of decoupling total capacity from active compute. That matters for multimodal foundation models, where dense scaling is becoming hard to sustain. Second, it treats embodied grounding as a pretraining data-mixture and objective-design problem rather than only a downstream robotics fine-tuning problem. That is the more interesting angle here. The contribution looks more like a systems-level recipe than a single sharp algorithmic advance, but the combination of single-stream DiT, sparse experts, data rebalancing, and physically informed rewards is relevant to anyone thinking about unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main pieces. The first is a task-unified single-stream diffusion transformer. Text conditions, image conditions, and visual latent patches are projected into the same hidden space and concatenated into one token sequence. T2I, T2V, and I2V are all handled in one framework, with image generation treated as the special case of a one-frame video. To separate condition tokens from visual tokens without introducing task-specific branches, the model uses 3D MM-RoPE with non-overlapping temporal coordinate ranges. The motivation for the single-stream design is practical and clear: better parameter reuse, denser cross-modal interaction at every layer, larger and cleaner GEMMs, and less split/concat overhead than dual-stream architectures, especially under distributed sequence-parallel training.

The second piece is sparse MoE scaling. The provided text does not include the full routing details, but the intent is clear: MoE is used to scale spatiotemporal modeling capacity without paying dense-compute cost everywhere. This mirrors the logic of MoE in LLMs, but the video setting is harder because routing has to coexist with spatial, temporal, and multimodal structure. Stability, load balancing, and temporal consistency are likely more delicate here. Choosing a single-stream backbone before adding MoE is a sensible systems decision, because it avoids compounding communication and partitioning complexity that a dual-stream design would introduce.

The third piece is data and training signal design. The model is trained on a robot-augmented corpus that mixes internet-scale videos with robot manipulation, navigation, and egocentric data. Importantly, the paper frames this as a profiling, filtering, and rebalancing problem rather than naive concatenation. On top of that, the training objective includes a multi-dimensional reward system that extends beyond perceptual quality and text alignment to physical plausibility and task-level success. Conceptually, this looks like alignment for a generative video model, but the target is still pretraining behavior: learning dynamics and interactions that are more useful for embodied settings.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the full experimental section, so it is not possible to state reliable numbers for parameter count, training scale, benchmark scores, or exact gains. What can be inferred is that the paper presents qualitative T2I and T2V samples and positions the model as a large-scale open-source MoE video foundation model. The key empirical questions to check in the full paper are straightforward: whether MoE improves the quality-efficiency trade-off over dense DiT baselines, whether embodied data improves physical interaction and action semantics, and whether the reward system improves task success or physical plausibility beyond standard perceptual alignment. The most informative ablations would isolate the effects of the single-stream design, the data rebalancing pipeline, and the reward system. If the paper reports MFU, throughput, latency, load-balance metrics, or long-horizon consistency measures, those are more important than visual samples.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read it for design choices, not for the demo outputs. Start with the introduction and make sure the problem framing is clear: visually strong video generation is not the same thing as an embodied world model. Then read the unified input formulation, the single-stream DiT section, and the positional encoding design. That is where the pretraining-relevant content is. After that, jump to the MoE implementation details: where experts are inserted, how routing works, whether there is an auxiliary load-balancing loss, and what the active-vs-total parameter scales are. Then inspect the data profiling engine: source composition, filtering rules, mixture ratios, and whether there is any curriculum. Finally, read the reward section and the ablations to understand whether the added supervision behaves more like RL-style alignment, reweighting, or extra supervision heads. Around 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 MoE-DiT 和数据 profiling 设计；若正文没有干净 scaling ablation，就只能当具身视频 pretrain recipe 参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the MoE-DiT and data profiling design; without clean scaling ablations, this is mainly a recipe reference for embodied video pretraining.

paper.title: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
paper.abstract: World models -- internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment -- have become one of the most actively debated concepts in AI. From model-based reinforcement learning and video generation to embodied robotics and ultimately, physical AI, researchers across AI subfields are building systems that they call "world models", yet there is no consensus on what a world model fundamentally is, what it should predict, or how it should be built. This perspective article provide

summary.core_problem: 给“world model”一个可操作的科学定义，并提出一条分阶段的研发路线图，试图解决该概念在 RL、视频生成、机器人与生成建模社区中被混用、难以对齐的问题。全文的核心落点不是提出新训练目标或新架构，而是统一讨论：世界模型到底在压缩什么分布、应该预测什么、以及数据规模与多样性在其中的决定性作用。
summary.importance:
对 LLM 基座预训练的直接方法贡献较弱（偏观点/路线图），但对“跨模态统一预训练/视频-动作建模/物理世界建模”的研究取向有启发：
- 把 world model 视为对“感知观测 + 动作”的联合分布做最大压缩的机制，强调压缩带来的语义抽象 vs 物理细节保真之间的连续权衡。
- 强调数据多样性决定泛化上限（引用 Training Compute-Optimal 观点），并提出优先利用互联网视频的规模优势，再逐步蒸馏到任务对齐的具身数据（Inverted Pyramid Workflow）。
这些观点会影响预训练数据策略（先广覆盖再窄对齐）、表征学习目标（像素重建 vs 潜空间预测）、以及“视频作为物理先验载体”的数据工程优先级。
summary.technical_approach:
文章是 perspective，不给出单一可复现算法；技术内容主要是概念框架与工程路线：
- 批评仅按输出形式分类（renderer/simulator/planner）的功能分类法：同一个内部表征可以被不同解码头投影到像素、状态或动作建议，关键在于共享内部表征如何学到。
- 讨论 LeCun 式观点（不做像素级生成、只做 latent prediction / joint embedding）与生成式重建之间的取舍：作者倾向认为像素重建不是终点，但重建质量能作为“信息丢失诊断工具”，帮助判断压缩表征遗漏了哪些物理因素。
- 提出 compression-centered view：世界模型学习的是现实世界传感观测与动作的联合分布的压缩；压缩必然带来表征在高层语义与低层动力学/感知保真之间的权衡。
- Inverted Pyramid Workflow：以互联网视频为底座获取最大多样性物理经验，通过自动过滤与标注“解锁”隐含物理先验，再逐步漏斗式蒸馏为更紧凑、动作表征更标准化、与机器人任务更对齐的数据集。其论点是：架构与算力影响逼近上限的效率，但数据多样性抬升上限。
summary.experiments: 无核心实验与量化结果（观点文章）。文中更多是论证与例子：互联网视频包含大量隐式物理先验（物体恒常性、刚体/非刚体约束、遮挡因果、光照阴影时序等），但像素空间难以直接显式化，需要“目的性压缩机制”提取结构。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看定义与争议点澄清：他们如何界定 world model、为何认为“输出分类”不够。
- 看 compression-centered view 的论证：它如何把重建/潜空间预测之争落到“信息保留诊断”与“表征权衡”。
- 看 Inverted Pyramid Workflow：把它当作数据路线图而非算法，思考与现有视频预训练、具身数据合成/标注管线的接口。
如果目标是改进 LLM/多模态预训练 recipe，这篇更适合作为数据策略与目标函数取舍的讨论材料，而不是直接照搬实现。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a precise, scientific definition of “world models” and a staged roadmap, addressing the fact that the term is used inconsistently across model-based RL, video generation, robotics, and generative modeling. The paper is primarily about clarifying what a world model represents and how it should be built, rather than proposing a new trainable algorithm.
summary_en.importance:
Weak direct contribution to LLM pretraining methods, but useful as a framing for multimodal/foundation pretraining that targets physical understanding:
- Treats a world model as a compression mechanism for the joint distribution of sensory observations and actions, making the abstraction–fidelity trade-off explicit.
- Argues that data diversity sets the generalization ceiling (architecture/compute affect efficiency, not the ceiling), motivating an internet-video-first data strategy.
- Proposes an “Inverted Pyramid” data workflow: start from broad web video, unlock latent physical priors via automated filtering/annotation, then distill into compact, task-aligned embodied datasets.
These ideas can influence pretraining data mixture strategy and the choice between pixel reconstruction and latent-space prediction objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
As a perspective piece, it offers conceptual and engineering frameworks rather than a single reproducible method:
- Critiques function-based taxonomies (renderer/simulator/planner) as classifying decoders rather than the shared internal representation; the same internal model can be queried/decoded in multiple ways.
- Discusses the latent-prediction/joint-embedding stance (e.g., LeCun) versus generative reconstruction: reconstruction is not the end goal, but it can serve as a diagnostic for what information a compressed representation fails to preserve.
- Introduces a compression-centered definition: world models aim to maximally compress the joint distribution over real-world observations and agent actions; lossy compression induces a continuum between high-level semantics and fine-grained physical dynamics/perceptual fidelity.
- Presents the Inverted Pyramid Workflow as a data roadmap: leverage the scale/diversity of internet video to extract broad physical priors, then progressively filter/standardize action representations and distill into smaller, task-aligned datasets for robotics.
summary_en.experiments: No central experiments or quantitative results (non-empirical roadmap paper). The text motivates the approach by enumerating physical priors implicitly present in web video (object permanence, rigidity constraints, occlusion causality, lighting dynamics, etc.) and argues that pixel space hides these factors, requiring purpose-built compression/representation learning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the definition section and the critique of output-based taxonomies to understand what they consider the “internal model.”
- Focus on the compression-centered argument and how it reframes reconstruction vs latent prediction as an information-retention trade-off.
- Read the Inverted Pyramid Workflow as a data strategy blueprint; map it to existing video pretraining and embodied data pipelines.
Use it as guidance for data/objective choices, not as an implementation recipe.

recommendation.zh: 对 'World Model' 概念的系统性梳理和定义，有助于澄清当前多模态预训练和具身智能中被滥用的术语，建议快速浏览其 Roadmap 划分。
recommendation.en: A systematic review and definition of the 'World Model' concept, helping to clarify the often-abused terminology in current multimodal pretraining and embodied AI. Recommend skimming its Roadmap stages.

paper.title: MoP-JEPA: Hard-Assigned Predictor Mixtures for Stochastic JEPA World Models
paper.abstract: JEPA world models predict the next latent state with a single deterministic predictor trained by latent regression. We show that this fails structurally when the environment is stochastic: at a branching transition, the regression-optimal predictor outputs the conditional mean of the successor embeddings, a point between the true next states that corresponds to no state at all.
