summary.core_problem: 确定性JEPA世界模型在随机环境下会出现预测坍塌，回归最优预测输出后继嵌入的条件均值，不对应任何真实状态，导致规划性能极差。
summary.importance: 方法创新与理论证明，提出硬分配混合预测器的MoP-JEPA，解决了随机环境下JEPA的预测坍塌问题，并给出收敛性证明。
summary.technical_approach: 用硬分配的混合预测器替代单确定性预测器，证明其会收敛到转移分布的量化器，每个预测头对应一个后继模式，可在单次前向传播中枚举所有可能的下一状态，供规划器使用。
summary.experiments: 在OGBench离线数据集上进行无泄露评估，基于单预测器滚动的规划成功率仅0.02-0.09，而基于MoP-JEPA预测模式的规划成功率最高达0.85，在所有任务上优于确定性、门控MoE和变分预测器。

summary_en.core_problem: Deterministic JEPA world models suffer from prediction collapse in stochastic environments: the regression-optimal predictor outputs the conditional mean of successor embeddings, which corresponds to no real state, leading to very poor planning performance.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation with theoretical proof, proposing MoP-JEPA with hard-assigned predictor mixtures to solve JEPA prediction collapse in stochastic environments, with convergence guarantees.
summary_en.technical_approach: Replaces the single deterministic predictor with hard-assigned mixture predictors, proving they converge to a quantizer of the transition distribution. Each predictor head corresponds to one successor mode, enumerable in a single forward pass for planner consumption.
summary_en.experiments: Leak-free evaluation on official OGBench offline data: planning with single-predictor rollouts achieves only 0.02-0.09 success rate, while planning with MoP-JEPA predicted modes reaches up to 0.85, outperforming deterministic, gated MoE, and variational predictors on all tasks.

recommendation.zh: 硬分配混合预测器解决JEPA坍塌的思路对LLM的MoE路由和预测式建模有启发，但属世界模型领域，仅作参考。
recommendation.en: The hard-assigned mixture predictor approach to JEPA collapse offers insights for LLM MoE routing and predictive modeling, but is in the world model domain and only for reference.

paper.title: WorldRoamBench: An Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models

We introduce WorldRoamBench, an open-world benchmark for long-horizon stability across four dimensions, each with tailored innovations: (i) Action: per-frame action metric bypassing cross-model semantic scale disparity and exposing failures hidden by trajectory; (ii) Vision: segment-based drift metric capturing non-monotonic

summary.core_problem: 现有交互式世界模型评测忽略长时稳定性、记忆与物理一致性，导致模型“看起来会动但不稳定/不守物理”的问题被掩盖。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark + 指标协议：把 long-horizon stability 拆成 Action/Vision/Physics/Memory 四维度，并给出更细粒度的度量；对做多模态/世界模型预训练与评测闭环的人有用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldRoamBench：1) Action 用逐帧动作度量避免轨迹级语义尺度不一致；2) Vision 用 segment-based drift 捕捉中途崩坏；3) Physics 用 controllability-gated 评测力学/光学/3D一致性；4) Memory 用 action-decoupled 协议评测场景记忆（transition-localized 3D 点云重建）与主体记忆（tracking+VLM 推理）。
summary.experiments: 提供 600+ 测试用例，覆盖 Nature/Urban/Indoor、第一/第三人称、WASD 10-60s 交互；摘要未列出被测模型列表与具体分数，但强调能暴露轨迹级评测隐藏的失败模式。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing interactive world model evaluations miss long-horizon stability, memory, and physics consistency, hiding failures behind trajectory-level metrics.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark/metric contribution: decomposes long-horizon stability into Action/Vision/Physics/Memory with tailored protocols; useful for multimodal/world-model pretraining + eval loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldRoamBench introduces (1) per-frame action metrics, (2) segment-based drift for vision collapse, (3) controllability-gated physics plausibility scoring across mechanics/optics/3D consistency, and (4) action-decoupled memory tests via transition-localized 3D point-cloud reconstruction and tracking+VLM reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: 600+ test cases across Nature/Urban/Indoor, 1st/3rd person, WASD interactions for 10–60s; abstract doesn’t list evaluated models/scores but claims it reveals failures missed by trajectory-only eval.

recommendation.zh: 做世界模型/多模态交互预训练的可以只看指标设计：逐帧 action + segment drift 很可能比“起终点对比”更诚实。
recommendation.en: If you work on interactive world models, focus on the metric design—per-frame action and segment drift are likely more honest than start-vs-end trajectory eval.

paper.title: Directing the World: Fast Autoregressive Video Generation with Compositional Human-Camera Control
paper.abstract: Building interactive world models requires generating realistic videos while maintaining controllable dynamics over long horizons. Autoregressive video generation offers a scalable foundation, but suffers from error accumulation and temporal degradation during extended rollouts. This issue is further amplified under heterogeneous controls such as human motion and camera trajectories, which may interfere and destabilize a pretrained video prior, while existing methods often trade off controllabil

summary.core_problem: 在长时程自回归视频生成中，同时保持画质、时序稳定性，并支持人物运动和相机轨迹的组合控制。
summary.importance: 贡献是可控视频世界模型生成框架，和 LLM 预训练的直接关系有限，但自回归视频 prior、长程 rollout 稳定性和控制信号解耦对统一多模态生成有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Directing the World，自回归视频生成框架在保留统一视频 prior 的同时解耦控制学习。核心包括 Fast-Slow Memory 训练策略，用于稳定长时程 rollout 和加速收敛；人物运动控制使用 t-guided Dynamic Projection；相机控制则通过专门机制与人物控制组合，减少异质控制信号互相干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要未报告模型规模、视频 tokenization 方式、训练数据规模、基线和具体指标。实验应围绕长时程视频质量、人物运动控制、相机轨迹控制、rollout 稳定性和推理速度展开。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Xuelong Li；给定元数据未提供明确机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-horizon autoregressive video generation with stable quality and compositional control over human motion and camera trajectories.

It introduces a Fast-Slow Memory training strategy to stabilize long-horizon rollouts and improve convergence, plus a t-guided Dynamic Projection mechanism for human-motion control and additional camera-control mechanisms to reduce interference between heterogeneous controls.

paper.title: From Tokens to States: LLMs as a Special Case of World Models and the Continuous Path Beyond
paper.abstract: The AI community has framed the relationship between large language models (LLMs) and world models as a dichotomy: LLMs predict tokens; world models simulate reality. Yann LeCun argues in 2022 that reaching general intelligence requires abandoning autoregressive token prediction in favour of latent-space architectures. This framing is unnecessarily binary. Two claims will be defended. First, LLMs are a degenerate special case of world models: the state space is the set of all token sequences, th

summary.core_problem: 重新讨论 LLM 与 world model 的关系：自回归 token prediction 是否只是世界模型的一种退化形式，而不是与 latent world model 对立的路线。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是概念分析和建模范式整理。它试图把 next-token prediction、multi-token prediction、future-summary prediction、next-latent prediction 和 JEPA 放在连续谱上，帮助理解从离散 token LM 走向 latent-space 模型时会放松哪些约束、同时失去哪些可扩展训练优势。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出两个主张：第一，LLM 可以被形式化为 world model 的特殊情形，状态空间是所有 token 序列，动作只有追加一个 token；第二，从 NTP 到 JEPA 存在连续路径，中间形式包括多 token 预测、未来摘要预测和下一 latent 预测。方法主要是概念框架和已有研究的重解释，不是新模型或新实验。
summary.experiments: 摘要未描述任何实验、模型训练或定量评测。论证重点是形式化关系和研究路线图，因此结论应作为观点材料而非经验结果使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes the relationship between LLMs and world models, asking whether autoregressive token prediction is a degenerate case of world modeling rather than an opposing paradigm.
summary_en.importance: This is a conceptual analysis of modeling paradigms. It places next-token prediction, multi-token prediction, future-summary prediction, next-latent prediction, and JEPA on a continuum, clarifying which constraints are relaxed when moving from token LMs toward latent-space models and which scaling advantages may be lost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that an LLM can be formalized as a special case of a world model: the state space is the set of token sequences and the only action is appending a token. It then sketches intermediate modeling objectives between NTP and JEPA. The work is a conceptual reframing rather than a new algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report experiments, trained models, or quantitative evaluations. The contribution should be read as a position and taxonomy rather than empirical evidence.

recommendation.zh: 作为路线图观点扫一眼即可；没有实验证据，但能整理 NTP 到 latent prediction 的概念坐标。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick scan as a taxonomy; it has no empirical weight but usefully positions NTP-to-latent objectives.

paper.title: Textual Belief States for World Models: Identifiable Representation Learning Under Strict Mediation
paper.abstract: World models in partially observed environments rely on latent representations that summarize interaction history, but in many modern LLM-based architectures predictive performance fails to reflect representation quality due to history bypass, rendering the latent state unidentifiable. Strict latent state mediation, requiring predictions to depend only on the latent state and action, is a classical principle that resolves this, but enforcing it in text-based settings is an open challenge: textua

summary.core_problem: 在部分可观测交互环境里，用文本作为“信念状态/世界模型隐变量”时，强解码器会绕过瓶颈读历史，导致隐状态不可辨识、预测好但表征差。
summary.importance: 把经典的“严格中介（strict mediation）→ 可辨识/可检验表征质量”原则搬到文本离散隐变量场景，并给出可训练的实现路径；对用 LLM 做 world model / belief state 的训练目标设计有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 形式化说明 history-bypass 会破坏“预测性能≈表征质量”的可检验性；提出可变长、离散、可解释的 textual latent state 作为瓶颈，并用基于策略梯度的 factorized GRPO（fGRPO）在不可微离散通道上优化，使预测严格依赖(latent state, action)而非原始历史。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体规模/数据/指标细节；主张通过对比“严格中介 vs 历史泄漏架构”来展示：只有严格中介下，表征质量的变化会稳定反映到可观测的预测/控制指标上。
summary.authors_note: Intuit AI Research；其关注点更偏 world model 表征可辨识与训练信号设计，而非纯粹 next-token 预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: In partially observed interactive settings, text-based latent belief states are often bypassed by powerful decoders that directly exploit history, making the latent state unidentifiable despite good prediction.
summary_en.importance: Ports the classical strict-mediation principle to discrete textual latents, making representation quality empirically testable; relevant to LLM-based world models and belief-state training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes why history leakage breaks the link between predictive performance and representation quality; introduces variable-length discrete textual latent states and optimizes them with factorized GRPO (policy-gradient style) to enforce that predictions depend only on (latent state, action).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model/data/metric details; the claimed evaluation contrasts strict mediation vs history-leaky architectures to show only the former yields testable representation quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Intuit AI Research; positioned around identifiability and training-signal design for LLM-based world models rather than standard next-token pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 值得看它对“history bypass 让 latent 不可辨识”的形式化与训练约束；先核对实验是否真做到严格屏蔽历史，否则结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read for the clean framing of history-bypass → unidentifiable latents and the enforcement recipe; verify they truly block history, otherwise treat results as weak evidence.

paper.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
paper.abstract: Recent game world models can synthesize visually plausible, action-conditioned rollouts. However, their interaction behaviors often remain limited to exploratory or wandering trajectories, and physical dynamics are typically learned as implicit correlations from data rather than as controllable variables. This limitation hinders their applicability to authored game environments, where physical rules are deliberately designed and require explicit manipulation. We introduce PhysEditWorld, a multim

summary.core_problem: 构建一个可控制物理参数的游戏世界模型数据集，使模型能学习同一动作轨迹在不同重力条件下产生的可归因变化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态世界模型数据资产。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但受控 replay-and-render 数据构造方式对 embodied/world-model 预训练的数据设计有参考意义，尤其是把物理变量从相关性中显式拆出来。
summary.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld 基于 UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline：记录归一化 action trace，然后在相同初始状态、角色控制器、动作序列和相机策略下，用不同 gravity configuration 重放并渲染，从而形成成对、可控、可归因的物理变化数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示数据集包含 12 个 cinematic UE5 scenes，并围绕 gravity 作为首个版本的核心物理参数；具体样本规模、训练模型、baseline 和指标在给定信息中不完整。论文重点更偏数据构建，而不是提出新的生成模型结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a dataset for physics-editable game world models, enabling models to observe attributable changes under different gravity settings for the same action trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a multimodal world-model dataset contribution. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the controlled replay-and-render design is relevant to data construction for embodied and generative world models, especially for disentangling physical variables from raw correlations.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld uses a UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline. It records normalized action traces and replays the same initial state, character controller, action sequence, and camera policy under multiple gravity configurations, producing controlled paired data for physical variation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the dataset contains 12 cinematic UE5 scenes and focuses on gravity in the initial release. The provided information does not fully specify dataset size, trained model scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The main contribution is the data-generation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 可看数据构造思路，不必读模型细节；受控重放比随机视频采集更像 world-model 预训练该要的数据。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for the data protocol, not the model details; controlled replay is closer to useful world-model pretraining data than random video scraping.

paper.title: A Generalization Theory for JEPA-Based World Models
paper.abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for world modeling by learning predictive dynamics in a latent space rather than generating future observations at the input level. Despite their empirical success, the theoretical understanding of JEPA-based world models remains limited. In this paper, we develop the first generalization theory for JEPA-based world models. We formulate JEPA pretraining as a conditional spectral graph learning problem

summary.core_problem: 为 JEPA 类 world model 建立可解释的泛化理论，说明 latent predictive pretraining 的误差如何影响下游规划 regret。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是原理分析。它把 JEPA 预训练从经验性表征学习目标，转写为条件谱图学习和低秩矩阵分解问题，并给出有限样本泛化界。对关心 latent world model、非生成式自监督预训练和规划接口的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 JEPA pretraining 形式化为 action-conditioned co-occurrence matrix 的低秩分解；进一步把预训练误差传递到 downstream planning regret，建立样本复杂度界。核心技术点是用条件谱图学习刻画 latent dynamics，并分析 latent dimension 在近似误差与样本误差之间的权衡。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看主要是理论工作，未给出具体模型规模、训练数据或实证 benchmark。结果包括 JEPA 目标的矩阵分解等价性、pretraining error 到 planning regret 的界，以及 latent dimension 选择带来的 bias-variance 型取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a generalization theory for JEPA-style world models, linking latent predictive pretraining error to downstream planning regret.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory contribution. It recasts JEPA pretraining as conditional spectral graph learning and low-rank factorization, giving a finite-sample account of when latent predictive world models should support planning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate the JEPA objective as factorizing an action-conditioned co-occurrence matrix. They then propagate the resulting pretraining error into a regret bound for downstream planning, with latent dimensionality controlling an approximation-versus-sample-error tradeoff.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes a primarily theoretical paper rather than a scaling or empirical training study. The main outputs are equivalence results, finite-sample bounds, and a characterization of the role of latent dimension.

recommendation.zh: 只看 JEPA 目标到低秩分解、再到 planning regret 的链条；对 LLM 预训练不是直接 recipe，但能校准 latent world model 的理论 prior。
recommendation.en: Read only the JEPA-to-low-rank-factorization-to-planning-regret chain; it is not an LLM recipe, but it sharpens the prior around latent world models.

paper.title: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion with causal diffusion transformers has emerged as a major paradigm for real-time streaming video generation and action-conditioned interactive world models. In this work, we extend rCM, an advanced diffusion distillation framework, to autoregressive video diffusion. The core philosophy of rCM lies in the complementarity between forward and reverse divergences, represented by consistency models (CMs) and distribution matching distillation (DMD), respectively, in dif

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是自回归视频扩散蒸馏里的一个老问题：训练时看到的条件分布和推理时模型自己滚动生成出来的分布不一致，导致长时生成里误差累积、画质下滑、动作漂移。已有做法通常分成两段：先用 teacher-forcing 或 diffusion-forcing 做一个稳定初始化，再切到 self-forcing 配合 DMD/GAN 做 on-policy 蒸馏。但这些系统往往是经验拼装，为什么要这样分阶段、不同初始化各自解决什么问题、CM 与 DMD 在 AR diffusion 里如何互补，并没有被系统讲清楚。Causal-rCM 试图把这件事统一起来：用 teacher-forcing consistency model 提供覆盖更全、训练更稳的离线信号，再用 self-forcing DMD 对齐真实推理时的少步采样分布。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在视频生成本身，而在于它把“前向/离线目标负责稳定与覆盖，反向/on-policy目标负责贴近生成分布”这个训练原则，明确落到了 AR diffusion distillation 上。这个思路和语言模型里的 pretrain ↔ post-train、offline imitation ↔ online refinement 有明显同构关系。另一点更实际：作者给出了 teacher-forcing continuous-time consistency training 的工程实现，包括自定义 mask 的 FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel，并声称相对离散时间 CM 有 10× 收敛加速。这部分对做新型 LM 范式、尤其是 any-order / diffusion LM 的训练基础设施有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两层统一。第一层是目标函数视角：CM 被视为更偏 forward-divergence、保轨迹、mode-covering 的目标；DMD 被视为更偏 reverse-divergence、直接优化学生生成分布的目标。第二层是因果训练范式视角：teacher-forcing 对应离线、稳定、覆盖教师轨迹；self-forcing 对应 on-policy、直接暴露推理时误差。Causal-rCM 把两者配对起来，形成 teacher-forcing CM + self-forcing DMD 的组合。

更具体地说，teacher-forcing CM 阶段在真实因果上下文和教师轨迹上做 few-step causal distillation，让学生先学会在“正确历史”条件下稳定地少步去噪；随后 self-forcing DMD 阶段让学生在自己生成的 rollout 上继续优化，缩小训练-推理 gap。作者强调这两部分既可以联合训练，也可以按 forward-to-reverse 的顺序分阶段训练。

论文还系统比较了 self-forcing DMD 的不同初始化来源，包括 ODE-pair regression、diffusion-forcing 风格因果适配、hybrid TF/DF 初始化，以及他们主张的 TF-CM 初始化。作者的判断是：如果直接上 reverse/on-policy 目标，容易因为覆盖不足和初始化差而塌缩；先用 forward/offline 目标把轨迹空间铺开，再切到 DMD，稳定性和最终质量都更好。

工程上最值得注意的是 continuous-time consistency model 的实现。文中提到此前 AR diffusion 里更多用 discrete-time CM，而他们实现了 teacher-forcing 版本的 sCM / MeanFlow，并用自定义 mask 的 FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel 支持连续时间训练。这说明作者不只是换了 loss，而是把 AR causal mask、consistency training、JVP 计算图和高效注意力内核打通了。
summary.experiments:
从引言能确认的实验结论有三类。第一，训练效率：teacher-forcing continuous-time CM 相比 discrete-time CM 达到约 10× 更快收敛，这是全文里最明确、也最有工程含义的数字。第二，方法比较：作者声称做了对 self-forcing DMD 初始化策略的系统研究，并展示不同初始化各有优缺点，而 TF-CM 初始化更稳、更适合作为统一 recipe。第三，整体性能：文中将 Causal-rCM 描述为在 AR diffusion distillation 上达到领先结果，面向 streaming video generation 和 interactive world model 场景。

但就当前给出的全文片段，还拿不到完整的主表数字、模型参数量、训练数据规模、采样步数、具体 benchmark 名称，也看不到消融表的精确提升幅度。因此这篇更适合先抓方法框架和训练原则，再在正式阅读时补齐实验细节，尤其是：1）不同初始化在 FVD、长时一致性、rollout 稳定性上的差异；2）joint training 与 two-stage training 的对比；3）continuous-time 与 discrete-time CM 在 wall-clock、显存、吞吐上的真实代价。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Table 1，抓住作者要统一的三件事：causal training paradigm、distillation loss、initialization strategy。然后重点看方法部分里 teacher-forcing CM 与 self-forcing DMD 的接口定义，弄清楚训练数据来自教师轨迹还是学生 rollout，各自优化的分布是什么。接着看 continuous-time CM 的实现细节，尤其是 custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel，这部分最可能对做新型预训练范式的人有迁移价值。

实验部分建议优先看三类图表：初始化策略对比、continuous-time vs discrete-time 收敛曲线、长时 rollout 质量随时间退化的分析。如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若要深挖，重点不是视频指标本身，而是 forward/offline objective 与 reverse/on-policy objective 的分工边界，这个抽象层次更值得带回到 LM 训练里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central failure mode in autoregressive video diffusion distillation: the mismatch between training-time conditioning and inference-time self-generated rollouts. Teacher-forcing and diffusion-forcing provide stable supervision, but they do not expose the model to its own rollout errors. Self-forcing addresses exposure bias, yet DMD- or GAN-based on-policy distillation is fragile, highly initialization-sensitive, and prone to collapse. Causal-rCM tries to turn this from an ad hoc recipe into a principled training scheme by pairing an offline, mode-covering consistency objective with an on-policy distribution-matching objective.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is less about video generation per se and more about the training principle it makes explicit: offline/forward objectives are useful for coverage and stability, while on-policy/reverse objectives are useful for matching the actual generated distribution. That pattern is highly relevant to non-AR language modeling, diffusion LM training, and even the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The infrastructure contribution also matters: the paper implements teacher-forcing continuous-time consistency training for causal AR diffusion with a custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel, and reports roughly 10x faster convergence than discrete-time CMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method unifies two complementary views. At the objective level, consistency models are treated as forward-divergence-like, trajectory-preserving, and mode-covering, whereas DMD is treated as reverse-divergence-like and directly aligned with the student-generated distribution. At the causal training level, teacher-forcing plays the role of stable offline supervision on teacher trajectories, while self-forcing plays the role of on-policy refinement under autoregressive rollouts.

Causal-rCM combines them as teacher-forcing CM plus self-forcing DMD. In the first part, the student learns few-step causal distillation on offline causal contexts and teacher trajectories, which gives a stable initialization under correct histories. In the second part, the student is optimized on its own rollouts so that the distilled few-step sampler better matches inference-time behavior. The paper argues that this complementarity can be realized either jointly or in a staged forward-to-reverse schedule.

A useful part of the paper is its systematic treatment of initialization for self-forcing DMD. It compares several existing choices, including ODE-pair regression, diffusion-forcing-style causal adaptation, and hybrid TF/DF initialization, against TF-CM initialization. The claimed takeaway is that reverse/on-policy optimization alone is too brittle when coverage is poor, while a forward/offline consistency stage provides a much better basin for subsequent DMD refinement.

The engineering layer is also nontrivial. The authors implement teacher-forcing continuous-time consistency models, including sCM and MeanFlow variants, in an autoregressive causal-mask setting. The custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel is the key systems piece that makes this practical. That is likely the most transferable part for researchers working on alternative language-modeling paradigms.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text portion, three experimental claims are clear. First, training efficiency: teacher-forcing continuous-time CM converges about 10x faster than discrete-time CM. This is the most concrete quantitative result visible in the available text. Second, the paper performs a systematic study of initialization strategies for self-forcing DMD and argues that TF-CM initialization is more stable and more suitable as a unified recipe. Third, the overall method is presented as a leading open recipe for AR diffusion distillation in streaming video generation and interactive world models.

What is not recoverable from the current excerpt are the full benchmark tables, model sizes, dataset scales, sampling-step configurations, and exact gains on headline metrics. So the paper is better read first for its training decomposition and only then for detailed numbers. When reading the experiments in full, the most important checks are: differences among initialization strategies on rollout stability and long-horizon quality, joint versus two-stage training, and the real wall-clock and memory trade-offs of continuous-time versus discrete-time consistency training.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the summary table of related methods. The key is to understand the three-way alignment the paper is proposing: causal training paradigm, distillation loss, and initialization strategy. Then read the method section with one concrete question in mind: which distributions are optimized in teacher-forcing CM versus self-forcing DMD, and where exactly does the training-inference gap get reduced?

After that, go to the implementation details of continuous-time consistency training, especially the custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel. That section is likely more reusable than the video-specific parts. In the experiments, prioritize the initialization ablations, continuous-time versus discrete-time convergence plots, and long-horizon rollout degradation analyses. A practical skim should take around 25–35 minutes. If reading more deeply, focus on the division of labor between forward/offline and reverse/on-policy objectives rather than on video metrics alone.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 TF-CM 初始化 SF-DMD 的实验；它可能改变对 AR 生成中 teacher forcing 是否只是训练捷径的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the TF-CM-to-SF-DMD ablation; it may update the prior that teacher forcing is merely a training shortcut in AR generation.

paper.title: Beyond the Autoregressive Horizon: A Comprehensive Survey of Diffusion Models, World Modelling, and State Space Models for Code
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language models have driven significant progress in automated software engineering, enabling powerful code generation and assistance systems. However, the next-token prediction paradigm introduces structural limitations for code reasoning, including restricted global planning, challenges in maintaining long-range dependencies, and limited grounding in program execution semantics. Noting the heavy skewness of existing literature towards AR models, we discuss emerging paradigms

summary.core_problem: 在代码智能场景下，next-token 自回归范式的结构性限制（全局规划、长程依赖、执行语义落地）是否有替代建模路线可走。
summary.importance: 综述型工作：把“非AR代码建模”相关的三条线（Diffusion code generation / Code world models / State space models）放到同一框架下讨论，帮助预训练研究员快速定位可能挑战 AR 的范式与关键瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 以问题驱动方式梳理：1) 扩散模型用整体去噪生成以更好满足全局语法/结构约束；2) 代码世界模型通过显式/隐式执行状态模拟来增强语义与可验证性；3) SSM 以线性时间序列建模缓解长上下文成本。主要是概念归纳与文献组织，不提出新训练目标或新架构实现细节。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验（survey）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether alternatives to next-token autoregressive modeling can better address structural limitations in code intelligence (global planning, long-range dependencies, and grounding in execution semantics).
summary_en.importance: A survey that consolidates three non-AR directions for code modeling—diffusion models, code world models, and state space models—useful for quickly mapping the design space that could challenge AR pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Problem-driven literature organization: (1) diffusion-style holistic denoising for global syntactic/structural constraints, (2) code world models that simulate execution states for semantic grounding and verification, and (3) SSMs for linear-time long-context modeling. No new objective/architecture is introduced.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments (survey).

recommendation.zh: 当作“非AR代码建模路线图”备查即可；别指望有可复现的 recipe，主要价值是帮你快速列出 diffusion/CWM/SSM 三条线的关键问题清单。
recommendation.en: Use it as a map of non-AR code modeling threads; don’t expect reproducible recipes—its value is a curated problem checklist across diffusion/CWMs/SSMs.

paper.title: Autonomous Video Generation with Counterfactual Controllability for Self-Evolving World Models
paper.abstract: Existing literature claims that video generation essentially is world modelling. On the one hand, the claim is productive because it pushes generative AI beyond static images and toward temporally extended physical scenes. On the other hand, this claim dangerously relies on the belief that scaling visual prediction alone will automatically yield physical agents. We prefer a more accurate statement: video generation models learn a partial, implicit spatiotemporal world model, but not a fully grou

summary.core_problem: 重新定义视频生成作为世界模型时应满足的关键能力：不仅要预测逼真视频，还要支持可干预、可控制的反事实生成。
summary.importance: 贡献更像方法立场或框架性问题定义，而不是明确的预训练 recipe。它对基座研究有一定启发：视觉预测损失可能只学到隐式时空相关性，不能保证模型知道哪些变量可控、哪些约束来自智能体身体、哪些未来在干预后仍然有效。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张用 counterfactual controllability 作为自演化世界模型的判据。摘要未说明完整算法，但核心方向是让视频生成模型从被动预测转向可干预生成，使模型能区分可控变量、身体约束和干预后的有效未来。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline、评测指标或量化结果。若正文没有干净的反事实控制评测，这篇更应作为问题设定阅读，而不是经验结论阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that video generation as world modeling should be judged not only by realistic prediction, but by counterfactual controllability under interventions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution appears to be a framing or method proposal rather than a concrete pretraining recipe. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the warning that visual prediction losses may learn implicit spatiotemporal correlations without learning controllable variables, embodiment-specific constraints, or valid futures after intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes counterfactual controllability as a criterion for self-evolving world models. The abstract does not specify a full algorithm, but the central direction is to move video generation from passive prediction toward intervention-aware generation that separates controllable factors, body constraints, and feasible counterfactual futures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model scale, training data, baselines, metrics, or quantitative results. If the full paper lacks a clean controllability evaluation, it should be read mainly as a problem-framing piece rather than as empirical evidence.

recommendation.zh: 概念判断比实验更有用；若正文有干净反事实评测可细看，否则当作 world-model prior 修正。
recommendation.en: The framing is more useful than the likely experiments; read closely only if it offers a clean counterfactual-control evaluation.

paper.title: Beyond the Next Step: Variable-Length Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
paper.abstract: Recently, world models have emerged as a promising paradigm for building intelligent agents by learning predictive models that estimate future environment states conditioned on observations and actions. In particular, JEPA-style latent world models provide an efficient alternative to pixel space prediction by learning action-conditioned dynamics in compact representation spaces. However, existing latent world models typically rely on one-step prediction and must be recursively rolled out for lon

summary.core_problem: 现有的潜空间世界模型（Latent World Models）通常采用固定步长（如单步）的预测目标，这导致在长程规划中误差累积严重，且训练目标与下游长程任务不匹配。
summary.importance: 提出了一种变长预测的训练范式，将长程语义一致性与短期动态建模统一在一个目标下，为长程规划提供了一种更稳定的潜空间世界模型训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了变长潜空间世界模型（VLWM）。核心创新有两点：1）变长预测目标：模型被训练去预测未来第 $t+k$ 步的潜状态，其中 $k$ 是变化的，这使得模型能同时捕捉短期动态和长程语义。2）Action-as-token 机制：将动作嵌入作为标准的 Transformer token，与状态 token 交错排列，取代了传统的条件注入机制（如 FiLM），自然支持变长动作序列。为了稳定训练，采用了课程学习策略，逐步扩大预测步长 $k$。
summary.experiments: 在三个规划基准测试上，VLWM 在长程规划任务上显著优于固定步长的基线模型（如 LeWorldModel），同时在短程任务上保持或提升了性能。分析表明，变长监督能产生更具长程可预测性和下游可控性的潜空间表示。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读变长预测目标的具体形式（如何采样 $k$）以及 Action-as-token 的实现细节。课程学习策略是训练成功的关键，值得关注其实施细节。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing latent world models typically rely on fixed-step (e.g., one-step) prediction objectives, leading to severe compounding errors in long-horizon planning and a mismatch between training objectives and downstream tasks.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a variable-length prediction paradigm that unifies long-range semantic consistency and short-term dynamics modeling under a single objective, providing a more stable training method for latent world models in long-horizon planning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Variable-length Latent World Models (VLWM). Two core innovations: 1) Variable-length prediction objective: The model is trained to predict the latent state at step $t+k$, where $k$ varies, enabling the model to capture both short-term dynamics and long-range semantics. 2) Action-as-token mechanism: Treats action embeddings as standard Transformer tokens interleaved with state tokens, replacing traditional conditioning mechanisms (e.g., FiLM) and naturally supporting variable-length action sequences. To stabilize training, a curriculum learning strategy is adopted to gradually expand the prediction horizon $k$.
summary_en.experiments: On three planning benchmarks, VLWM significantly outperforms fixed-horizon baselines (e.g., LeWorldModel) on long-horizon tasks while matching or improving short-horizon performance. Analysis shows variable-length supervision yields representations with better long-range predictability and downstream controllability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the formulation of the variable-length prediction objective (how $k$ is sampled) and the implementation details of the action-as-token mechanism. The curriculum learning strategy is crucial for stable training and warrants attention. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对 World Model 长程规划的复合误差问题提出了变长预测框架，思路直接，值得关注其具体实现和在复杂环境下的表现。
recommendation.en: Proposes a variable-length prediction framework to address compounding errors in long-horizon planning for World Models; the approach is straightforward and its implementation and performance in complex environments are worth watching.

paper.title: FlexLAM: Resolving the Bottleneck Trade-off in Latent Action Learning
paper.abstract: Latent actions provide a compact interface between action-free video and downstream decision-making, yet existing Latent Action Models (LAMs) force every transition through a fixed-capacity bottleneck. We identify a bottleneck trade-off: overly tight codes can discard transition cues needed for action alignment, while overly loose codes preserve additional transition variation that must be resolved when alignment labels are scarce or narrowly distributed. FlexLAM replaces this fixed capacity wit

summary.core_problem: 解决 Latent Action Models 中固定容量 latent action bottleneck 的取舍：容量太小会丢失动作对齐所需的转移信息，容量太大会保留过多无关变化，给少量标注对齐带来负担。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 latent action 表示学习方法。它与视频到动作 token、机器人/世界模型接口有关，对思考多模态 agent 预训练中的 action tokenization 有弱相关性，但不是 LLM 基座训练论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FlexLAM，用 nested dropout 训练 variable-length latent actions，得到 prefix-valid codes。短前缀先编码紧凑转移结构，需要更多细节时再使用更长 code；不引入新架构或额外 loss，主要改变 latent code 的容量调度方式。
summary.experiments: 在 action-free video 到下游决策的 latent action 学习设置中评估。摘要称单个 FlexLAM 在多个 token budget 下匹配或超过分别训练的固定容量 LAM，并在标准 scarce-label supervision 和 low-return single-task alignment stress test 下都成立。未给出具体模型规模、数据集规模或绝对提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fixed-capacity bottleneck in Latent Action Models: codes that are too tight discard transition cues needed for action alignment, while codes that are too loose retain nuisance variation that is hard to align with scarce labels.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a latent-action representation-learning method. It is weakly relevant to action tokenization for multimodal agents and world-model pretraining, but it is not an LLM foundation-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlexLAM trains variable-length latent actions with nested dropout, producing prefix-valid codes. Short prefixes encode compact transition structure first, while longer codes add details only when needed. The method changes capacity allocation without introducing new architectures or losses.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates latent action learning from action-free video for downstream decision-making. The abstract reports that one FlexLAM matches or surpasses separately trained fixed-capacity LAMs at every evaluated token budget, both under standard scarce-label supervision and under a low-return single-task alignment stress test. The abstract does not provide model scale, dataset scale, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 action-tokenizer 备查即可；nested dropout 的可变长度 bottleneck 有意思，但离 LLM pretrain 还隔一层。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an action-tokenizer reference; the nested-dropout variable bottleneck is neat, but it sits one layer away from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Can In-Context Learning Support Intrinsic Curiosity?
paper.abstract: Effective machine learning depends not only on how we model data, but also on what data we choose to collect. While large sequence models have revolutionized data modeling, the problem of automated data selection, or "intrinsic curiosity", remains a significant challenge. Classic approaches incentivize exploration by rewarding an agent based on its "learning progress", which measures how much a newly acquired observation improves a world model's predictive ability. However, evaluating these rewa

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个基础问题：能否用序列模型的 in-context learning 来计算内在好奇心奖励，从而避免传统 learning progress 方法中每条轨迹都要对 world model 做梯度更新的昂贵内循环。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值在于把 ICL 明确放到“摊销贝叶斯推断”的框架里，并分析这种能力能否支持主动数据采集。对基座模型研究来说，这比一个普通 RL 探索方法更有意义：它讨论的是预训练出的序列模型能不能在冻结状态下评估新数据的信息量。结论比较克制：在一般 MDP 中，基于预测误差的好奇心奖励会偏离 Bayesian information gain；在更受控的 Bayesian Experimental Design 设置中，某些奖励可以由 ICL 近似，并在长轨迹极限下接近 BIG。这给数据选择、主动学习、world model 预训练和 RL pretrain 提供了一个较清晰的边界条件。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 Bayes-Adaptive MDP 出发，假设每个 episode 有一个固定但未知的环境参数 θ，状态转移由 θ 决定。目标不是最大化外部任务奖励，而是训练策略选择最有信息量的 action，使轨迹尽可能揭示 θ。理想奖励是 Bayesian information gain，即观察新状态后关于 θ 获得了多少信息。直接计算 BIG 需要显式建模环境参数并做贝叶斯推断，通常不可行。论文改用一个预训练后冻结的序列模型 ρ：它在由先验 p(θ) 采样的环境轨迹上训练，输入上下文后输出 next-state posterior predictive。核心假设是，如果 ρ 通过 ICL 近似了贝叶斯后验预测，那么可以通过它的预测误差，或通过操纵上下文前后的预测差异，来构造内在奖励。理论部分给出两类结论：对一般 MDP，prediction-based intrinsic rewards 是 BIG 的有偏估计，经典 learning progress 这类需要真实模型更新前后对比的奖励不能直接由一次 ICL 前向替代；对 Bayesian Experimental Design 这类更接近独立实验选择的设置，若轨迹足够长并使用合适的奖励结构，ICL 可以近似若干信息增益型奖励，并渐近逼近 BIG。
summary.experiments: 实验用于验证理论判断：预训练的序列模型可以在受控环境中用上下文快速适配，并产生可用于训练探索策略的 curiosity reward；但在一般 MDP 中，预测误差型奖励和真实信息增益之间会出现系统性偏差。摘要和提供的正文片段没有给出完整数值、模型规模或环境细节，因此不宜补充具体提升幅度。可确认的实验结论是：ICL 作为 world model 的快速推断机制是可行的，但它能否正确度量“信息量”取决于环境结构和奖励定义，而不是只取决于模型预测能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30 分钟。先看 Problem Setting and Notation，确认 BAMDP、latent θ、BIG 和 posterior predictive 的定义；这些定义决定了后面结论的适用范围。然后看理论部分的两个边界：一般 MDP 的负结果，以及 Bayesian Experimental Design 的正结果。实验部分重点看预测误差奖励和 BIG 的相关性、策略收集数据的分布变化，以及不同 reward construction 的对比。若关心预训练数据选择，可以重点思考：一个冻结的 ICL 模型是否能作为数据价值评估器，以及在什么环境假设下这种评估器会失真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether in-context learning can be used to compute intrinsic curiosity rewards without running an expensive inner loop of gradient updates to a world model inside every trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research comes from its treatment of ICL as amortized Bayesian inference. The question is not only how a sequence model predicts data, but whether a frozen pretrained sequence model can evaluate which new data would be informative. That connects directly to active data collection, world-model pretraining, RL pretraining, and data-value estimation. The main message is conditional rather than universal: prediction-based curiosity rewards are biased estimators of Bayesian information gain in general MDPs, but in Bayesian Experimental Design settings some ICL-computable rewards can approximate information gain, and one reward structure can asymptotically approach BIG for long trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is a Bayes-Adaptive MDP. Each episode samples a latent environment parameter θ from a prior, and transitions are Markovian given θ. There is no external task reward. The policy should choose actions that produce trajectories informative about θ. The ideal intrinsic reward is Bayesian information gain, the mutual information between the next observation and θ conditioned on the history. Exact BIG is hard because it requires explicit Bayesian inference over environment dynamics. The paper instead assumes a pretrained and frozen sequence model ρ trained on trajectories from the prior, with uniform actions, to output the Bayesian posterior predictive for the next state. Under this view, ρ is an in-context learner that performs fast posterior prediction from its context. The paper then studies which intrinsic rewards can be computed from prediction errors or context manipulations of ρ. It proves negative results for general MDPs: prediction-based rewards do not generally equal BIG, and classic learning progress cannot be implemented simply by replacing model updates with ICL. It also proves positive results for Bayesian Experimental Design regimes, where several reward constructions become ICL-approximable and a suitable long-horizon reward can converge toward BIG.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to check the theoretical claims. They show that a pretrained sequence model can adapt in context and provide curiosity rewards useful for exploration in controlled settings. They also show the predicted failure mode: in general MDPs, prediction-error-based rewards can diverge systematically from true information gain. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, model sizes, or environment details, so exact gains should not be inferred. The reliable takeaway is that ICL can remove the gradient-update bottleneck for some curiosity objectives, but correctness depends on the environment class and the reward construction.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 minutes. Read the problem setup first, especially the definitions of BAMDP, latent θ, BIG, and the posterior predictive model ρ. Then focus on the theoretical sections separating the general-MDP negative result from the Bayesian Experimental Design positive result. In the experiments, look for how closely the ICL-derived rewards track BIG, how the learned policy changes the data distribution, and which reward constructions fail. For pretraining researchers, the key question to keep in mind is when a frozen ICL model can serve as a data-value estimator and when predictive accuracy is not enough to measure information gain.

recommendation.zh: 将 ICL 视为免更新的世界模型来计算内在奖励，思路巧妙，对理解 ICL 机制和设计高效探索策略有启发。
recommendation.en: Cleverly frames ICL as an update-free world model for computing intrinsic rewards; inspiring for understanding ICL mechanisms and designing efficient exploration strategies.

paper.title: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
paper.abstract: While RL has become a promising tool for refining world models, existing methods largely rely on conservative rollouts near the training distribution, limiting exploration, behavioral diversity, and richer dynamic discovery. In this work, we challenge this conservative paradigm. We argue that the core limitation is not exploration itself, but the lack of reliable verification strategies to support broader exploration. Without reliable verification, expanded exploration becomes highly susceptible

summary.core_problem: 解决 embodied world model 中 RL 探索受限的问题：现有方法倾向在训练分布附近做保守 rollout，原因是奖励信号不可靠，扩大探索后容易 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法与训练信号设计。它把 reward 设计成一个主动评估行为的 agent，而不是静态打分器，用于支持更宽的探索范围。对 LLM 预训练研究员的间接价值在于，它讨论了 RL 中“探索—验证—奖励作弊”的闭环，而这也是 RLVR、agentic post-training 和世界模型训练里的共同问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Reward as an Agent：奖励模块主动检查生成行为，从物理合理性、任务完成度和动态一致性等角度给出更稳健的反馈。方法重点不是让 policy 更会探索，而是用 agentic verifier 承担 reward shaping 与异常行为识别，降低 expanded rollout 带来的奖励漏洞。
summary.experiments: 实验设在 embodied world models，使用物理合理性和任务完成作为验证环境。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称或数值提升；只能确认论文将保守 rollout 与更宽探索下的 agentic reward 做对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses restricted RL exploration in embodied world models, where conservative rollouts near the training distribution are used because unreliable rewards make broader exploration vulnerable to reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a reward-signal and training-loop design. It turns reward into an active agent rather than a passive scorer, aiming to support broader exploration. For LLM pretraining researchers, the useful signal is indirect: the exploration-verification-reward-hacking loop is also central to RLVR, agentic post-training, and world-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Reward as an Agent, actively evaluates generated behaviors using criteria such as physical plausibility, task completion, and dynamic consistency. The key move is not simply to increase exploration, but to pair wider rollout distributions with an agentic verifier that can detect reward exploits and provide more robust feedback.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted in embodied world-model settings, using physical plausibility and task completion as verification signals. The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, baselines, or numerical gains; it only indicates comparisons between conservative rollout regimes and broader exploration with agentic reward.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 RL reward 设计的弱信号看，重点看 verifier 如何约束探索；和 LLM 预训练关系较远。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a weak signal on RL reward design; inspect how the verifier constrains exploration, but it is distant from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Physics-IQ Verified
paper.abstract: Video generative models ( VGMs) have become a new frontier that can be used not just for video generation but for a multitude of downstream tasks, including world modeling. To advance these tasks, a good video model must understand the physical reality of the world. Evaluating this understanding is an emerging field and has led to the Physics-IQ benchmark, which quantifies this explicitly by comparing model-generated videos to real-world videos of physical experiments. In this work, we present a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作不是提出新的视频生成模型，而是审计一个已经被广泛采用的物理理解评测基准 Physics-IQ。它要解决的问题是：当前 benchmark 的分数到底有多大程度在测“模型是否理解物理”，又有多大程度被提示词歧义、参考视频伪激活、以及数据集级聚合方式这些评测噪声左右。如果 benchmark 本身有系统误差，那么后续模型比较、训练方向甚至所谓 world model 进展都会被带偏。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不算高，因为核心对象是视频生成模型评测，而不是 LLM 预训练方法本身。但它对“生成式世界模型如何被可靠评估”有方法论价值，尤其适合关注统一视频生成/世界模型的人。重要之处在于它提醒了一件常被忽略的事：当 benchmark 试图测更高层能力，比如物理一致性、因果结构或世界建模时，评测协议里的小偏差会被放大，甚至改变模型排名。对做多模态基座的人，这比单纯再加几个分数更有意义，因为它关系到训练目标是否真的朝着想要的能力优化。
summary.technical_approach:
作者做了三类修正。第一是 prompt 质量修正。原始 Physics-IQ 中一部分文本描述存在歧义，而且没有充分考虑不同模型的提示习惯。作者为不清晰样本重写更具区分性的描述，并引入 template 化 prompting，使输入更符合模型类型与使用规范。这样做的目的不是“帮模型作弊”，而是减少由于提示不当导致的无关误差，让分数更接近模型能力上限。

第二是 metric aggregation 修正。原始 Physics-IQ 主要定义数据集级总分，不同样本对总分影响不均，也不利于定位失败模式。作者提出 sample-level 的 Physics-IQ Verified 分数，把四个指标在样本层面统一计算与归一化，再做更公平的聚合。这个改动的价值在于可解释性和统计稳健性：你可以知道模型到底在哪些实验、哪类物理现象、哪种指标上失败，而不是只看一个混合总分。

第三是 ground-truth artifact 清理。作者发现不少参考视频里存在与目标物理现象无关的“spurious metric activations”，例如背景变化、偶然运动或采集噪声会触发 IoU/MSE 类指标，导致模型即使没抓住真正物理过程，也可能得到误导性的分数。于是他们对参考视频做清理，尽量让指标只响应目标物理效应。相比重新设计全套指标，这是一种更务实的 benchmark 修复路径：先把测量对象定义得更干净，再谈模型优劣。
summary.experiments:
实验上最关键的不是某个模型赢了，而是 benchmark 修正后模型排序会明显变化。作者在六个 image-to-video 模型上同时跑原始版和 Verified 版评测，发现不同模型对这些修正的敏感性不同，因此总体排名发生了较大变化。这说明原始 benchmark 的噪声不是均匀噪声，而是会系统性偏向某些模型。

数据层面的修正幅度也不小。文中给出：57.6% 的样本存在被修正的 measurement errors，影响到 29.8% 的视频；34.8% 的 prompt 被认定为高度歧义并得到纠正。基准本身包含 66 个物理实验、3 个视角、2 次重复，共 396 个视频，每个视频 8 秒，其中前 3 秒作为条件输入，后 5 秒用于生成与比较。评测仍沿用四个核心指标：Spatial IoU、Spatiotemporal IoU、Weighted Spatial IoU 和 MSE，但作者重新审视了这些指标在样本层面的聚合与参考信号质量。对读者来说，最值得注意的是：这些修正并非边角料，而是足以改变 benchmark 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和作者列出的三类问题，确认它到底在修什么。然后直接看 benchmark 设计与原始 Physics-IQ score 的定义，理解原版为何会在 dataset-level aggregation 上掩盖样本差异。接着重点看 prompt ambiguity 的案例图、artifact 清理示例，以及原始版和 Verified 版下模型排名变化的结果表。若只想抓住结论，读完问题定义、三项修正和 ranking change 的实验即可，20 分钟左右足够。若你关心世界模型评测设计，再细看 sample-level score 的公式与 physical variation ceiling 的处理方式。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 团队；从文中提供的 benchmark 仓库与写作风格可确认机构背景，但当前材料未给出完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper does not introduce a new video generative model. It audits Physics-IQ, a benchmark that has quickly become a standard way to evaluate whether video generation models capture physical reality rather than merely producing plausible motion. The core question is whether the benchmark score actually measures physical understanding, or whether it is substantially distorted by prompt ambiguity, artifacts in the reference videos, and a dataset-level aggregation scheme that hides sample-specific failures.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect, since the work is centered on evaluation for video generative models rather than language-model training. Still, it matters for anyone interested in world models, multimodal pretraining, or unified generative modeling. The main contribution is methodological: when a benchmark aims to measure higher-level capabilities such as physical consistency or causal understanding, small protocol flaws can become large sources of error and even change model rankings. That is a useful warning for foundation-model research more broadly, because optimization follows evaluation. If the benchmark is misaligned, model development will be misaligned too.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper makes three concrete corrections. First, it improves prompt quality. The authors identify ambiguous prompts in the original benchmark and rewrite them to be more distinctive, while also introducing a templated prompting scheme that better matches model-specific prompting practices. The point is not to make the task easier in an artificial way, but to reduce variance caused by poor prompting so the score better reflects model capability.

Second, it changes metric aggregation. The original Physics-IQ score is defined at the dataset level, which means samples can contribute unevenly and failure modes are hard to localize. The paper introduces a sample-level Physics-IQ Verified score so that each sample and each metric can be analyzed more directly and aggregated more fairly. This improves interpretability and statistical hygiene.

Third, it cleans artifacts in the ground-truth videos. The authors show that many reference videos contain spurious activations unrelated to the target physical phenomenon, such as incidental motion or visual noise that can trigger IoU- or MSE-based metrics. They therefore clean the references so the metrics respond more selectively to the intended physical effect. This is a pragmatic benchmark-repair strategy: clean the measurement target before redesigning the entire metric stack.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important result is not that one model scores higher than another, but that model rankings change materially once the benchmark is corrected. The authors evaluate six image-to-video models under both the original and the verified protocols and find that models respond differently to the benchmark fixes, leading to substantial ranking shifts. That means the noise in the original benchmark is not harmless random noise; it can systematically favor some models over others.

The scale of the benchmark issues is also nontrivial. The paper reports that the refinement removes measurement errors in 57.6% of all samples, affects 29.8% of videos, and corrects more than 34.8% of prompts judged to be highly ambiguous. The benchmark itself contains 66 physical experiments, each recorded from 3 viewpoints and repeated twice, for a total of 396 videos. Each 8-second video is split into a 3-second conditioning segment and a 5-second continuation to be predicted. The evaluation still uses the original four metrics—Spatial IoU, Spatiotemporal IoU, Weighted Spatial IoU, and MSE—but revisits how they should be aggregated and what reference signal they should operate on. The practical takeaway is that these are not cosmetic fixes; they are large enough to alter benchmark conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the three failure modes the paper identifies. Then read the section that defines the original Physics-IQ score to understand why dataset-level aggregation can obscure sample-level behavior. After that, focus on the prompt-ambiguity examples, the artifact-cleaning examples, and the table showing ranking changes between the original and verified protocols. If you only need the main message, those parts are enough and should take around 20 minutes. If you care about benchmark design for world models, spend extra time on the sample-level score definition and the treatment of the physical-variation ceiling.
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind team; the repository and paper context make the institution clear, but the full author list is not available in the provided material.

recommendation.zh: 做视频 world model 评测的人应扫一遍；重点看哪些样本被改掉，原 Physics-IQ 分数可能混入 prompt/GT 噪声。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you evaluate video world models; focus on the revised samples, since original Physics-IQ scores may include prompt and ground-truth noise.

paper.title: Can LLM Agents Infer World Models? Evidence from Agentic Automata Learning
paper.abstract: We propose agentic automata learning to evaluate the extent to which tool-calling LLM agents can uncover hidden environments through interaction. In our setup, an agent should uncover a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA) by interacting with an oracle through (1) membership queries ("Does this string belong to the target language?") and (2) equivalence queries ("Is this the target DFA?"). This yields a scalable testbed with controlled task complexity, measurable interaction efficiency, a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题很具体：工具调用型 LLM agent 在与环境交互时，能否真正学出一个可验证的世界模型，而不是只靠局部模式和短视试探。作者把问题落到 active automata learning 上，让模型通过 membership query 和 equivalence query 去识别一个隐藏 DFA。这样做的好处是，环境结构已知、复杂度可控、最优或强基线算法现成，因而可以把“会不会建模环境”拆成可测的几个维度：成功率、查询效率、随状态数增长的退化曲线，以及交互轨迹中的规划失误类型。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对“agent 能力到底来自哪里”给了一个很干净的诊断框架。价值主要有三层。第一，它把 world-model inference 从开放任务里抽离出来，避免 benchmark 污染和任务提示技巧，把能力测成一个受控变量。第二，它说明当前强推理模型即便在小规模离散环境里也远未接近经典算法，问题不只是知识不足，而是主动查询规划、证据整合、假设修正这几步都不稳。第三，这类结果对预训练和后训练都有启发：如果模型在这种最小化环境建模任务上都明显掉队，那么仅靠更长 CoT 或更大模型未必能补齐，可能需要更明确的交互式训练信号、外部记忆、程序化状态表示，或把“查询策略学习”直接纳入训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把经典 automata learning 重新包装成 agentic setting。每个任务实例先采样一个目标 DFA，agent 只能通过两类工具与 oracle 交互：MQ 询问某个字符串是否被目标语言接受，EQ 提交一个候选 DFA，若错误则得到反例。评测时既看最终是否恢复正确 DFA，也看用了多少查询。复杂度主要由最小 DFA 的状态数控制。基线选了经典的 L* 和 TTT，这一点很关键，因为它让结果不只是“模型彼此比较”，而是“模型与已知高效学习程序比较”。从全文描述看，作者还做了轨迹级分析，把失败分成几类：查询不够信息化、对已有观测推理不一致、构造假设时没有正确利用历史证据、收到 counterexample 后修正方向不对。这个分析框架比单纯报成功率更有信息量，因为它把 agent 失败定位到 planning 和 state tracking，而不是笼统归因于 reasoning 不足。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果有三点。第一，随着 DFA 状态数增加，成功率快速下滑；对 9-state automata，没有任何模型超过 25% 成功率，而经典算法在同类任务上是 100%。第二，即便只看成功样本，最强模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的查询数仍比 TTT 多约 45.8%，说明问题不只是偶尔失败，而是整体发现过程低效。第三，reasoning model 与非 reasoning model 差距很大：在 4–5 状态任务上，Gemini 3.1 Pro 可达 85% 成功，而 GPT-5.4 非 reasoning、Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、Llama-3.3-70B 为 0%。这些数字说明，显式推理能力确实有帮助，但帮助主要体现在把模型从“几乎不会做”拉到“能做一部分”，离稳定、系统化的环境归纳还很远。轨迹分析部分的价值也不小：模型常提出冗余或低区分度查询，不能围绕当前 hypothesis 的不确定边界去设计 probe；拿到反例后，也常不能把反例转成结构性修正，而只是局部打补丁。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和任务定义，理解为什么 DFA learning 是一个比一般 agent benchmark 更干净的世界模型测试。然后重点看实验主表和按状态数分层的结果图，抓住两个事实：性能随复杂度的退化斜率，以及与 L*/TTT 的效率差。接着看 trajectory analysis，尤其是作者如何把失败拆成 query planning、evidence integration、hypothesis construction 三类。若只花 20–30 分钟，建议读任务设定、主结果、失败案例三部分即可。若要深挖，可以思考两件事：一是当前 agent 框架里，模型到底缺的是搜索策略、外部记忆，还是离散结构归纳偏置；二是如果把这类任务做成 post-training 或 RL 环境，奖励该如何设计，才能学到接近经典 learner 的查询策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: can tool-using LLM agents actually infer a latent world model through interaction, rather than relying on shallow local heuristics? It instantiates this as active automata learning: the agent must recover a hidden DFA using membership queries and equivalence queries. This setup gives controlled environment complexity, exact ground truth, strong algorithmic baselines, and trajectory-level observability, so “world-model inference” becomes measurable instead of anecdotal.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for foundation-model researchers because it isolates one capability that many agent benchmarks blur together. The contribution is mainly diagnostic. First, it turns latent-structure inference into a clean controlled testbed. Second, it shows that current reasoning-capable LLM agents remain far from classical learners even in small deterministic environments, so the gap is not just missing knowledge but weak query planning, weak evidence aggregation, and unstable hypothesis revision. Third, it suggests that scaling CoT alone is unlikely to close this gap; more explicit interactive training signals, external state tracking, or policy learning over information-gathering actions may be needed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method recasts classical active automata learning as an agentic evaluation environment. For each instance, an oracle is initialized with a target DFA. The LLM agent can call two tools: MQ asks whether a string is accepted by the target language, and EQ submits a hypothesized DFA, which is either accepted or rejected with a counterexample. Task difficulty is controlled by the number of states in the minimal DFA. Evaluation measures both final identification success and interaction efficiency in number of queries. A strong design choice is the inclusion of classical learners such as L* and TTT as baselines, which anchors the results against known efficient procedures rather than only against other LLMs. The paper also goes beyond aggregate scores and analyzes trajectories, attributing failures to poor query informativeness, inconsistent reasoning over accumulated evidence, weak use of prior observations when constructing hypotheses, and ineffective use of counterexamples for refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Three results matter most. First, performance drops sharply as DFA size grows: for 9-state automata, no tested model exceeds 25% success, while classical algorithms solve all instances. Second, even on successful runs, Gemini 3.1 Pro, the best model in the study, uses about 45.8% more queries than TTT, indicating a substantial efficiency gap. Third, reasoning models are much stronger than non-reasoning ones: on 4–5 state automata, Gemini 3.1 Pro reaches 85% success, whereas GPT-5.4 without reasoning, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, and Llama-3.3-70B score 0%. The trajectory analysis is equally informative: models often ask redundant or weakly discriminative queries, fail to maintain a coherent global hypothesis, and treat counterexamples as local patches rather than structural evidence for DFA refinement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the task formulation and motivation sections to see why DFA learning is a cleaner probe of world-model inference than open-ended agent benchmarks. Then read the main results tables and the plots stratified by DFA size; the key signal is the degradation slope with complexity and the efficiency gap to L*/TTT. After that, focus on the trajectory analysis and failure cases, especially how the paper separates planning failures from evidence-integration failures. For a quick read, 20–30 minutes on setup, main results, and representative trajectories is enough. For deeper reading, the useful question is not whether LLMs fail, but what kind of inductive bias is missing: search policy, external memory, symbolic state abstraction, or training on information-gathering behavior itself.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务形式和错误轨迹分析即可；它把“agent 会不会学世界模型”拆成了干净可控的反例生成器。
recommendation.en: Read the task setup and failure-trajectory analysis; it gives a clean counterexample generator for claims about agents learning world models.

paper.title: DLWM: Diverse Latent World Models for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have improved considerably in recent years. Existing approaches typically rely on explicit chain-of-thought or continuous latent-space trajectories to enhance multi-step reasoning. However, these methods generally assume that an input admits a single latent interpretation and unfold reasoning along a fixed path or under a uniform computation budget. In real-world multimodal settings, visual observations are often subject to occlu

summary.core_problem: 多模态推理中，视觉输入常有遮挡、模糊、视角变化和语义歧义，单一路径 latent reasoning 难以覆盖多个可能解释。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态 latent reasoning 方法创新：把连续潜空间世界模型、多假设推理和强化学习结合，目标是在不固定单一路径和统一算力预算的情况下改进多步推理。
summary.technical_approach: DLWM 在连续 latent space 中构造多组 latent world hypotheses，每组表示一种可能的视觉解释或推理状态；再用强化学习选择、展开或分配推理预算。相对显式 CoT，它不依赖文本链；相对单轨 latent trajectory，它显式保留多假设分支。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据、RL 细节、baseline 名称或具体提升。可确认实验目标是 MLLM 的多步 multimodal reasoning，并关注 memory usage 与 rollout cost。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses multimodal reasoning under ambiguous visual observations, where a single latent interpretation and a fixed reasoning path can be inadequate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a latent-reasoning method for MLLMs: it combines continuous latent world models, multiple hypotheses, and reinforcement learning to allocate reasoning effort more flexibly.
summary_en.technical_approach: DLWM constructs a set of diverse latent world hypotheses, each corresponding to a plausible interpretation of the multimodal input. Reinforcement learning is then used to guide hypothesis selection, rollout, or compute allocation. Compared with textual CoT, the reasoning is latent; compared with single-trajectory latent reasoning, it keeps multiple branches alive.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include model size, data scale, RL algorithm details, named baselines, or numerical gains. It states that the method targets MLLM multi-step reasoning while reducing memory and rollout cost.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和 RL 预算分配部分即可；多假设 latent reasoning 值得跟，但缺数字前不要改训练路线。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and RL budget-allocation section; multi-hypothesis latent reasoning is worth tracking, but do not update training plans without numbers.

paper.title: GeoStream: Toward Precise Camera Controlled Streaming Video Generation
paper.abstract: Accurate interactive camera control is essential for video-based world models, but most existing approaches learn camera motion implicitly, leading to inaccurate control under out-of-distribution trajectories. Explicit geometric conditioning improves controllability, but existing methods are non-autoregressive and rely on a static 3D cache built from an initial frame, which becomes ineffective once the viewpoint moves beyond the original frustum. We propose GeoStream, a framework that enables pr

summary.core_problem: 交互式视频世界模型需要精确相机控制，但隐式学习相机运动的方法在分布外轨迹上控制不准，静态 3D cache 又会在视角移出初始视锥后失效。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成和世界模型方向的系统方法：在 autoregressive streaming video generation 中引入在线自刷新几何条件，用于 metric-scale camera control。
summary.technical_approach: GeoStream 维护一个 self-refreshing 3D cache：从最近生成帧估计深度，反投影到 3D，再重投影到目标视角，生成 point reprojection 作为后续合成的几何条件。训练时也用 student 自己生成帧渲染条件，以缩小训练和推理时的条件分布差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供训练数据、模型大小、视频长度、baseline 或量化提升。可确认评估重点是 autoregressive streaming video generation 中的精确相机控制，尤其是分布外 camera trajectories。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets controllable streaming video generation, where implicit camera-motion learning fails on out-of-distribution trajectories and a static 3D cache becomes invalid once the view leaves the initial frustum.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systems-style method for video generation and world models: online refreshed geometric conditioning for metric-scale camera control in autoregressive streaming generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GeoStream maintains a self-refreshing 3D cache. It estimates depth from the latest generated frame, unprojects it to 3D, reprojects it into the target camera, and uses point reprojections as geometric conditioning for subsequent frames. Training conditions are also rendered from the student's own generated frames to reduce train-test mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not specify training data, model size, sequence length, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation focus is precise camera control in autoregressive streaming video generation, especially under out-of-distribution trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 作为视频世界模型工程信号看即可；自刷新 3D cache 思路干净，但离 LLM 预训练方法还有距离。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering signal for video world models; the self-refreshing 3D cache is clean, but it is far from LLM pretraining methodology.

paper.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
paper.abstract: This work presents RepWAM, a representation-centric world action model (WAM) built on representation visual-action tokenizers. Existing WAMs typically inherit reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers from pretrained video generation models. Although these tokenizers preserve visual fidelity, pixel reconstruction alone provides limited guidance for learning instruction-following dynamics that connect future prediction with robot control. To address this, we explore a semantic visual-action latent

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个能更好地将未来预测与机器人控制联系起来的、基于表示的世界动作模型（WAM）？
summary.importance: 指出现有基于重建的视频tokenizer在学习指令跟随动态（连接预测与控制）方面存在局限，提出了一种基于语义视觉-动作潜在空间的表示中心WAM。
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个表示视觉-动作tokenizer，将视觉输入映射到对齐的视觉和潜在动作token。然后预训练WAM，在语言指令下联合建模未来视觉状态和连接它们的潜在动作，最后适应真实机器人轨迹进行闭环操作。
summary.experiments: 在真实世界操作任务和模拟基准测试中进行了实验，表明RepWAM提供了更好的性能（具体提升幅度未在摘要中说明）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自复旦大学、蚂蚁集团等，Yu-Gang Jiang是复旦大学知名教授，Yujun Shen在生成模型领域有丰富经验。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a representation-centric World Action Model (WAM) that better connects future prediction with robot control?
summary_en.importance: Identifies limitations of existing reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers in learning instruction-following dynamics (connecting prediction and control), and proposes a representation-centric WAM based on a semantic visual-action latent space.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a representation visual-action tokenizer mapping visual inputs to aligned visual and latent action tokens. Pretrains the WAM to jointly model future visual states and connecting latent actions under language instructions, followed by adaptation to real robot trajectories for closed-loop manipulation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks show RepWAM delivers better performance (specific improvements not detailed in abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Fudan University, Ant Group, etc. Yu-Gang Jiang is a well-known professor at Fudan, and Yujun Shen has extensive experience in generative models.

recommendation.zh: 探索了视觉-动作联合 tokenizer 的设计，对多模态统一预训练中如何离散化和对齐控制信号有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Explores the design of a joint visual-action tokenizer, offering reference value for discretizing and aligning control signals in unified multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence: Explanatory Insufficiency as a Driver of Representation Learning and World Models
paper.abstract: Representation learning is central to modern machine learning, enabling transitions from handcrafted features to learned embeddings, latent spaces, foundation models, world models, and digital twins. Yet most research examines how representations are optimized after a representational framework has been selected, while less attention is given to when a new level of representation becomes necessary. We introduce the Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER), a framework describing how

summary.core_problem: 现有研究关注表征框架选定后如何优化，但较少关注何时需要新的表征层级的问题。
summary.importance: 理论创新：首次提出表征涌现的自举理论(TBER)，将解释不足识别为表征转变的积极信号。
summary.technical_approach: TBER框架描述当现有表征仍能描述观察但无法解释其组织或变换时，新表征如何产生；解释不足是表征创新的驱动因素。
summary.experiments: 纯理论框架，无实验验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Most research focuses on optimizing representations after a framework is selected, with less attention to when a new level of representation becomes necessary.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical innovation: proposes the Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER), identifying explanatory insufficiency as a positive signal for representational transition.
summary_en.technical_approach: TBER framework describes how new representations arise when existing ones can still describe observations but no longer make their organization or transformations intelligible; explanatory insufficiency drives representational innovation.
summary_en.experiments: Pure theoretical framework, no experimental validation.

recommendation.zh: 高度抽象的表征学习理论框架，非针对LLM，对LLM机制分析仅有间接启发，读摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Highly abstract theoretical framework on representation learning, not specific to LLMs; indirect intellectual interest for mechanism analysis but no direct practical value. Read abstract only.

paper.title: Autoregressive Diffusion World Models for Off-Policy Evaluation of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents in multi-turn interactive environments is expensive and risky, as it requires online environment interaction. We propose ADWM (Autoregressive Diffusion World Model), an evaluation framework that estimates the performance of a new LLM agent policy purely from pre-collected trajectories. The core idea is to learn a latent diffusion world model that simulates how the environment responds to the evaluation policy, without ever executing it in the real env

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮交互式 LLM agent 在线评测昂贵且有风险的问题，用离线轨迹估计新 agent policy 的表现。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent off-policy evaluation 方法。它不是预训练工作，但触及一个真实痛点：agent policy 迭代不能总依赖在线环境交互，尤其在高成本或高风险场景中。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ADWM，即 Autoregressive Diffusion World Model。方法学习 latent diffusion world model 来模拟环境对 agent 动作的响应；与一次性扩散整条 trajectory 的 OPE 不同，它按 transition 独立 denoise，并让 world model 与 LLM agent 在 rollout 中交替执行，以适配离散文本动作必须由 policy 观测后采样的约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体环境、模型规模、baseline 和数值提升。声称相较普通 autoregressive world model，ADWM 通过每步独立去噪降低 compounding error；相较 joint trajectory diffusion，更适配 LLM agent 的离散文本动作生成过程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses expensive and risky online evaluation of multi-turn LLM agents by estimating a new agent policy’s performance from pre-collected trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an off-policy evaluation method for agents. It is not a pretraining paper, but it targets a real bottleneck: agent policy iteration cannot always rely on live environment interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADWM learns a latent diffusion world model that simulates environment responses to agent actions. Unlike diffusion OPE methods that denoise full trajectories jointly, it denoises each transition independently and alternates between the world model and the LLM agent during rollout, which better matches discrete text actions sampled after observing the environment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete environments, model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims that per-transition denoising reduces compounding errors relative to standard autoregressive world models and handles LLM-agent text actions better than joint trajectory diffusion.

recommendation.zh: agent 离线评测方向值得知道，但摘要缺少实验锚点；先看 OPE setup，数值别急着信。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing for offline agent evaluation, but the abstract lacks experimental anchors; read the OPE setup before trusting the numbers.

paper.title: The Invisible Hand of Physics: When Video Diffusion Models Know More Than They Show
paper.abstract: Modern video diffusion models generate increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, motivating their use as candidate world simulators. Yet it remains unclear whether these models internally encode physical structure, or merely reproduce motion patterns seen during training. We study this question by probing video diffusion models along latent trajectories corresponding to real videos with known physical plausibility. To obtain such trajectories, we approximately invert the determinist

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题很具体：视频扩散模型在生成结果里经常表现出物理错误，但它的内部表征里到底有没有形成可读出的物理知识。难点不在于做一个新的物理 benchmark，而在于如何把“真实视频”送进一个生成式 diffusion/flow 模型的内部轨迹里，因为这类模型通常只暴露从噪声到样本的前向采样过程，不直接提供给定真实视频对应的中间状态。作者解决的是这个可探测性问题：近似反演 deterministic sampling 轨迹，从 clean latent 沿 learned velocity field 反向积分回噪声，恢复一条与真实视频对应的 latent trajectory，再在这条轨迹上分析 transformer block 的隐藏状态、attention 和可解码物理信号。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义，不在视频生成效果本身，而在两个更基础的判断。第一，生成目标即使不是显式的预测式表征学习目标，内部也可能自发形成与物理一致性相关的结构化表示；这对理解 diffusion/flow 类语言建模或多模态生成模型的“内部知道什么”很有参考价值。第二，输出失败不等于内部没有知识，错误可能出在采样轨迹、解码阶段、或局部计算没有把已有信号稳定转化为最终样本。这一点对新型 LM 范式很重要，因为它提醒人们不要只用最终 generation quality 判断模型是否学到某种结构。若把视角放到统一生成模型、world model、甚至 diffusion LM，这篇工作的价值主要在 probing 方法和表示-行为脱钩这个结论，而不是某个具体物理任务分数。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三层。第一层是轨迹恢复。模型采用 flow-matching/ODE 形式的生成过程，作者从真实视频的 VAE latent 出发，沿 learned velocity field 反向积分，近似得到从 data point 回到 noise 的路径。这样每个时间步都能重新跑一遍 backbone，拿到 block-level hidden states 和 attention。作者在附录里讨论了这个近似反演的误差来源与上界，核心前提是 learned dynamics 在局部足够平滑，数值积分误差可控，因此恢复出的中间表示可以作为“模型若把该视频视作自己轨迹的一部分时会如何表示它”的近似。第二层是线性 probing。作者在不同 denoising time、不同 transformer depth 上训练线性 probe，预测视频是否物理 plausible，以及一些定量物理变量。重点不是用大 probe 榨性能，而是看物理信号在何处、何时出现。结果显示，中间层比输入 latent 或最终层更容易线性解码出物理信息，说明信号是在 denoising computation 中逐步形成的。第三层是因果干预。作者做了 block-level noise intervention，把某些层的表示替换、扰动或注入噪声，并定义 probe-surprise 一类指标，观察物理信号在网络中的敏感位置，以及轨迹是否越贴近模型自身连续动力学，物理信号越强。这个设计比纯 probing 多走了一步：它不只问“能不能读出来”，还问“哪些计算部件在承载或放大这个信号”。与 V-JEPA 这类预测式表征学习不同，这里没有显式 future prediction objective；与常见 diffusion interpretability 不同，这里不是分析随机生成样本，而是把真实视频嵌回模型轨迹中研究内部状态。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验主线不是追求大而全 benchmark，而是围绕几个核心现象做验证。第一，作者在具有已知物理可行性标签的真实视频上恢复轨迹，发现物理 plausibility 可以从 diffusion transformer 的中间表示中被线性解码，而且这种可解码性沿深度和时间并不均匀，通常在中间 block、特定噪声区间最强。第二，除了二分类的 plausible/implausible，文中还报告了部分定量物理变量也可被解码，说明模型内部不是只学到一个粗糙的“看起来像不像”信号，而是包含更细的动力学信息。第三，作者比较了不同轨迹条件下的信号强弱，结论是当恢复轨迹更贴近模型 learned continuous dynamics 时，probe 表现更好，支持“物理信息是 denoising dynamics 的副产物”这一解释。第四，干预实验显示，扰动某些 block 会显著削弱物理可解码性或改变生成行为，说明这些层不是被动携带相关性，而更可能参与了物理结构的形成与传递。就你关心的预训练视角，这些实验最值得看的不是绝对数值，而是三种曲线：probe accuracy 随层深变化、随 diffusion time 变化、以及干预前后变化。提供的页面里没有完整表格数字、模型参数量和数据规模细节；从正文语境看，研究对象是现代视频 diffusion transformer，配合 pretrained VAE latent 空间，而不是小型玩具模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认作者真正解决的是“如何在真实视频上恢复 diffusion 内部轨迹”，不是单纯做物理分类。然后看 Method 里 reverse sampling 的定义，重点理解为什么从 clean latent 反向积分可以近似得到可分析轨迹，以及这个近似在哪些条件下可信。接着看 probing 结果图，优先关注不同 block 和不同 time step 的可解码性分布，这决定了“物理信号何时形成”。如果时间有限，干预实验至少看一遍，因为它决定这篇工作是否只是相关性分析。附录里关于 approximation error 的讨论也值得看，尤其如果你关心把类似方法迁移到 diffusion LM、音频生成或 unified multimodal generator。预计 30-45 分钟可以抓住主结论；若要深挖，建议把 reverse ODE reconstruction 与 representation probing 的接口细读一遍，思考它是否能用于分析 AR 之外的新型生成范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharp question: when video diffusion models produce physically wrong videos, do they still encode physically meaningful structure internally? The main obstacle is access. Diffusion or flow-based generators expose trajectories from noise to data, but they do not naturally provide the intermediate states associated with a given real video. The paper tackles this observability problem by approximately inverting the deterministic sampling dynamics: starting from a clean video latent, it integrates the learned velocity field backward toward noise, reconstructing an approximate latent trajectory for a real video. This makes it possible to inspect hidden states and attention maps along the model’s own denoising path.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is less about video generation quality and more about representation formation in non-AR generative models. The central result is that a model can contain decodable physical knowledge even when its final outputs fail to respect that knowledge. That matters for diffusion LM, multimodal generators, and world-model style pretraining, because it separates internal competence from sampled behavior. It also suggests that denoising computation itself can induce structured latent representations, even without an explicit predictive objective such as future-state prediction. For pretraining researchers, the paper is useful as a probing methodology and as evidence that generation objectives may learn richer internal structure than output-only evaluation reveals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three parts. First, trajectory reconstruction. The model is treated as a flow-matching or ODE-based generator with a learned velocity field. Given a real video encoded into the pretrained VAE latent space, the authors integrate the velocity field backward from the clean latent toward noise, producing an approximate reverse trajectory. This allows them to rerun the backbone at each time step and collect block-level hidden states and attention patterns. The appendix discusses approximation error and the conditions under which the recovered trajectory is a faithful proxy. Second, linear probing. They train lightweight probes on intermediate transformer states to predict physical plausibility and some quantitative physical variables. The point is not to maximize probe capacity, but to localize where and when physical information becomes linearly accessible. Third, causal intervention. They perform block-level noise interventions and use a probe-surprise style analysis to identify which components carry or amplify the physical signal. This goes beyond standard probing: it asks not only whether the information is readable, but also whether perturbing specific computations changes the signal and downstream generation. Compared with predictive representation learners such as V-JEPA, the model here is not trained with an explicit future-prediction objective. Compared with standard diffusion interpretability work, the analysis is anchored on real videos embedded back into the model’s trajectory rather than on arbitrary generated samples.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around a few core phenomena rather than a broad benchmark sweep. First, on real videos with known physical plausibility labels, the recovered trajectories show that physical plausibility is linearly decodable from intermediate diffusion-transformer states. The signal is not uniform across the network: it tends to peak at certain depths and noise levels, often in intermediate blocks rather than at the input latent or final layer. Second, the paper reports that some quantitative physical variables are also decodable, which suggests the model is not merely storing a coarse plausible-versus-implausible cue. Third, the strength of the signal depends on trajectory fidelity: when the reconstructed path better follows the model’s learned continuous dynamics, probe performance improves, supporting the claim that physical structure emerges from denoising dynamics. Fourth, intervention experiments show that perturbing specific blocks weakens decodability or changes generation behavior, indicating that these layers are involved in forming and transmitting the signal rather than passively correlating with it. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, model sizes, or training-scale details, but the study is clearly conducted on modern video diffusion transformers operating in a pretrained VAE latent space rather than on toy models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the first method figure. The key contribution is not a new physics benchmark, but a way to recover internal diffusion trajectories for real videos. Then read the reverse-sampling section carefully: the main technical question is why backward integration from a clean latent is a reasonable approximation and what its failure modes are. After that, focus on the probing plots across transformer depth and diffusion time. Those figures tell you where the physical signal emerges.
