If time is limited, still read the intervention section, because it determines whether the paper is only about correlation or says something causal about computation. The appendix on approximation error is worth reading if you are interested in adapting the same idea to diffusion LM, audio generation, or unified multimodal generators. A quick but useful read is about 30 to 45 minutes; a deeper read should center on the interface between reverse ODE reconstruction and representation probing.

recommendation.zh: 把扩散当world model的人该看：反向积分拿到中间态再做线性探针很“干净”，但别被81%冲昏头，先核对反演误差与对照实验是否严谨。
recommendation.en: If you treat diffusion as a world model, read this: backward integration + linear probes is a clean diagnostic, but verify inversion error controls and baselines before trusting the 81% headline.

paper.title: Representation Learning Enables Scalable Multitask Deep Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Scaling reinforcement learning (RL) to diverse multitask settings remains a central challenge. While recent advances in model-based RL achieve strong performance, they rely on planning and complex training pipelines, making it unclear which components are essential for scalability. We revisit this question and argue that the primary driver of scalable multitask RL is not model-based control, but \emph{representation learning}. In particular, we show that combining predictive, model-based represe

summary.core_problem: 在多任务强化学习中，究竟是基于模型的控制（planning）还是表示学习（representation learning）驱动了可扩展性？
summary.importance: 通过解耦模型预测和规划，挑战了基于世界模型的 RL（World Models）必须依赖复杂规划的普遍认知，强调了表示学习的核心作用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个简单的无模型算法 MR.Q，将辅助的预测目标（基于模型的表示）与高容量的价值函数逼近相结合，集成到可扩展的 Actor-Critic 架构中，但不使用规划（planning）。
summary.experiments: 在多任务连续控制套件上，MR.Q 优于最近的基于世界模型的方法和一系列深度 RL 基线，同时显著降低了计算开销并提高了挂钟效率。
summary.authors_note: Mila 和 Google DeepMind 的合作，作者包括 RL 领域的知名学者 Aaron Courville 和 Pablo Samuel Castro。

summary_en.core_problem: In multitask reinforcement learning, is it model-based control (planning) or representation learning that drives scalability?
summary_en.importance: Challenges the prevailing notion that World Model-based RL must rely on complex planning by decoupling model prediction and planning, emphasizing the core role of representation learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a simple model-free algorithm, MR.Q, which combines auxiliary predictive objectives (model-based representations) with high-capacity value function approximation into a scalable actor-critic architecture, without using planning.
summary_en.experiments: On a diverse suite of multitask continuous control tasks, MR.Q outperforms a recent world-model-based method and a range of deep RL baselines, while significantly reducing computational overhead and improving wall-clock efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Mila and Google DeepMind, with authors including prominent RL researchers Aaron Courville and Pablo Samuel Castro.

recommendation.zh: 解耦了 World Model 中的表示学习和 Planning，结论是表示学习才是 scaling 的关键，对理解 RL 预训练的机制有启发，但非 LLM 核心。
recommendation.en: Decouples representation learning and planning in World Models, concluding that representation learning is key to scaling; insightful for RL pretraining mechanisms, though not core LLM.

paper.title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
paper.abstract: World models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide complementary capabilities for predicting future outcomes from static visual observations. World models can generate concrete visual rollouts of possible futures, while MLLMs can reason abstractly over questions, goals, and rules. However, generated rollouts are stochastic and may be visually plausible but task-incorrect, making it necessary to determine when visual simulation is useful, whether a rollout is credible, and how it s

summary.core_problem: 如何让多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 学会判断何时调用世界模型进行视觉模拟，并验证和整合模拟结果以辅助抽象推理？
summary.importance: 探讨了世界模型（具体视觉模拟）与 MLLM（抽象推理）的互补性，提出了受控的具体推理范式，并构建了相关 Benchmark 和训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 将问题形式化为受控的具体推理，模型需要学会调用、验证和整合视觉未来模拟。提出了特权未来同策略自蒸馏 (PF-OPSD) 方法，在训练期间利用真实的未来视频作为特权信息指导模型学习。
summary.experiments: 构建了两个人类验证的 Benchmark：VRQABench（可控空间前瞻）和 OpenWorldQA（开放域物理预测）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自澳门大学等机构，关注多模态推理和世界模型。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to learn when to invoke world models for visual simulation, and how to verify and integrate the simulation results to aid abstract reasoning?
summary_en.importance: Explores the complementarity between world models (concrete visual simulation) and MLLMs (abstract reasoning), proposes a controlled concrete reasoning paradigm, and constructs related benchmarks and training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates the problem as controlled concrete reasoning, where the model learns to invoke, verify, and integrate visual future simulations. Proposes Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD), which uses ground-truth future videos as privileged information during training to guide the model.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs two human-verified benchmarks: VRQABench for controllable spatial lookahead and OpenWorldQA for open-domain physical prediction.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from the University of Macau and other institutions, focusing on multimodal reasoning and world models.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了 MLLM 与 World Model 结合的范式，通过自蒸馏让模型学会何时调用和信任视觉模拟，对探索多模态 System 2 推理有启发，值得看其训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Explores the paradigm of combining MLLMs with World Models, using self-distillation to teach models when to invoke and trust visual simulations; inspiring for exploring multimodal System 2 reasoning, worth checking the training recipe.

paper.title: A Close Look At World Model Recovery In Supervised Fine-Tuned LLM Planners
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves end-to-end classical planning in large language models (LLMs), but do these models also learn to represent and reason about the planning problems they are solving? Due to the relative complexity of classical planning problems and the challenge that end-to-end plan generation poses for LLMs, it has been difficult to explore this question. In our work, we devise and perform a series of interpretability experiments that holistically interrogate world model reco

summary.core_problem: 监督微调（SFT）能提升 LLM 在经典规划任务中的端到端表现，但模型是否真正学习并表征了规划问题的世界模型（world model）仍不清楚。
summary.importance: 通过可解释性实验，深入探究了 SFT 对 LLM 内部表征和生成能力的影响，为理解 LLM 在规划任务中的内部机制提供了实证依据，有助于指导更有效的微调策略。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了一个框架，从内部表征质量和生成模型视角量化世界模型恢复程度。1) 内部表征：在微调后 LLM 的隐藏状态上训练线性探针，预测状态谓词的真值和中间步骤动作的有效性；2) 生成能力：采用指标，通过生成的 token 概率对有效和无效动作进行分类。实验在两个经典规划环境中进行，对比了三种不同数据分布的微调效果，并探索了类似思维链（CoT）的微调技术（在动作之间生成中间状态）。
summary.experiments: 发现：1) 仅在有效动作序列上进行 SFT，就足以让 LLM 学习到线性编码动作有效性和部分状态谓词的内部表征；2) 即使模型难以利用预测概率区分有效和无效动作，其内部表征可能仍具备这种区分能力；3) 在具有良好状态空间覆盖率（如随机游走生成）的规划数据上进行微调，通常能实现更好的分布内和分布外世界模型恢复。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读实验设计部分（如何定义和量化世界模型恢复）以及结果分析（特别是内部表征与生成概率之间的差异）。不同数据分布对微调效果的影响也值得关注。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves end-to-end performance of LLMs in classical planning tasks, but it remains unclear whether the models truly learn and represent the world model of the planning problems.
summary_en.importance: Through interpretability experiments, this paper deeply investigates the impact of SFT on the internal representations and generative capabilities of LLMs, providing empirical evidence for understanding the internal mechanisms of LLMs in planning tasks and guiding more effective fine-tuning strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a framework to quantify world model recovery from the perspectives of internal representation quality and generative models. 1) Internal representation: Trains linear probes on the hidden states of fine-tuned LLMs to predict the truth values of state predicates and the validity of actions at intermediate steps; 2) Generative capability: Adopts a metric to classify valid and invalid actions using generated token probabilities. Experiments are conducted in two classical planning environments, comparing the fine-tuning effects of three different data distributions and exploring a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) style fine-tuning technique (generating intermediate states between actions).
summary_en.experiments: Findings: 1) SFT directly on sequences of valid actions is sufficient for LLMs to learn internal representations that linearly encode action validity and some state predicates; 2) Even if models struggle to use predicted probabilities to distinguish between valid and invalid actions, their internal representations may still possess this capability; 3) Fine-tuning on planning data with good state space coverage (e.g., generated by random walks) generally achieves better in-distribution and out-of-distribution world model recovery.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental design (how world model recovery is defined and quantified) and the result analysis (especially the discrepancy between internal representations and generation probabilities). The impact of different data distributions on fine-tuning effects is also noteworthy. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探究 SFT 模型是否真正学到了世界模型，发现内部表示（线性探针可分）与输出概率（生成能力）之间存在脱节，对理解 LLM 的 reasoning 机制有帮助。
recommendation.en: Investigates whether SFT models truly learn world models, finding a disconnect between internal representations (linearly separable) and output probabilities (generative capabilities), helpful for understanding LLM reasoning mechanisms.

paper.title: Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning
paper.abstract: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its d

summary.core_problem: 自动驾驶中的离散视觉 tokenizer 通常继承自图像生成任务，主要优化像素重建，导致生成的 token 难以直接用于下游的规划和决策任务（存在“易生成”与“易解码”之间的 gap）。
summary.importance: 提出了一种面向自动驾驶的统一离散 token 学习框架，将 token 视为自动驾驶世界的“离散语言”，不仅服务于世界模型的生成，还直接作为规划模块的输入，为端到端自动驾驶的预训练表示提供了一种新范式。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了一个表征引导且几何增强的 VQ tokenizer。编码端以冻结的 DINO 特征为主输入（捕获语义），并引入显式细节分支（恢复纹理和边界）。解码端联合重建 RGB 和 DINO 特征，使 token 逼近强语义表征同时保持生成外观。为了注入规划所需的几何状态线索，在训练中加入相邻帧深度和相对位姿监督。采用多码本量化缓解联合监督下的容量瓶颈并稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 在匹配设置下，将学习到的离散 token 插入轻量级规划器和自回归 next-token Transformer 世界模型中，相比代表性基线，在规划指标和生成质量上均有提升（具体数字需参考原论文完整实验部分）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注 Method 部分关于 tokenizer 架构的设计（特别是 DINO 特征融合和几何监督的加入方式），以及实验部分规划与生成任务的对比结果。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete visual tokenizers in autonomous driving are typically inherited from image generation tasks, optimizing primarily for pixel reconstruction, which creates a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for downstream planning and decision-making.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified discrete token learning framework for autonomous driving, treating tokens as the 'discrete language' of the driving world that serves both world model generation and direct consumption by planning modules, offering a new paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving pre-training representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced VQ tokenizer. The encoder uses frozen DINO features as the primary input (for semantics) and introduces an explicit detail branch (to recover textures and boundaries). The decoder jointly reconstructs RGB and DINO features, aligning tokens with strong semantic representations while preserving generative appearance. To inject geometric state cues for planning, adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision are added during training. Multi-codebook quantization is adopted to alleviate capacity bottlenecks and stabilize training under joint supervision.
summary_en.experiments: By plugging the learned discrete tokens into a lightweight planner and an autoregressive next-token Transformer world model under matched settings, the method improves both planning metrics and generation quality compared to representative baselines (specific numbers require referencing the full experimental section of the original paper).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim guide: Focus on the Method section regarding the tokenizer architecture design (especially the fusion of DINO features and the addition of geometric supervision), and the experimental comparison results for planning and generation tasks. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了视觉 Tokenizer 在特定领域（自动驾驶）中超越单纯像素重建的需求，结合语义和几何特征的思路对 VLM 预训练中的视觉 Tokenizer 设计有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Explores the need for visual tokenizers to go beyond mere pixel reconstruction in specific domains (autonomous driving); the idea of combining semantic and geometric features offers reference value for visual tokenizer design in VLM pretraining.

paper.title: From Human Videos to Robot Manipulation: A Survey on Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning with Human-Centric Data
paper.abstract: Recent progress in generalizable embodied control has been driven by large-scale pretraining of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, most existing approaches rely on large collections of robot demonstrations, which are costly to obtain and tightly coupled to specific embodiments. Human videos, by contrast, are abundant and capture rich interactions, providing diverse semantic and physical cues for real-world manipulation. Yet, embodiment differences and the frequent absence of task-alig

summary.core_problem: 如何把海量人类视频转化为可用于 Vision-Language-Action（VLA）模型的训练信号，以减少对昂贵机器人示教数据的依赖。
summary.importance: 综述型贡献：系统梳理“人类视频→动作/控制知识”的几条技术路线；对做多模态统一预训练/视频表征学习的人有参考，但不是新的预训练范式或关键实证结论。
summary.technical_approach: 按从人类视频中提取的动作相关信息将方法分四类：潜在动作表征（帧间变化编码）、预测式世界模型（预测未来帧）、显式 2D 监督（图像平面线索）、显式 3D 重建（几何/姿态等）；讨论 embodiment gap 与缺少任务标注带来的挑战。
summary.experiments: 综述论文通常不提供统一可复现的大规模对比实验；摘要未给出新的 benchmark 或统一评测协议。
summary.authors_note: Tsinghua University, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Fudan University, Microsoft Research Asia, Peking University

summary_en.core_problem: How to convert abundant human videos into effective training signals for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, reducing reliance on costly robot demonstrations.
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution: organizes the design space of extracting action/control knowledge from human videos; useful background for multimodal pretraining and video representation, but not a new pretraining paradigm or a decisive empirical result.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes approaches into four groups by the action-related information derived: latent action representations, predictive world models, explicit 2D supervision, and explicit 3D reconstruction; discusses embodiment gaps and missing task-aligned annotations.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it likely lacks a unified large-scale head-to-head experimental protocol; the abstract does not indicate a new benchmark or standardized evaluation suite.
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Fudan University, Microsoft Research Asia, Peking University

recommendation.zh: 当索引读：把“人类视频怎么变成动作监督”分门别类讲清楚；别指望有干净对比或可直接迁移到 LM 预训练的 recipe。
recommendation.en: Use it as an index: it cleanly maps how human videos become action supervision; don’t expect clean ablations or a recipe you can directly port to LM pretraining.

paper.title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
paper.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics by predicting how robot actions affect the surrounding scene. However, the rollout inference remains computationally expensive in pixel space, as long-horizon manipulation videos typically have to be generated frame by frame. This cost cannot be easily reduced by indiscriminately dropping frames, since downstream policies rely on complete preservation of sparse task-relevant events such as approach, contact, grasp, and releas

summary.core_problem: 如何降低具身世界模型（Embodied World Models）在像素空间进行长视野操作视频逐帧生成的计算成本，同时保留关键任务事件？
summary.importance: 提出了一种稀疏到密集的视频生成框架，在提高具身世界模型推理效率的同时，保证了下游策略所需的关键事件（如接触、抓取）不丢失。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SKIP (Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm)。首先利用机器人感知的多模态特征识别任务相关的关键帧；然后使用稀疏视频扩散模型仅合成这些关键帧；最后，通过学习到的间隙预测器和以动作为条件的插值器，根据机器人动作重建缺失的间隔。
summary.experiments: 在 LIBERO 等数据集上进行了评估（摘要未详述具体指标，但强调了效率和事件保留）。
summary.authors_note: 北京大学、北京通用人工智能研究院（BIGAI）等机构合作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reduce the computational cost of frame-by-frame generation for long-horizon manipulation videos in pixel space for Embodied World Models, while preserving key task events?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a sparse-to-dense video generation framework that improves the inference efficiency of embodied world models while ensuring that key events (e.g., contact, grasp) required by downstream policies are not lost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SKIP (Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm). It first identifies task-relevant keyframes using robot-aware multimodal features. Then, it synthesizes only these keyframes with a sparse video diffusion model. Finally, a learned gap predictor and an action-conditioned interpolator reconstruct the missing intervals based on robot actions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on datasets like LIBERO (specific metrics not detailed in abstract, but emphasizes efficiency and event preservation).
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Peking University, Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence (BIGAI), etc.

recommendation.zh: 具身智能领域的视频生成/插帧优化，核心是解决长视频生成的效率问题，对通用多模态预训练（如 Sora 类模型）的架构设计有微弱的借鉴意义。
recommendation.en: Video generation/interpolation optimization in embodied AI, focusing on the efficiency of long video generation. It has weak reference value for the architecture design of general multimodal pre-training (like Sora-class models).

institutions: Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence (BIGAI)

paper.title: Domain Adaptation and Reasoning Frameworks in Language Models: A Controlled Experiment with Historical Cosmology
paper.abstract: We investigate how domain adaptation reshapes explanatory behavior in language models using historical cosmology as a controlled setting. In Phase 1, we train a small language model from scratch on a pre-Copernican corpus from which explicit heliocentric references were removed, and evaluate whether Earth-motion or heliocentric continuations nevertheless emerge. In Phase 2, we fine-tune a larger pretrained model using QLoRA on the same corpus in order to study how adaptation modifies explanatory

summary.core_problem: 用历史宇宙论作为受控场景，研究领域适配如何改变语言模型的解释框架和世界观式输出。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个小规模机制分析实验：通过删除显式 heliocentric references 的 pre-Copernican corpus，观察模型是否仍会产生地动或日心相关延续，并比较从零训练与 QLoRA 微调的行为差异。
summary.technical_approach: Phase 1 从零训练小语言模型，训练语料为去除了显式日心引用的前哥白尼文本；Phase 2 用同一语料对较大 pretrained model 做 QLoRA fine-tuning。输出由 LLM-as-judge 标注 cosmological stance 和 explanatory frame。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、语料 token 数和 judge 校准细节。结果称小模型偶尔生成局部 Earth-motion continuations，但整体不稳定，不能支撑一致的宇宙论推理；QLoRA 微调会显著改变较大模型的解释 framing 和 cosmological stance。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses historical cosmology as a controlled setting to study how domain adaptation changes a language model’s explanatory framing and stance-like outputs.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a small mechanistic analysis experiment. By removing explicit heliocentric references from a pre-Copernican corpus, it tests whether models still produce Earth-motion or heliocentric continuations, and contrasts training from scratch with QLoRA adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Phase 1 trains small language models from scratch on the edited pre-Copernican corpus. Phase 2 fine-tunes a larger pretrained model on the same corpus with QLoRA. Outputs are labeled by an LLM-as-judge for cosmological stance and explanatory frame.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, token count, or judge calibration details. It reports that small models occasionally produce local Earth-motion continuations but fail to form stable global cosmological reasoning, while QLoRA adaptation significantly shifts the larger model’s framing and stance.

recommendation.zh: 有趣但很窄；作为 domain adaptation 改写解释框架的案例看摘要即可，LLM judge 让结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Interesting but narrow; treat it as a domain-adaptation case study, with the LLM-judge setup making the conclusions weak evidence.

paper.title: Subspace-Decomposed JEPAs: Disentangling Progression and Content in Latent World Models
paper.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models by predicting future embeddings, but no single coordinate of the latent is designated to encode task progression. We carve the JEPA latent into two orthogonal subspaces with disjoint roles: a low-dimensional progression subspace shaped by a cosine-margin triplet loss, and a high-dimensional content subspace regularised by the existing SIGReg objective of LeWM. We prove that the two anti-collapse forces act on disj

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是 JEPA latent 缺少显式“进度”坐标的问题。LeWM 这类端到端像素 JEPA 能用 latent dynamics 做规划，但 latent 主要由下一步 embedding 预测和边缘分布正则塑形，没有一个维度或子空间专门表达任务推进到哪里。作者想验证：能否在不破坏 SIGReg 防坍缩机制的前提下，把 latent 拆出一个低维 progression subspace，并让它承担时间顺序和任务进度信息。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性不强，但对“预测式表征学习”和 latent world model 有参考价值。最有用的点不是控制任务结果，而是目标函数之间的可组合性分析：一个子空间用样本级 temporal contrastive/triplet 约束，另一个子空间用维度级边缘分布正则约束，二者通过坐标拆分避免梯度互相争抢。这类设计对多目标预训练也有启发，尤其是当一个 latent 需要同时服务可预测性、可规划性和可解释进度变量时。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 SD-JEPA。它继承 LeWM 的 encoder-predictor 框架，把 encoder 输出 z 拆成低维 z_prog 和高维 z_cont。z_cont 继续承接 LeWM 的预测 MSE 和 SIGReg，用于保持内容表征和边缘分布的非坍缩；z_prog 用 cosine-margin triplet loss 约束，让时间相近的帧在该子空间更接近，时间相远的帧更远，从而形成平滑的进度几何结构。作者强调两类 anti-collapse force 作用在不相交坐标上，因此梯度支持也不相交，组合时是加性关系，而不是在同一批维度上竞争。规划阶段也做了对应拆分：content cost 使用 z_cont 的 MSE，progression 部分可加入 z_prog 的 angular cost。对于二维 progression subspace，作者用 atan2 得到角度 θ_t，把它解释为 scene-aware compass：能追踪任务推进，也能在任务真正回退时回退。
summary.experiments: 实验规模沿用 LeWM 设置，约 15M 参数，可在单 GPU 训练，并在 matched compute 下比较 SD-JEPA 和 LeWM。根据给出的全文片段，SD-JEPA 在多数控制 benchmark 上持平或优于 LeWM，但未提供具体任务表和逐项数字。较有信息量的是 subspace-ablation falsifier：通过分别消融 progression/content 子空间，验证进度信号确实集中在 z_prog，而内容和预测相关信息主要由 z_cont 承担。作者还分析 θ_t 在扰动下的行为：它能区分“惊讶发生的时刻”和扰动后重新定位到任务进度的位置，这说明该坐标不是简单的时间戳，而是依赖场景状态的进度变量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟。建议重点看方法部分的 latent split、triplet loss 与 SIGReg 的组合方式，以及关于 disjoint gradient support 的证明。实验部分优先看 subspace ablation 和 θ_t 可视化，而不是只看控制任务平均分。真正值得深挖的是目标函数设计：为什么把 progression 和 content 分到不同坐标，比在同一 latent 上叠加 triplet/SIGReg 更稳。若关注语言模型预训练，可把它当作多目标表征学习的一个小型案例，而不是通用 LM 训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a representation issue in JEPA-style latent world models: the latent state can support prediction and planning, but it does not reserve any coordinate system for task progression. In LeWM, the latent is shaped by next-embedding prediction and SIGReg on the marginal distribution. SD-JEPA asks whether a low-dimensional progression subspace can be added without weakening the anti-collapse behavior of SIGReg.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not directly about language-model pretraining, but it is relevant to predictive representation learning and latent world models. The useful lesson is about composing objectives. Instead of applying several regularizers to the same coordinates, the method assigns temporal ordering and content preservation to separate subspaces. This is a clean design pattern for multi-objective pretraining when one latent space must carry both predictive content and an interpretable control variable.
summary_en.technical_approach: SD-JEPA extends the LeWM encoder-predictor setup by splitting the latent vector into z_prog and z_cont. The content subspace keeps the LeWM-style prediction loss and SIGReg, which regularizes the marginal latent distribution toward an isotropic Gaussian. The progression subspace is trained with a cosine-margin triplet loss: temporally nearby frames are pulled together, while distant frames are pushed apart. The paper argues that the two anti-collapse mechanisms act on disjoint coordinates, so their gradients do not compete over the same dimensions. For planning, the cost is also decomposed into a content MSE term and an optional angular progression term. In the two-dimensional progression case, atan2 gives an angle θ_t, interpreted as a scene-aware progress compass rather than a raw timestamp.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments follow the LeWM control setting, using a roughly 15M-parameter model trainable on a single GPU. Under matched compute, SD-JEPA reportedly matches or improves over LeWM on most control benchmarks, although the provided text does not include the full benchmark table. The more informative evidence is the subspace-ablation falsifier, which checks whether progression information is actually concentrated in z_prog while content remains in z_cont. The analysis of θ_t under perturbations is also important: the progression coordinate can regress when the task state regresses and can separate the moment of surprise from subsequent re-localization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20-30 minutes. Focus on the latent decomposition, the triplet/SIGReg objective combination, and the proof sketch for disjoint gradient support. In the experiments, prioritize the subspace ablations and θ_t visualizations over aggregate control scores. The main point to extract is why separating progression and content coordinates is preferable to stacking all losses on a single shared latent.

recommendation.zh: 对 JEPA 潜在空间的结构化改进，通过正交子空间解耦 content 和 progression，对于研究基于 JEPA 的世界模型或表征学习有一定启发。
recommendation.en: A structural improvement to the JEPA latent space, disentangling content and progression via orthogonal subspaces; offers some inspiration for research on JEPA-based world models or representation learning.

paper.title: DecMem: Towards Minute-Long Consistent World Generation with Decoupled Memory
paper.abstract: Recent advances in video generative models have promoted rapid progress in controllable world models. However, maintaining fine-grained spatio-temporal consistency under long-horizon reasoning remains a key challenge. In this work, we move beyond explicit 3D memory and coarse frame-level implicit modeling, and propose a fine-grained, learnable, and scalable memory for consistent world generation. We first identify two fundamental limitations of naïve learnable memory architectures in long-horizo

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频/世界生成中分钟级外推时的细粒度时空一致性问题，尤其是历史信息如何被稳定、低成本地访问。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成架构创新。它不直接推进文本 LLM 预训练，但对长时程生成模型中的记忆组织、注意力稀释和历史状态压缩有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DecMem，将可学习记忆拆成 Sparse Global Memory 和 Anchored Local Memory：前者用于高效访问全局历史，后者用于稳定局部外推和保持画质。论文先分析朴素可学习记忆在长程外推中的两个问题：计算低效和 attention dispersion，再用解耦记忆结构处理二者的冲突。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在一致性世界生成任务上进行广泛实验，并显著超过当前方法；未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量、基线名称和提升幅度。实验重点应是分钟级生成的一致性、质量和推理效率。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港大学、快手 Kling Team 和 Kuaishou Technology；Kling 团队长期做视频生成系统，Xintao Wang 和 Kwan-Yee K. Wong 在视觉生成与底层视觉方向较有代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets fine-grained spatiotemporal consistency in minute-long world generation, focusing on how long histories can be accessed stably and efficiently.
summary_en.importance: This is an architectural contribution for multimodal generation rather than LLM pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is the treatment of long-horizon memory, attention dilution, and state compression in generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: DecMem decouples learnable memory into Sparse Global Memory for efficient fine-grained access to global history and Anchored Local Memory for stable local extrapolation and visual quality. The design is motivated by an analysis of two failure modes in naive learnable memory: computational inefficiency and attention dispersion.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments and significant gains over current methods for consistent world generation, but does not provide model scale, data scale, baseline names, or exact margins. The likely evaluation axes are long-horizon consistency, generation quality, and efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The University of Hong Kong, the Kling Team, and Kuaishou Technology. The Kling team is known for video generation systems; Xintao Wang and Kwan-Yee K. Wong are recognizable names in visual generation and vision research.

recommendation.zh: 不必读全篇；如果在做长上下文多模态生成，只看 attention dispersion 分析和 DecMem 的全局/局部拆分。
recommendation.en: Do not read it end to end; if you work on long-context multimodal generation, inspect the attention-dispersion analysis and the global/local memory split.

paper.title: Theoretical Foundations and Effective Algorithms for Policy-Aware Simulator Learning
paper.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) agents typically learn world models by minimizing predictive loss. However, powerful RL optimizers inevitably exploit minor model inaccuracies, leading to simulator exploitation and a reality gap where policies succeed in simulation but fail in the real world. We propose that the objective for learning simulators should be strategic robustness rather than predictive accuracy, and formulate this as a zero-sum minimax game between a model player and an adv

summary.core_problem: 解决模型式强化学习里“预测误差很小但策略仍会利用模拟器漏洞”的问题，即如何让 learned simulator 对策略优化具有战略鲁棒性而不只是拟合观测。
summary.importance: 贡献偏理论与算法：把 simulator learning 从预测损失最小化改写成模型与对抗策略之间的零和博弈，并给出 regret、critic 近似和 Error-MDP 对偶分析。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对 world model、agent training、reward hacking 与 simulator exploitation 的理解有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是把模拟器学习目标定义为最坏策略下的价值差最小化，而非一步预测误差最小化。作者给出三层结果：在线学习视角下的可学习性与次线性遗憾界；用局部 critic loss 上界全局 policy-value gap 的可 tractable 简化；以及 Error-MDP duality，把寻找最坏策略转化为以一步 critic error 为奖励的标准 RL 问题，并据此设计主动数据选择算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论保证和可证明收敛的主动采样算法，但未给出具体环境、模型规模、baseline 或数值提升。按题目与摘要判断，实验更像验证理论趋势，而不是大规模经验研究。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mehryar Mohri、Yishay Mansour，均是统计学习理论与强化学习方向的资深研究者；论文气质明显偏理论。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the classic failure mode in model-based RL where a simulator with low predictive error is still exploitable by a strong policy optimizer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly theoretical and algorithmic: simulator learning is reframed as a zero-sum game between the model and an adversarial policy, with regret guarantees, critic-based simplification, and an Error-MDP duality. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to world models, agent training, reward hacking, and simulator exploitation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key move is to optimize simulators for worst-case strategic robustness rather than one-step prediction accuracy. The paper provides three pieces: learnability with sublinear regret in an online-learning formulation; a tractable critic-based bound connecting local critic loss to global policy-value gap; and an Error-MDP duality that turns worst-case policy search into a standard RL problem with one-step critic error as reward, enabling a provably convergent active data selection algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory and a provably convergent active sampling method, but does not report concrete environments, model sizes, baselines, or empirical gains. The empirical section is likely supportive rather than the main contribution.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Mehryar Mohri and Yishay Mansour, both well-known senior researchers in learning theory and RL; the paper is clearly theory-driven.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接相连，但它把“拟合好不等于不可被 exploit”讲得很干净；若你关心 world model 或 RL 训练信号污染，只看理论主张和 Error-MDP 对偶即可。
recommendation.en: Not directly an LLM paper, but it cleanly formalizes why good prediction does not imply robustness to exploitation; read the Error-MDP duality if you care about world models or RL signal hacking.

paper.title: Emergent Semantic Representations in World Models through Physical Interaction without Linguistic Supervision
paper.abstract: What does a world model learn from physical exploration, without any linguistic supervision? We argue the answer is organized by a single principle: the geometric structure of the physical world. Training a VAE-based world model on random embodied exploration, we find that its latent space develops spatial semantic structure that mirrors physical geometry -- direction accuracy 0.677+-0.029 versus 0.547 for a randomly initialized encoder, and position RSA 0.192+-0.047 versus 0.029 for random enco

summary.core_problem: 探索世界模型在没有任何语言监督的情况下，仅通过物理随机探索，能否在潜空间中自发涌现出空间语义结构（如方向和位置）。
summary.importance: 为“具身经验先于语言”的认知发展理论提供了计算证据，表明物理几何结构是组织世界模型表征的核心驱动力，对理解多模态预训练中视觉与语言的对齐机制有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在简单的网格世界（MiniGrid）中，训练一个基于 VAE 的世界模型（包含图像编码器和转移模型）。智能体执行纯随机策略收集数据。通过表征相似度分析（RSA）和线性探测（Linear Probing），评估潜空间表征与物理空间几何结构（方向、位置）的对齐程度。通过调整 KL 散度权重（β）进行双重敲除实验，验证预测性能与语义对齐的共同驱动机制。
summary.experiments: 物理训练使潜空间的 RSA 得分比随机初始化编码器高 6.6 倍（0.192 vs 0.029）。线性探测显示方向准确率达到 0.677。预测损失与语义对齐在训练过程中协同改善（r = -0.61）。当 KL 权重过大导致后验坍塌时，预测性能和语义对齐同时崩溃，证实了两者共享几何驱动机制。位置结构的涌现早于方向结构。
summary.reading_guide: 建议关注 Method 部分的实验设计（特别是 RSA 的计算方式）以及双重敲除实验的逻辑。预计阅读时间 10 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates whether a world model can spontaneously develop spatial semantic structure (direction and position) in its latent space purely through physical random exploration, without any linguistic supervision.
summary_en.importance: Provides computational evidence for the developmental theory that grounded experience precedes language. It highlights physical geometry as a core organizing principle for world model representations, offering insights into the alignment mechanisms in multimodal pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a VAE-based world model (image encoder + transition model) in a simple grid world (MiniGrid) using a purely random exploration policy. Evaluates the alignment between latent representations and physical geometry using Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) and linear probing. Conducts a double-knockout experiment by tuning the KL divergence weight (β) to verify the shared driver mechanism between prediction performance and semantic alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Physical training increases the RSA score by 6.6x compared to a random encoder (0.192 vs 0.029). Linear probing achieves 0.677 accuracy for direction. Prediction loss and semantic alignment co-improve during training (r = -0.61). When a high KL weight induces posterior collapse, both prediction and semantics fail simultaneously, confirming the shared geometric driver. Spatial structure emerges before directional structure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental design in the Method section (especially the RSA computation) and the logic behind the double-knockout experiment. Estimated reading time: 10 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关于世界模型表征学习的机制分析，验证了预测目标能自发促成几何结构的涌现，对理解多模态预训练的表征有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Mechanism analysis on representation learning in world models, verifying that prediction objectives spontaneously foster the emergence of geometric structures, offering some inspiration for understanding representations in multimodal pre-training.

paper.title: What-If World: A Causal Benchmark for General World Models in Embodied Scenarios
paper.abstract: Video generation models are increasingly used as world simulators for tasks like driving and robotic manipulation. What matters in these settings is not whether a single video looks right, but whether the model's output changes when its input changes. We test this by giving a model two prompts describing the same scene with one physical detail varied, and checking whether the two videos diverge the way physics predicts. The wording difference between the prompts is small by design, since only on

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注一个现有视频世界模型评测几乎没有正面测到的问题：模型是否会随着输入中的受控物理变量变化而产生相应变化。现有 benchmark 往往逐条视频独立打分，只检查单个输出是否“看起来合理”，却无法发现一种更关键的失败模式——两条只改了一个物理条件的 prompt，模型却生成几乎一样的视频。对于自动驾驶、机器人操作、基于模型的规划和策略训练，这种 failure 比单视频不够真实更严重，因为它意味着模型没有学到可操控、可比较的因果响应。
summary.importance: 对预训练和统一世界模型研究的启发比较直接。它把“世界模型好不好”从视觉逼真度转向因果敏感性，尤其是对 intervention 的差分响应。这会影响未来视频生成或 action-conditioned world model 的训练目标、数据构造和评测协议：如果训练只优化单样本 realism，很可能学到的是视觉模板，而不是可用于规划的动力学响应。贡献量级属于中等：它不是新架构，但 benchmark 设计抓住了一个被主流评测忽略的核心能力，而且实验显示现有强模型在这一点上普遍偏弱。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由 benchmark 构建和 paired evaluation 两部分组成。第一部分是 What-If World 数据集。作者先定义什么样的物理干预变量适合做对比测试，并由两位领域专家在真实视频上筛选与归并，最后得到横跨自动驾驶和机械臂操作的六类 primitive：环境相关包括 surface friction、material/medium、obstacle configuration，动作相关包括 spatial alignment、force/degree、temporal sequencing。每个测试样本不是单 prompt，而是一个 paired triplet：同一初始帧 x0，加上一对只在一个语义变量上不同的 prompt。构建流程分三步：从 nuScenes 或 DROID 过滤出满足条件的真实片段；抽取动作开始前一帧并配上共享的场景描述；再人工写出只改一个干预变量的 prompt pair。这样做的目的，是尽量用文本设计近似 ceteris paribus，让输出差异能归因到该干预。第二部分是 APEO 评测框架。它把 paired generation 的好坏拆成四项：Adherence，干预是否被执行；Physics，动力学是否合理；Environment，非干预场景是否保持稳定；Outcome，成对输出是否按预期发生差异。前三项既看单视频也看成对视频，Outcome 只在 paired 模式下定义。这个拆分很有用，因为它能区分“没执行干预”“执行了但没拉开差异”“差异来自场景漂移”三种不同失败。评测实现依赖 VLM judge，并用人工标注做了验证。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个当前视频生成世界模型，其中 4 个开源、5 个闭源。最关键的结果有三点。第一，没有模型在 paired metric 上超过 52%，4 个开源模型集中在约 28% 左右，说明因果敏感性远未过关。第二，单视频评测与 paired 评测之间存在明显落差，作者把它称为 contrastive bottleneck：模型能分别生成两条看起来都合理的视频，但无法让它们按输入差异正确分化。第三，模型表现更像依赖“后果是否显眼”，而不是稳定掌握物理机制。比如 Force/Degree 这类会带来明显运动差异的干预，得分可到 40.4%；而 Surface Friction 这类只带来细微轨迹变化的干预，得分只有 14.2%。数据规模方面，benchmark 含 319 个 paired triplets，来源于 nuScenes 和 DROID 两个真实 embodied 场景数据源。就诊断价值而言，这些数字已经足够说明：现有模型在单样本 realism 上的进步，并没有自动转化为可用于控制和规划的差分物理建模能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，作者对 failure mode 的定义很清楚，能迅速理解为什么单视频 benchmark 不够。然后看 benchmark construction，重点是六类 intervention primitive 的定义标准，以及 prompt pair 如何保证只改一个变量。接着看 APEO 评测协议，尤其是 Adherence / Physics / Environment / Outcome 四项如何区分不同错误来源。最后看主结果表和按 primitive 分解的结果，那里最能体现 contrastive bottleneck。若只花 25 分钟，建议看图示样例、taxonomy、APEO 定义和主表；若要判断它是否能指导训练目标设计，再细读 human validation 和 failure case 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode that current video world-model benchmarks mostly miss: whether the model’s output changes appropriately when a controlled physical variable in the input changes. Existing benchmarks score videos one by one and ask whether each sample looks plausible in isolation. That misses the more consequential error: two prompts differ in exactly one physical condition, yet the model produces nearly the same video for both. For driving, robotics, model-based planning, and policy training, this is more damaging than imperfect realism, because it means the model is not controllably responsive to interventions.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining and world-model research is fairly direct. The paper shifts the evaluation target from visual realism to causal sensitivity, especially differential response to interventions. That has implications for training objectives, data construction, and evaluation protocols for video generation and action-conditioned world models. If training only rewards single-sample realism, models may learn visual templates rather than dynamics that are useful for planning. The contribution is moderate but solid: no new architecture, but a benchmark that isolates a capability current evaluation largely ignores, and empirical evidence that many strong models remain weak on it.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts: benchmark construction and paired evaluation. First, What-If World builds a contrastive benchmark around physically meaningful interventions. Two domain experts define and merge intervention variables into six primitives spanning autonomous driving and robotic manipulation. Environment-side primitives include surface friction, material/medium, and obstacle configuration. Agent-side primitives include spatial alignment, force/degree, and temporal sequencing. Each test case is a paired triplet: the same initial frame x0 plus two prompts that differ in exactly one semantic variable. Construction proceeds in three steps: filter suitable clips from nuScenes or DROID; extract the frame right before the action starts and pair it with shared scene descriptors; then author a prompt pair that changes only the intervention variable. The goal is to approximate ceteris paribus through prompt design so that output differences can be attributed to the intervention. Second, the APEO evaluation framework decomposes success into four criteria: Adherence, whether the intervention was executed; Physics, whether the dynamics are valid; Environment, whether the non-intervened scene stays stable; and Outcome, whether the paired outputs diverge as the intervention predicts. The first three are scored in both single-video and paired modes, while Outcome is inherently paired-only. This decomposition is useful because it separates different failure modes: the intervention may be ignored, executed without sufficient divergence, or confounded by scene drift. The implementation uses a VLM judge validated against human annotation.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is applied to nine state-of-the-art video generation world models, including four open-source and five closed-source systems. Three results stand out. First, no model exceeds 52% on the paired metric, and the four open-source models cluster around 28%, indicating that causal sensitivity is still weak. Second, there is a substantial gap between single-video scores and paired scores, which the authors call the contrastive bottleneck: models can generate two individually convincing videos while still failing to differentiate them in the way the input requires. Third, performance appears to track the visual salience of the intervention’s consequences more than robust physical understanding. Force/Degree, which often causes large visible motion changes, reaches 40.4%, while Surface Friction, which induces subtler trajectory differences, drops to 14.2%. The benchmark itself contains 319 paired triplets built from real embodied data sources, nuScenes and DROID. As a diagnostic result, these numbers are already enough to show that better single-sample realism does not automatically translate into controllable physical simulation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction. The failure mode is stated very clearly, and it immediately explains why per-video benchmarks are insufficient. Then read the benchmark construction section, focusing on how the six intervention primitives are defined and how prompt pairs are constrained to differ in only one variable. After that, read the APEO protocol, especially how Adherence, Physics, Environment, and Outcome disentangle different error sources. Finally, inspect the main result table and the per-primitive breakdown; that is where the contrastive bottleneck becomes most visible. If you only have 25 minutes, prioritize the motivating examples, the primitive taxonomy, the APEO definition, and the main quantitative table. Read the human-validation and failure-case sections only if you want to judge whether this benchmark can inform future training objectives.

recommendation.zh: 非常好的 World Model 评测视角，从单样本的 'plausibility' 转向对比样本的 'causality'，对于做多模态/视频生成的 pretrain 团队来说，这是衡量模型是否真正学到物理规律的关键 metric。
recommendation.en: An excellent evaluation perspective for World Models, shifting from single-sample 'plausibility' to contrastive 'causality'. Crucial metric for multimodal/video pretrain teams to measure if models actually learn physical laws.

paper.title: Do LLMs Build World Models From Text? A Multilingual Diagnostic of Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Whether large language models (LLMs) construct internal spatial world models from pure-text descriptions remains contested, and whether such capabilities transfer across languages has not been systematically studied. We introduce MentalMap, a multilingual diagnostic benchmark with a six-level capability hierarchy (L0-L5) spanning atomic spatial facts to generative world-graph construction, together with four diagnostic axes probing frame of reference, reading-direction bias, reasoning-effort all

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM空间推理评测存在三个核心缺陷：几乎仅覆盖英文、评测维度单一、无法区分模型是依赖统计共现记忆还是真正构建了内部世界模型，也未系统验证空间推理能力在不同类型语言间的迁移性，无法回答LLM是否从文本中构建了通用空间世界模型的问题。
summary.importance: 研究表明静态事实记忆和主动空间推理是两个独立的能力层级，预训练数据的多语言空间描述覆盖率、空间相关内容占比，以及专门的预训练目标设计，才能提升主动空间推理能力，单纯扩大参数或数据规模无法解决L3性能悬崖问题，为预训练数据和目标设计提供了明确的优化方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MentalMap多语言诊断基准，采用双轴设计：能力轴为6级阶梯，从L0-L2的静态空间事实检索，到L3-L5的主动空间变换、最终生成世界图；诊断轴覆盖四个正交维度：参考系、阅读方向偏差、推理努力分配、幻觉。基准基于ProcTHOR的100个家庭场景构建，覆盖8种类型差异极大的语言（含LTR和RTL书写系统、全部Levinson参考系类），并设置结构化文本对照组。
summary.experiments: 测试13个LLM，涵盖前沿闭源模型、7-10B开源模型、27-32B中等规模模型以及视觉语言对照模型。核心发现包括：所有模型均存在L3性能悬崖，静态到主动推理边界处性能降至L0的一半以下；思维链并非通用提升手段，可提升DeepSeek L3性能32个百分点，但使Qwen2.5-7B L3性能下降16个百分点；L3悬崖在27-32B参数规模下依然存在，说明是纯文本模态的工作记忆瓶颈而非规模不足导致；多语言性能相关性可复现文字类型学聚类（拉丁/CJK/阿拉伯-泰语）；人类在相同纯文本协议下也存在相同的L3悬崖，验证了瓶颈的模态固有性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第3节的基准设计和第4节的7个核心发现，重点关注静态到主动推理的性能悬崖分析，以及多语言性能的聚类结果。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM spatial reasoning benchmarks have three critical limitations: near-exclusive focus on English, single-dimensional evaluation, and inability to distinguish between statistical co-occurrence memorization and genuine internal world model construction. No systematic cross-lingual transfer investigation of spatial reasoning capabilities exists, leaving the question of whether LLMs build generalizable spatial world models from text unanswered.
summary_en.importance: The study demonstrates that static fact recall and active spatial reasoning are independent capability tiers. Improving active spatial reasoning requires optimizing pre-training data composition (cross-lingual coverage of spatial descriptions, proportion of spatial-related content) and designing dedicated pre-training objectives; simply scaling parameter count or data volume cannot resolve the L3 performance cliff, providing clear optimization directions for pre-training data and objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce MentalMap, a multilingual diagnostic benchmark with a two-axis design. The capability axis is a 6-level staircase ranging from static spatial fact retrieval (L0-L2) to active spatial transformation and generative world graph output (L3-L5). The diagnostic axis covers four orthogonal dimensions: frame of reference, reading direction bias, reasoning effort allocation, and hallucination. The benchmark is built on 100 ProcTHOR household scenes, covers 8 typologically diverse languages including both LTR and RTL writing systems and all Levinsonian frame classes, and includes a structured-text control group.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate 13 LLMs including frontier closed-source models, 7-10B open-source models, 27-32B mid-scale models, and a vision-language ablation. Key findings include a universal L3 performance cliff where all models drop to below half of their L0 accuracy at the static-to-active reasoning boundary; chain-of-thought does not deliver consistent improvements, boosting DeepSeek L3 performance by 32 pp but reducing Qwen2.5-7B L3 performance by 16 pp; the L3 cliff persists at 27-32B parameter scale, indicating a pure-text modality working memory bottleneck rather than insufficient scale; multilingual performance correlations reproduce script typology clusters (Latin / CJK / Arabic-Thai); human participants also exhibit the same L3 cliff under the same pure-text protocol, verifying the modality-inherent nature of the bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for benchmark design and Section 4 for the 7 core findings, focus on the L3 performance cliff analysis and multilingual performance clustering results. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 L3 cliff 的构造和控制实验；它给“文本学出世界模型”的说法加了一个清晰反例。
recommendation.en: Read the L3 cliff setup and controls; it gives a clean counterexample to broad claims that text alone yields robust world models.

paper.title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
paper.abstract: World models for interactive video generation have largely focused on single-agent settings, where future observations are generated from a single control signal. However, many generated environments require multi-agent interaction: multiple players, robots, or embodied agents act simultaneously within a shared space. Scaling world models to such settings requires a principled multi-agent design: agents should remain independently controllable, permutation-symmetric, and support efficient infere

summary.core_problem: 现有交互式视频世界模型多按单智能体控制信号生成未来观测，难以自然扩展到多玩家、多机器人或多具身体同时行动的共享环境。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多智能体生成式世界模型的架构改进。它把可独立控制、置换对称和高效推理作为同一个建模约束处理，对交互视频生成和仿真式数据生成有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding，将 agent 身份表示为旋转角空间中正单纯形的顶点，是一种无参数的 3D RoPE 扩展。每个 agent 获得不同相位，同时在置换意义下等价，避免学习固定 slot identity 或依赖固定 agent 顺序。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、基线和定量提升。可确认的实验目标是多智能体交互视频生成，并强调时间一致性、视角一致性和推理效率。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Sanja Fidler，其团队长期做视觉生成、具身感知和世界模型相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Interactive video world models are mostly built around a single control stream, which does not scale cleanly to shared environments with multiple players, robots, or embodied agents acting at the same time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architectural design for generative multi-agent world modeling. It is relevant as a way to impose independent controllability, permutation symmetry, and efficient inference in interactive simulation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding, a parameter-free extension of 3D RoPE that places agent identities at vertices of a regular simplex in rotary-angle space. This assigns distinct phases to agents while keeping them permutation-equivalent, avoiding learned slot identities or fixed ordering.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The experimental setting is multi-agent interactive video generation with an emphasis on temporal and perspective consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Sanja Fidler is among the authors; her group is known for work on visual generation, embodied perception, and world modeling.

recommendation.zh: 看 Simplex RoPE 设计即可；它对多主体 token/slot 编码有借鉴，但离 LLM 预训练主线还有一层距离。
recommendation.en: Skim the Simplex RoPE design; it is a useful cue for multi-entity token or slot encoding, but still one step away from core LM pretraining.

paper.title: When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?
paper.abstract: A representation that scrambles the true degrees of freedom of the world cannot support reliable planning or compositional generalization. We prove that LeJEPA (alignment plus Gaussian regularization) linearly recovers the world's latent variables from nonlinear observations, a property known as linear identifiability, in a broad class of worlds where latents evolve under stationary, additive-noise transitions. Our main result is that among all such worlds, the Gaussian is the unique latent dist

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“LeJEPA 能不能学到有用表征”，而是更严格的问题：在什么条件下，LeJEPA 学到的表征可以被视为 world model，也就是能线性恢复真实潜变量。全文把这个问题形式化为 linear identifiability：若观测由未知非线性映射 x=g(z) 生成，学习到的表示 y=f(x) 与潜变量之间满足 h(z)=f(g(z))=Qz（只差一个线性变换/对称性），则表示没有把世界自由度任意纠缠。论文要解决的核心，是给 LeJEPA 这类 JEPA 方法建立首个可证明的可识别性结果，并说明这种保证何时成立、何时不成立，以及近似优化时会退化成什么样。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 JEPA/联合嵌入预测从经验方法推进到可分析对象，补上了“防塌缩后到底学到了什么”这一空白。第二，它给出一个很具体的结论：LeJEPA 的 alignment + Gaussian regularization 组合，不只是稳定训练技巧，而是在高斯潜变量、平稳加性噪声转移下，确实偏好线性可恢复的潜空间；这让“高斯化表示分布”从工程启发变成了有理论支撑的设计。第三，它的 if-and-only-if 结论很尖锐：在作者定义的这类世界中，高斯是唯一能保证线性可识别的潜变量分布。这一点对表征学习、世界模型、latent planning 都有启发，因为它说明 identifiability 不是 JEPA 普遍自带的性质，而是目标函数与数据生成假设共同决定的。对做预训练的人来说，价值不在于可直接照搬到 LLM，而在于它提供了一个分析模板：显式分布正则 + 预测一致性，可能比隐式防塌缩更容易得到可解释的训练偏置。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文分析的是 LeJEPA 目标：一部分是 alignment，让正样本对的表示接近；另一部分是把表示分布显式正则到各向同性高斯，文中对应 SIGReg 一类 Gaussian regularization。作者先定义一类世界：潜变量各维独立，正样本来自平稳过程，转移是加性噪声。然后在前向定理里进一步专门化到 z~N(0,I)，并利用平稳性推出唯一保持边缘分布不变的加性噪声转移是 OU 形式 z'=ρz+sqrt(1-ρ^2)ε。关键技术点是把复合映射 h=f∘g 在高斯测度下做谱分解。直观上，若 h 含有高于一次的非线性成分，这些成分在 alignment 目标下会受到严格惩罚，而 Gaussian regularization 又要求输出分布保持标准高斯，因此最优解只能保留一次项，也就是线性映射 Qz。这里的证明思路和高斯空间上的正交多项式/谱展开关系很深：不同“非线性阶数”在相关高斯对上有不同衰减系数，alignment 会把高阶项压下去。反方向定理更有意思：作者证明在同一类平稳加性噪声世界里，若潜变量分布不是高斯，就无法对所有此类世界都保证 LeJEPA 学到线性可识别表示。也就是说，高斯不是一个方便的例子，而是唯一能给出这类普适保证的分布。除此之外，论文还给出 approximate identifiability 结果：当 alignment 和 Gaussian matching 只近似满足时，表示到线性映射的偏差可以被上界控制；并进一步证明，若表示线性恢复潜变量，则在该表示空间做规划足以达到潜空间最优规划。这把“可识别”与“可用于控制”连了起来，而不是停留在表征美学层面。
summary.experiments: 实验部分主要是理论结论的验证，而不是追求大规模任务成绩。文中做了几类实验。第一类是合成混合实验：在 2D 非线性 mixing 上，检查 LeJEPA 学到的表示是否与真实潜变量线性对应，并与非高斯潜变量分布做对照，验证高斯条件的重要性。第二类是高维实验，潜变量维度扩展到 1024 维，用来说明结论不是低维玩具现象。第三类是分布消融，系统替换潜变量分布，观察当偏离高斯时线性可识别性如何恶化，对应理论里的 converse 和 approximate bound。第四类是像素级机器人控制/latent-space planning 实验，用来支撑“线性可识别足以支持最优潜空间规划”的命题。摘要里没有给出完整数值表，提供的全文片段也未包含所有结果表格，因此不宜编造具体提升百分比；但从实验设计可以看出，作者重点不是比基线多几个点，而是验证三件事：高斯条件的必要性、近似满足目标时的平滑退化、以及表征可识别性与规划性能之间的联系。阅读时应重点看图中表示与潜变量的线性对应关系、不同分布下 probe/规划指标的变化，以及近似界是否与经验误差趋势一致。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合按“定义—定理—实验验证”来读。先看 Introduction 和问题设定，明确作者所说的 world model 不是泛指预测未来，而是能线性恢复潜变量。然后看 The World and the Learner，特别是三条世界假设：独立潜变量、平稳性、加性噪声，以及为什么高斯潜变量会导出 OU 转移。真正的核心在理论部分：前向定理里，注意作者如何利用高斯空间谱分解说明高阶非线性会被 alignment 惩罚；反向定理里，注意“高斯唯一性”是如何建立的。若时间有限，优先看主定理、证明思路图、近似可识别性命题和 latent planning 命题，再回头看实验。实验部分建议重点看 2D mixing、1024 维扩展、分布消融和机器人控制四组。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 Gaussian regularization 在这里扮演的是训练稳定器还是结构归纳偏置，答案其实偏后者；二是结论对非高斯世界的限制很强，这提示未来若想把 JEPA 理论推广到更一般世界，可能需要换正则形式，而不是只改证明技巧。预计泛读 30-45 分钟，若要吃透证明需要更久。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a stricter question than whether LeJEPA learns useful features: when does it learn a representation that qualifies as a world model? The criterion is linear identifiability. If observations are generated by an unknown nonlinear map x=g(z), the learned representation y=f(x) should recover the latent state up to a linear transform, i.e. h(z)=f(g(z))=Qz. This rules out representations that preserve task performance while arbitrarily entangling the true degrees of freedom. The central problem is to establish the first identifiability result for a JEPA-style objective, characterize exactly when it holds, when it fails, and how it degrades under approximate optimization.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly conceptual, but it is relevant to pretraining because it turns an empirical recipe into an analyzable objective. First, it addresses a long-standing gap in JEPA-style SSL: explicit collapse prevention may stabilize training, but what structure does it actually recover? Second, it gives a sharp answer for LeJEPA: alignment plus explicit Gaussian regularization does not merely avoid collapse; under Gaussian latents with stationary additive-noise transitions, it biases the solution toward linearly recoverable latent structure. Third, the if-and-only-if result is unusually strong: within the paper’s world class, Gaussian latents are the unique distribution for which this guarantee can hold universally. That matters beyond JEPA theory. It says identifiability is not a generic byproduct of predictive SSL; it depends on a precise match between the objective and the latent generative assumptions. For pretraining researchers, the broader lesson is that explicit distributional regularization can make representation learning objectives much easier to reason about than implicit anti-collapse mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis centers on the LeJEPA objective: an alignment term that pulls positive-pair embeddings together, plus an explicit regularizer that matches the embedding distribution to an isotropic Gaussian, in the spirit of SIGReg. The paper first defines a broad class of worlds: independent latent coordinates, positive pairs drawn from a stationary process, and additive-noise transitions. The forward theorem then specializes to z~N(0,I). Under stationarity, the only additive-noise transition that preserves the Gaussian marginal is the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck form z'=rho z + sqrt(1-rho^2) epsilon. The key proof idea is a spectral decomposition of the composed map h=f∘g under Gaussian measure. Intuitively, if h contains nonlinear components beyond degree one, those components are penalized by the alignment objective, while the Gaussian regularizer constrains the output distribution to remain standard normal. The optimum therefore retains only the linear component, yielding h(z)=Qz. The mechanism relies on the fact that different polynomial degrees decay differently under correlated Gaussian pairs, so alignment suppresses higher-order terms. The converse theorem is the more distinctive part: for the same class of stationary additive-noise worlds, if the latent distribution is non-Gaussian, one cannot guarantee linear identifiability for all such worlds. Gaussianity is therefore not just a convenient assumption for the proof; it is the unique distribution that supports this universal guarantee. The paper also proves an approximate identifiability result, showing that if alignment and Gaussian matching are only approximately optimized, the deviation from a linear latent map is bounded. Finally, it connects identifiability to control by proving that linear recovery of the latent state is sufficient for optimal latent-space planning.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to validate the theory rather than to maximize benchmark scores. The paper includes several regimes. First, low-dimensional synthetic mixing experiments test whether LeJEPA recovers a representation linearly aligned with the true latent variables under nonlinear observation maps, with non-Gaussian latent distributions used as ablations. Second, the setup is scaled to 1024-dimensional latents to show that the phenomenon is not confined to toy 2D cases. Third, distributional ablations systematically vary the latent distribution and measure how identifiability degrades as one moves away from Gaussianity, matching the converse and approximate-identifiability claims. Fourth, pixel-based robotic control and latent-space planning experiments support the claim that linear identifiability is sufficient for optimal planning in the learned representation space. The provided text fragment does not include the full result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains. What matters in the experimental section is the structure of the evidence: necessity of the Gaussian assumption, graceful degradation under approximate objective satisfaction, and the link between identifiable representations and planning quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as a theory paper with empirical checks, not as a benchmark paper. Start with the introduction and the formal problem setup to fix the paper’s notion of a world model: a representation that linearly recovers latent variables, not merely one that predicts future observations. Then read the world assumptions carefully: independent latents, stationarity, additive noise, and why Gaussian latents imply an OU transition. The main technical substance is in the forward theorem and the converse theorem. In the forward direction, focus on how the spectral decomposition over Gaussian space makes every nonlinear degree pay an alignment penalty. In the converse direction, focus on why Gaussianity is unique rather than merely sufficient. If time is limited, prioritize the theorem statements, proof sketches, the approximate-identifiability result, and the proposition connecting identifiability to latent planning, then inspect the synthetic and control experiments. The most useful questions to carry while reading are: is Gaussian regularization acting mainly as a stabilizer or as an inductive bias, and what kind of regularizer would be needed to extend the theory beyond Gaussian worlds? A quick pass takes about 30-45 minutes; a serious read of the proofs takes substantially longer.

recommendation.zh: 只看定理假设和 converse：它不是证明 JEPA 普遍学世界模型，而是把可识别性压到 Gaussian latent 这个窄条件里。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem assumptions and the converse: this does not prove JEPA generally learns world models; it narrows identifiability to Gaussian latents.

paper.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a train

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归视频扩散 world model 的长期一致性与实时推理之间的冲突。完整 KV-cache attention 能在重访场景时保持内容一致，但显存和 attention 计算随 rollout 长度线性增长；滑动窗口能保持速度，却会丢掉早期场景记忆，导致重访时漂移或生成新内容。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于传统 LLM 预训练方法，但对自回归多模态生成模型和长期上下文推理有参考价值。它的关键观察是：KV cache 不只是加速缓存，也可以作为模型已有的隐式世界记忆。与训练外部 memory module 或显式 3D 表示相比，WorldKV 选择直接管理模型自身的 KV cache，因此更接近 serving-time memory policy。对 LLM 研究的启发在于，长上下文能力不一定只靠扩大上下文窗口，也可以通过检索、压缩、重插入已有 KV 来获得更低成本的历史访问。
summary.technical_approach: WorldKV 是 training-free 框架，由 World Retrieval 和 World Compression 两部分组成。World Retrieval 把滑动窗口中被驱逐的 KV-cache chunk 存到 GPU/CPU memory，在模型重访相关场景时再选择性取回，并直接插回原生 attention window，不需要重编码，也不改模型结构。检索策略是模块化的，可以使用 camera/action correspondence，也可以使用 attention-based retrieval。World Compression 针对相邻帧 KV 高度冗余的问题，用 Key-Key similarity 识别并裁剪重复 token，把每个 chunk 大约压到一半大小。这样在同样 memory budget 下能保留约 2 倍历史，同时避免完整历史 attention 的线性开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个不同规模的自回归视频 world model 上评估：Matrix-Game-2.0 和 LingBot-World-Fast。一个重要实验现象是，即使 Matrix-Game-2.0 训练时只用 6-frame sliding window，推理时放开完整 KV-cache 仍能利用过去 cache 重建曾经看过的视角，说明这种记忆并不完全依赖长序列训练。成本方面，论文指出每帧会产生约 880 到 1,560 个 token，一分钟 rollout 会累积到数十万 token；LingBot-World-Fast 使用完整历史时，FPS 从 8.87 降到 3.61。World Compression 能把 chunk 约减半，World Retrieval 则在不读取完整历史的情况下提升 revisit fidelity。论文称 training-free KV 管理在重访一致性上可匹配或超过 full KV-cache attention 和 memory-trained baselines，同时保持实时推理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 的 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解“KV cache 已经携带世界记忆”和“完整历史 attention 不可承受”这两个前提。方法部分重点看 World Retrieval 如何定义 chunk、如何根据相机/动作或 attention 取回历史 KV，以及 World Compression 的 Key-Key similarity pruning。实验部分关注 Matrix-Game-2.0 的短上下文训练但长记忆可用这一点，这比具体应用演示更有方法价值。Appendix C 如果有时间可以看，用来判断 retrieval 策略是否可迁移到其他自回归多模态模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tension between long-term consistency and real-time inference in autoregressive video diffusion world models. Full-history KV-cache attention can preserve scene consistency during revisits, but memory and attention cost grow with rollout length. Sliding-window inference keeps the system fast, but evicts the very caches needed to recover previously seen views.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant as an inference-time memory management study for autoregressive multimodal generation. Its central observation is that KV cache is not only a compute buffer; it can act as an implicit world memory already available inside the model. Instead of training an external memory module, adding cross-attention, or reconstructing an explicit 3D scene, the method manages and reuses the model’s own KV cache. For LLM researchers, the useful analogy is long-context access under a bounded budget: selective retrieval and compression of past KV can be an alternative to simply increasing the active context window.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldKV is a training-free framework with two components. World Retrieval stores evicted KV-cache chunks in GPU or CPU memory and retrieves scene-relevant chunks when the camera or action trajectory indicates a revisit. The retrieved caches are inserted back into the native attention window, without re-encoding and without architectural changes. The retrieval interface is modular and can use camera/action correspondence or attention-based selection. World Compression reduces redundancy across adjacent video frames by pruning tokens according to Key-Key similarity. Since neighboring frames produce near-duplicate KV entries, compressing each chunk to roughly half size allows about twice as much history to be retained under the same memory budget.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on Matrix-Game-2.0 and LingBot-World-Fast. A notable finding is that Matrix-Game-2.0, although trained with only a 6-frame sliding window, can still use full past KV caches at inference time to reconstruct previously visited viewpoints. This supports the claim that the memory effect is not limited to models trained on minute-long sequences. The cost motivation is concrete: each frame produces around 880 to 1,560 tokens, so a one-minute rollout can accumulate hundreds of thousands of tokens. On LingBot-World-Fast, full-history attention reduces FPS from 8.87 to 3.61 over a one-minute rollout. WorldKV uses retrieval to avoid attending to the full history and compression to roughly halve chunk size. The reported results show revisit fidelity comparable to or better than full KV-cache attention and memory-trained baselines while maintaining real-time inference.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 in the introduction: they establish the two core claims, namely that KV carries usable scene memory and that full-history attention is too expensive. Then read the method sections on World Retrieval and World Compression. The most transferable details are chunk construction, camera/action-based retrieval, attention-based retrieval, and Key-Key similarity pruning. The Matrix-Game-2.0 result is worth noting because it separates inference-time cache reuse from long-sequence training. Appendix C is useful if the goal is to judge whether the retrieval policy could be adapted to other autoregressive multimodal models.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 KV 记忆的思路值得借鉴；重点看 retrieval key 的定义和压缩误差，别被视频场景绑住。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for long-context KV memory design; focus on the retrieval key and compression error, not the video-specific framing.

paper.title: stable-worldmodel: A Platform for Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
paper.abstract: World models are central to building agents that can reason, plan, and generalize beyond their training data. However, research on world models is currently fragmented, with disparate codebases, data pipelines, and evaluation protocols hindering reproducibility and fair comparison. Current practice is further limited by three key bottlenecks: fragile one-off codebases, slow video data loading, and the lack of standardized generalization benchmarks.
