summary.core_problem: 世界模型研究存在代码库碎片化、数据加载慢、缺乏标准化泛化基准的问题，导致结果可复现性差、不同方法难以公平比较
summary.importance: 标准化的世界模型研究平台降低了复现和比对成本，对基于世界模型的多模态预训练、通用智能体预训练研究有工具支撑价值
summary.technical_approach: 开源stable-worldmodel（swm）平台，基于PyTorch和Gymnasium构建，包含三层核心设计：1）基于Lance的高性能数据层，原生支持MP4、HDF5、LeRobot数据集及格式转换，消除多模态世界模型训练的I/O瓶颈；2）提供经过测试的主流世界模型基线（DINO-WM、LeWorldModel、PLDM、TD-MPC2等）和规划求解器（CEM、MPPI、GD等）的实现；3）覆盖经典控制、MuJoCo、Atari、机器人、开放世界环境的基准套件，加入可控制的视觉、几何、物理变化因素，支持标准化的零样本泛化和鲁棒性评估
summary.experiments: 暂无公开的系统级对比实验结果，平台已内置多类基线和基准可直接开展比对测试
summary.reading_guide: 重点看数据层设计、内置基线和基准套件的实现规范，预计阅读时间10分钟

summary_en.core_problem: World modeling research suffers from fragmented codebases, slow data loading, and lack of standardized generalization benchmarks, leading to poor result reproducibility and unfair comparison across different methods
summary_en.importance: The standardized world model research platform reduces the cost of reproduction and comparison, and provides tool support for world model based multimodal pretraining and general agent pretraining research
summary_en.technical_approach: Open-sources the stable-worldmodel (swm) platform built on PyTorch and Gymnasium, with three core designs: 1) A high-performance Lance-based data layer with native support and conversion tools for MP4, HDF5, and LeRobot datasets, eliminating I/O bottlenecks in multimodal world model training. 2) Well-tested implementations of mainstream world model baselines (including DINO-WM, LeWorldModel, PLDM, TD-MPC2) and planning solvers (including CEM, MPPI, GD). 3) A benchmark suite covering classic control, MuJoCo, Atari, robotics, and open-world environments, with controllable visual, geometric and physical variation factors to support standardized zero-shot generalization and robustness evaluation
summary_en.experiments: No public systematic comparison experiment results are available yet. The platform has built-in multiple baselines and benchmarks for direct comparison tests
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the data layer design, implementation specifications of built-in baselines and benchmark suites. Estimated reading time is 10 minutes

recommendation.zh: 更像 world model 版评测和数据底座；预训练研究员看接口设计即可，不必细读 baseline。
recommendation.en: This is mostly infrastructure for world-model evaluation and data handling; skim the interface design, not the baseline details.

paper.title: Why Latent Actions Fail, and How to Prevent It
paper.abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) aim to learn action-like representations from unlabeled videos by compressing frame-to-frame changes. The frames of in-the-wild videos, however, contain not only the agent's own state but exogenous state such as background clutter. Since the exogenous state introduces changes unrelated to actions, it hinders reliable latent action learning. This paper investigates this problem analytically by extending a linear LAM framework to explicitly model exogenous state. Our an

summary.core_problem: 研究无标注视频中的 latent action model 为何会学到与动作无关的外生变化，而不是稳定的动作表征。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析工作，不是 LLM 论文，但它讨论了表示学习目标在存在外生噪声时会学偏到未来观测信息的问题；这个结论对 world model、视频 token 建模和 action abstraction 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在线性化的 LAM 框架中显式引入 exogenous state，分析标准重建目标的最优解会如何把未来观测中的外生信息压进 latent action。进一步提出应在更聚焦 endogenous component 的表示空间中学习，并证明已有一些辅助目标，如 action supervision，会促进跨外生状态的一致动作表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者用分析推导加实验验证两点结论：标准 reconstruction objective 会污染 latent action；聚焦 endogenous representation 或加入辅助监督能缓解该问题。由于给出的摘要不完整，具体数据集、模型规模和提升幅度无法确认。
summary.authors_note: 首尔大学与 Microsoft Research 合作。微软研究院背景让这篇工作在 world model / representation learning 方向上比普通应用论文更值得扫一眼。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why latent action models trained on unlabeled videos often encode exogenous changes instead of stable action-like factors.
summary_en.importance: This is not an LLM paper, but it offers a useful analysis of how representation-learning objectives fail under exogenous noise. That can still inform work on world models, video tokenization, and action abstraction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extend a linear LAM framework with an explicit exogenous-state variable and show analytically that the standard reconstruction objective encourages latent actions to absorb future exogenous information. They then argue for learning in a representation space focused on endogenous components, and prove that auxiliary objectives such as action supervision promote consistency across exogenous states.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the paper combines theory with empirical validation of two claims: standard reconstruction contaminates latent actions with exogenous information, while endogenous-focused representations or auxiliary supervision mitigate the issue. The provided abstract is truncated, so datasets, model sizes, and exact gains cannot be verified.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Seoul National University and Microsoft Research. The Microsoft angle makes it more worth skimming than a typical application paper in representation learning.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但如果你做 world model 或视频 token abstraction，可只看理论部分：它把“重建目标为何学偏”讲得很干净，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but if you work on world models or video token abstraction, read the theory only—it cleanly explains how reconstruction objectives drift toward the wrong factors.

paper.title: Transformers Linearly Represent Highly Structured World Models
paper.abstract: Do transformers, when trained on sequential reasoning traces, build internal models of the underlying task? And if so, does the structure of those internal representations mirror the structure of the domain? We train an 8-layer transformer on Sudoku solving traces and perform a mechanistic analysis of its internal computation. We establish two results. First, the model builds a substructure world model: it does not represent the board state cell by cell, as a human analyst would expect, but orga

summary.core_problem: 探究训练在数独求解轨迹上的Transformer是否会形成与任务约束结构匹配的内部世界模型，以及这类组合约束满足任务下的表示几何是否与之前Othello等游戏的逐单元表示模式一致
summary.importance: 为机制可解释性和预训练模型推理机制研究提供参考，验证了Transformer内部表示会自适应任务底层约束结构，而非统一采用人类直觉的表面状态拆分方式，可为推理类预训练任务的设计提供机制层面的参考
summary.technical_approach: 训练8层因果Transformer在带回溯的Norvig风格数独求解轨迹上，采用已有的探针+激活修补的机制分析方法，分别验证亚结构表示、注意力对齐、专用推理电路三类特征。和现有Othello、国际象棋等任务的世界模型研究的区别是，选择了约束跨亚结构关联的数独任务，而非逐单元独立状态的游戏任务
summary.experiments: 在15万 held-out测试集上达到98.4%的单单元格准确率、97.5%的整张数独准确率；中层的（亚结构,数字）对线性探针准确率达到100%，而逐单元探针仅到80%；识别到中层注意力头会对齐行、列、宫等亚结构，OV电路会抑制亚结构中已出现数字的logits；最终MLP层存在一组单语义神经元专门检测单元格的唯一可填数字（裸单规则）
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3、4、5节的核心发现部分，跳过数独规则和探针技术细节，预计阅读时间15分钟，核心结论可快速对应到推理类预训练模型的表示设计参考

summary_en.core_problem: Investigate whether transformers trained on Sudoku solving traces form internal world models matching the underlying task constraint structure, and whether the representation geometry of such combinatorial constraint satisfaction tasks aligns with the cell-wise representation pattern observed in previous studies on games like Othello
summary_en.importance: Provides reference for mechanistic interpretability and pre-trained model reasoning mechanism research, verifies that transformer internal representations adapt to the underlying constraint structure of tasks instead of uniformly adopting the surface state decomposition intuitive to humans, which can offer mechanism-level reference for the design of reasoning-focused pre-training tasks
summary_en.technical_approach: Train an 8-layer causal transformer on Norvig-style Sudoku solving traces with backtracking, adopt the existing probe + activation patching mechanistic analysis method to verify three features: substructure representation, attention alignment, and dedicated reasoning circuits. Different from previous world model studies on tasks like Othello and chess, this work chooses Sudoku, a task with constraints correlated across substructures, rather than games with cell-wise independent states
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 98.4% per-cell accuracy and 97.5% per-grid accuracy on 150k held-out test puzzles; linear probes for (substructure, digit) pairs in mid-layers reach 100% exact match accuracy, while per-cell probes only plateau at 80%; mid-layer attention heads are found to align with substructures like rows, columns and boxes, and OV circuits suppress logits of digits already present in the attended substructure; a set of monosemantic neurons in the final MLP layer are identified to specifically detect the only valid digit for a cell (naked single rule)
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core findings in Sections 3, 4 and 5 during skimming, skip Sudoku rule descriptions and technical details of probing methods. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes. Core conclusions can be quickly mapped to representation design references for reasoning-focused pre-training models

recommendation.zh: 机制分析质量不错，约束代数塑造世界模型几何这个发现对思考pretrain数据如何诱导结构化表示有启发，建议看§3-§4的分析部分。
recommendation.en: Quality mechanistic analysis; finding that constraint algebra shapes world model geometry is informative for thinking about how pretraining data induces structured representations. Recommend reading §3-§4.

paper.title: EgoExo-WM: Unlocking Exo Video for Ego World Models
paper.abstract: Egocentric world models present a promising direction for enabling agents to predict and plan, but their performance is constrained by the limited availability of egocentric training data and its inherent partial observability of humans' physical actions. In contrast, exocentric video is abundant and reveals body poses well, but lacks direct alignment with an agent's action space -- and is not egocentric. We propose a method to bridge this gap by extracting structured body pose from exocentric v

summary.core_problem: 第一人称世界模型的训练受限于第一人称数据规模小、动作空间所需的3D人体姿态标注难以获取的瓶颈，而海量第三人称视频因视角不匹配、缺乏与智能体动作空间的对齐，无法直接用于第一人称世界模型训练。
summary.importance: 为第一人称世界模型的训练数据扩展提供了可落地的低成本路径，证明可通过第三人称视频转换补充训练数据，缓解通用具身模型的数据瓶颈，对具身多模态预训练的数据工程有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: EgoExo-WM框架以3D人体运动为统一表示，桥接第三人称与第一人称视角。首先从第三人称视频中提取3D人体运动作为动作空间的标注，再基于带人体运动学先验的视角转换模块，将第三人称视频转换为与提取的动作序列对齐的第一人称视频。转换得到的成对（第一人称视频+3D动作）数据与原生第一人称数据混合，用于训练基于视觉隐空间的动作条件第一人称世界模型。该世界模型使用预训练的DINOv3-L编码器提取视觉隐特征，输入历史窗口的过往隐特征和下一步3D动作，预测下一帧的视觉隐状态。框架还支持通过排序动作序列进行规划，找到能到达目标视觉状态的动作路径。
summary.experiments: 在Home Action Genome、LEMMA、Ego-Exo4D三个第一人称数据集上评测，未来帧预测表现优于现有第一人称世界模型基线；下游规划任务中，可有效生成达到目标视觉状态的3D人体运动序列。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的动机和第3章的视角转换模块设计，实验部分查看主结果表即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。核心关注如何用统一的动作表示实现跨视角数据对齐，不需要深挖世界模型的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Egocentric world model training is bottlenecked by small scales of available egocentric datasets and the difficulty of obtaining 3D human pose annotations required for the action space. Abundant exocentric (third-person) videos cannot be directly used for egocentric world model training due to viewpoint mismatch and lack of alignment with the agent's action space.
summary_en.importance: This framework provides a practical, low-cost path to expand training data for egocentric world models, proving that exocentric video conversion can supplement training data to alleviate the data bottleneck of general embodied models. It has direct reference value for data engineering in embodied multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EgoExo-WM uses 3D human motion as a unified representation to bridge exocentric and egocentric viewpoints. First, 3D human motion is extracted from exocentric videos as annotations for the action space. Then a viewpoint conversion module with human kinematics priors transforms exocentric videos into egocentric videos aligned with the extracted motion sequences. The converted paired (egocentric video + 3D action) data is mixed with native egocentric data to train an action-conditioned egocentric world model operating in visual latent space. The world model uses a pretrained DINOv3-L encoder to extract visual latents, and predicts the next frame's latent state given a history window of past latents and the next 3D action. The framework also supports planning by ranking action sequences to find the path that leads to a target visual state.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three egocentric datasets: Home Action Genome, LEMMA, and Ego-Exo4D. EgoExo-WM outperforms existing egocentric world model baselines on future frame prediction. On downstream planning tasks, it can effectively generate 3D human motion sequences that reach the target visual state.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, read Section 1 for motivation and Section 3 for the viewpoint conversion module design. Review the main results table in experiments. Expected reading time is 15 minutes. Focus on how unified action representation enables cross-view data alignment; no need to dive deep into world model implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据转换 pipeline；它把“外部视角数据不可用于 ego world model”的先验打松了。
recommendation.en: Read the data-conversion pipeline; it weakens the prior that exocentric video is unusable for ego world-model training.

paper.title: On Training in Imagination
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art model-based reinforcement learning methods train policies on imagined rollouts. These rollouts are trajectories generated by a learned dynamics model and are scored by a learned reward model, but without querying the true environment during policy updates. We study this training paradigm by quantifying how errors in learned dynamics and reward models affect returns and policy optimization. First, we extend the analysis of Asadi et al. (2018) to MDPs with learned reward models, a

summary.core_problem: 训练在想象中依赖 learned dynamics 和 learned reward 生成并打分 rollout，但两类模型误差如何分别影响 return、样本预算如何在 transition 与 reward annotation 之间分配，此前缺少清晰刻画。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 model-based RL、RLHF/RLAIF 中的 reward model 采样成本、以及用 learned world model 产生训练信号有参考意义。关键启发是把 dynamics error 和 reward error 拆成两个可控来源，而不是把环境模型误差混在一个项里。这个视角适合迁移到需要合成轨迹、偏好标注、过程奖励或 verifier 信号的训练系统中。
summary.technical_approach: 方法以 deterministic MDP 为对象，扩展 Asadi et al. 的 simulation-lemma 类分析。返回差距被分解为 dynamics error 与 reward error 两项，二者有不同的 Lipschitz 系数。Corollary 1 指出 learned dynamics、reward、policy 的 Lipschitz 常数越低，误差放大越弱，因此好的 latent representation 不只是预测准确，还应让系统在 latent space 中更平滑。Theorem 1 在误差满足 power-law scaling 的假设下，给出 dynamics samples 与 reward samples 的最优比例，比例由误差下降指数、单位样本成本、以及 Lipschitz 放大系数共同决定。Theorem 2 讨论 additive zero-mean reward noise 下 REINFORCE estimator 的无偏性与方差膨胀；systematic reward bias 会形成梯度偏差，不能靠多 trajectory 平均消除。
summary.experiments: 实验部分主要用于检查理论假设与预测，包括 power-law error scaling、Lipschitz 系数对 return bound 的影响、以及 reward annotation fidelity 与样本数量之间的取舍。给出的全文片段没有暴露具体数值表和曲线细节，因此不宜补造性能数字。可确认的实验定位是 Sections 3.1、4.1、4.2，分别对应假设验证、预算分配预测、reward noise/fidelity 分析。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Lemma 1、Corollary 1、Theorem 1、Theorem 2 的表述和假设，不必逐行推导证明。对预训练研究更有用的是两个问题：第一，reward model 的误差项是否可以在训练系统中单独建模和监控；第二，power-law 采样分配能否用于决定人类偏好、AI feedback、process reward、environment transition 数据的采集比例。

summary_en.core_problem: Training in imagination uses learned dynamics and learned reward models to generate and score rollouts, but the separate effects of dynamics error and reward error on return, and the optimal split between transition data and reward annotations, are not well characterized.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to model-based RL and to training pipelines that rely on learned reward signals. Its useful contribution is the separation of dynamics error and reward error as two controllable sources of training-signal degradation. That framing can inform RLHF/RLAIF systems, verifier-based training, process reward modeling, and synthetic trajectory generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis extends simulation-lemma-style bounds from Asadi et al. to MDPs with a learned reward model. The return gap is decomposed into a dynamics-error term and a reward-error term, each with its own coefficient. The coefficients depend on Lipschitz constants of the dynamics, reward, and policy, which turns smooth latent representations into a concrete desideratum rather than a qualitative preference. Under power-law error scaling, the paper derives a closed-form optimal allocation between dynamics samples and reward samples as a function of scaling exponents, per-sample costs, and the Lipschitz-derived coefficients. It also analyzes REINFORCE under additive zero-mean reward noise, showing unbiasedness with variance inflation, while systematic reward bias induces a gradient bias that trajectory averaging cannot remove.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical sections are designed to test the assumptions and predictions of the theory: whether model errors follow power-law scaling, whether lower Lipschitz constants tighten the observed return-error behavior, and how reward annotation fidelity trades off against sample count. The provided full-text excerpt identifies Sections 3.1, 4.1, and 4.2 as the relevant experimental locations, but does not expose the numerical tables or plots. Exact performance numbers should therefore be checked in the original PDF.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on Lemma 1, Corollary 1, Theorem 1, and Theorem 2. The most transferable ideas are the separate accounting of reward-model error and the power-law allocation rule for expensive labels versus cheaper transition data. The proofs are less important unless one wants to adapt the bounds to stochastic dynamics, token-level reward models, or verifier-guided language model training.

recommendation.zh: 看误差界和 sample allocation；它不会给 LLM recipe，但会校准“用想象轨迹训练”能信到什么程度。
recommendation.en: Read the error bound and sample-allocation rule; it will not give an LLM recipe, but it calibrates how much to trust imagined rollouts.

paper.title: Render, Don't Decode: Weight-Space World Models with Latent Structural Disentanglement
paper.abstract: Training world models on vast quantities of unlabelled videos is a critical step toward fully autonomous intelligence. However, the prevailing paradigm of encoding raw pixels into opaque latent spaces and relying on heavy decoders for reconstruction leaves these models computationally expensive and uninterpretable. We address this problem by introducing NOVA, a world modelling framework that represents the system state as the weights and biases of an auxiliary coordinate-based implicit neural re

summary.core_problem: 用更结构化、可渲染的潜表示替代视频世界模型中昂贵且不透明的像素解码器。
summary.importance: 贡献是世界模型表示形式的探索：把状态表示成辅助 INR 的权重和偏置，再解析渲染。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对 latent representation、视频 tokenizer 和可解释生成状态有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NOVA，将系统状态编码为 coordinate-based implicit neural representation 的参数，而不是普通 opaque latent；图像通过解析渲染得到，从而移除重型 decoder。作者还声称可通过 action-matching objective 将其蒸馏为上下文相关的视频生成器，并在无辅助 loss 或 GAN loss 的情况下产生背景、前景等结构分解。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型参数量、视频数据规模、baseline 名称或具体指标提升。宣称优势包括紧凑性、可移植性、零样本超分辨率，以及对场景结构成分的无监督 disentanglement。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Manchester 和 University of Bristol。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper replaces heavy, opaque pixel decoders in video world models with a structured latent state that can be analytically rendered.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a representation proposal for world models: states are stored as the weights and biases of an auxiliary INR. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but it is adjacent to latent representation design, video tokenization, and interpretable generative state spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: NOVA represents the system state as parameters of a coordinate-based implicit neural representation rather than a conventional opaque latent vector. Frames are produced by analytical rendering, removing the heavy decoder. The method can also be distilled into a context-dependent video generator with an action-matching objective, and the authors report structural disentanglement without auxiliary or adversarial losses.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify parameter count, video-data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims compactness, portability, zero-shot super-resolution, and unsupervised disentanglement of background and foreground structure.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Manchester and the University of Bristol.

recommendation.zh: 想找视觉 latent/tokenizer 新表示可看方法部分；实验细节缺失，先当概念备查。
recommendation.en: Worth a method skim if you track visual latents or tokenizers; the missing experimental detail makes it a concept note for now.

paper.title: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
paper.abstract: Achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) requires agents that learn and interact adaptively, with interactive world models providing scalable environments for perception, reasoning, and action. Yet current research still lacks large-scale datasets and unified benchmarks to evaluate their physical interaction capabilities. To address this, we propose iWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for training and testing world models on interaction-related abilities such as distance perception an

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 interactive world model 缺少统一、可比、覆盖面足够广的评测框架，尤其是不同模型使用的动作输入形式不一致，导致“交互能力”很难公平比较。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接推动有限，但对 world model 方向有现实价值。它把评测对象从一般视频生成拉回到“动作条件下的环境响应”，并把数据、动作表示、任务设计和指标放到同一框架里。对于做统一视频/世界模型预训练的人，这篇工作的启发主要在两点：一是动作空间的标准化会影响模型比较与训练接口设计；二是 memory 与 action-following 需要单独测，不能只看视觉质量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上主要是 benchmark engineering，而不是新的 world model 架构。作者先清洗并标准化 12 个高质量数据集的坐标系和相机内外参，又从 4 个模拟器的 18 个环境自动采集并筛选 10 万段 1080P 视频，最终得到 33 万段视频的数据池。然后提出一个统一的 Action Generation Framework，用 modality-agnostic 的方式编码动作，把不同模型常见的文本命令、键盘输入、连续轨迹等控制形式映射到同一个动作字典中，定义了 81 个基础运动动作。在此基础上设计 6 类交互任务轨迹，并加入带逻辑一致性的 memory 任务。评测时从 33 万视频中挑出 2100 个高质量样本，构造 4900 个任务，用 9 个指标从视觉质量、动作跟随、记忆能力三方面评估 14 个现有模型。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是提出新模型，而是系统评测。可确认的规模包括：33 万视频数据池、2100 个评测视频、4900 个任务、14 个 interactive world models、9 个指标。模型覆盖 5 个文本控制世界生成模型、2 个 one-hot 动作编码模型、7 个基于相机内外参控制的模型。论文的主要结果应当是不同动作接口下模型能力差异明显，且视觉质量好不代表动作响应或记忆能力强；同时，任务难度和 memory 设计能拉开模型差距。阅读时要重点看各类任务上的排名是否稳定、不同指标之间是否冲突，以及统一动作框架是否真的减少了比较偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三部分：数据构建流程图、Action Generation Framework 定义、以及主评测表。先确认动作统一映射是否严谨，再看 6 类任务是否覆盖了交互世界模型的核心能力，最后看 9 个指标里哪些真正有区分度。若只想抓要点，30 分钟左右足够。若你关心 world model 训练接口，可以再看附录里关于坐标系统一、动作编码细节和人工标注难度分级的说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmarking gap for interactive world models: current models use heterogeneous action interfaces, datasets are fragmented, and there is no unified evaluation setup that can fairly compare interaction capability across modalities.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on language-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for the world-model stack around foundation models. The main value is practical: it standardizes action-conditioned evaluation rather than treating world models as generic video generators. For pretraining researchers, the useful takeaway is that action representation is part of the model interface, and that visual fidelity alone is not enough; action following and memory need to be measured separately.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is primarily a benchmark and evaluation framework, not a new model architecture. The authors standardize 12 existing datasets by unifying coordinate systems and camera parameters, and also collect 100k 1080P clips from 18 environments across 4 simulators. The resulting pool contains 330k video clips. They then introduce an Action Generation Framework that maps heterogeneous control modalities—text commands, keyboard inputs, continuous trajectories, and related formats—into a modality-agnostic action dictionary with 81 basic motion actions. On top of this interface, they design six task types with varying difficulty, including memory-oriented tasks. For evaluation, they select 2,100 high-quality videos and build 4,900 tasks, then assess 14 interactive world models using 9 metrics covering visual quality, action following, and memory.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental contribution is a broad evaluation rather than a new performance claim. The confirmed scale is substantial: a 330k-clip data pool, 2,100 benchmark videos, 4,900 tasks, 14 evaluated models, and 9 metrics. The evaluated systems include 5 text-controlled world generation models, 2 one-hot action encoding models, and 7 models controlled by camera parameters. The main empirical value is likely in showing that model rankings depend strongly on which capability is measured: strong visual quality does not necessarily imply good action responsiveness or memory. When reading, focus on whether rankings are stable across task types, whether the metrics disagree in meaningful ways, and whether the unified action framework actually reduces comparison bias.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough for most readers. Prioritize three parts: the dataset construction pipeline, the definition of the Action Generation Framework, and the main evaluation tables. First check whether the action unification is principled rather than ad hoc. Then see whether the six task types cover the core abilities expected from interactive world models. Finally, inspect which of the nine metrics are actually discriminative. A focused read should take about 30 minutes. If you care about training interfaces for world models, the appendix sections on coordinate normalization, action encoding details, and human-assisted difficulty labeling are worth an extra pass.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 benchmark design 和 14 模型失败模式；它更像 world-model 评测基建，不会直接改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure modes across 14 models; this is world-model evaluation infrastructure, not something that directly changes a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: GenMatter: Perceiving Physical Objects with Generative Matter Models
paper.abstract: Human visual perception offers valuable insights for understanding computational principles of motion-based scene interpretation. Humans robustly detect and segment moving entities that constitute independently moveable chunks of matter, whether observing sparse moving dots, textured surfaces, or naturalistic scenes. In contrast, existing computer vision systems lack a unified approach that works across these diverse settings. Inspired by principles of human perception, we propose a generative m

summary.core_problem: 提出一种生成式物质模型，用统一机制从运动线索和外观特征中恢复可独立运动的物理实体。
summary.importance: 贡献在视觉感知和物理场景理解：试图用生成模型解释人类对 moving matter 的分组能力。对 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，但对世界模型、视觉归纳偏置和多模态表示设计有边缘参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: GenMatter 将低层运动线索和高层外观特征层次化组织为 particles，再把 particles 聚成表示可独立运动实体的 clusters。每个 particle 可理解为局部物质的小 Gaussian 表示；推理由硬件加速的并行 block Gibbs sampling 完成。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该模型可处理随机点、风格化纹理和自然 RGB 视频等不同输入形态。未给出参数规模、训练数据规模、baseline 或定量提升，重点似乎是跨输入类型的统一感知行为和分组稳定性。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 William T. Freeman、Joshua B. Tenenbaum 和 Vikash Mansinghka，相关团队长期研究视觉、认知科学、概率程序和物理场景理解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a generative matter model that recovers independently movable physical entities from motion cues and appearance features under a unified mechanism.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in visual perception and physical scene understanding: a generative account of how moving matter can be grouped into object-like entities. It is not LLM pretraining work, but it may be a peripheral reference for world models, visual inductive biases, and multimodal representation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: GenMatter hierarchically groups low-level motion cues and high-level appearance features into particles, then groups particles into clusters representing coherently and independently movable entities. Particles are small Gaussian-like units of local matter, and inference uses a hardware-accelerated parallel block Gibbs sampler.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the model operates on random dots, stylized textures, and natural RGB videos. It does not report model size, training data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains; the emphasis is unified behavior across input types and stable motion-based grouping.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes William T. Freeman, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, and Vikash Mansinghka, whose groups are associated with vision, cognitive science, probabilistic programming, and physical scene understanding.

recommendation.zh: 只看摘要和方法图；作为世界模型归纳偏置素材可以存档，但没有直接改变 LLM 预训练动作。
recommendation.en: Read only the abstract and method figure; archive it as world-model inductive-bias material, not as something that changes LLM pretraining practice.

paper.title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
paper.abstract: As AI systems move from generating text to accomplishing goals through sustained interaction, the ability to model environment dynamics becomes a central bottleneck. Agents that manipulate objects, navigate software, coordinate with others, or design experiments require predictive environment models, yet the term world model carries different meanings across research communities. We introduce a "levels x laws" taxonomy organized along two axes. The first defines three capability levels: L1 Predi

summary.core_problem: 把“world model”在不同社区（RL/视觉/LLM agent/机器人/科学发现）里含义不一致的问题，整理成一个可操作的能力分级框架，并讨论从“能预测”到“能用于决策的仿真”再到“能在新证据下自我修正”的路径与评价口径。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接方法贡献有限，更像概念与评测口径的统一工作。对做基座预训练的启发主要在两点：一是把“生成质量”与“决策可用性”区分开，提醒多模态/交互式预训练的目标函数与评测应围绕可控 rollout 与约束一致性；二是把“持续修正”(L3)明确成能力层级，和 continual pretrain / online finetune / 反事实数据收集的闭环更容易对齐。
summary.technical_approach:
文章核心是一个“levels × laws”的分类法。
- Levels（能力层级）：L1 Predictor 学局部一步转移；L2 Simulator 能把局部转移组合成多步、动作条件的 rollout，并且 rollout 需要满足领域约束（文中用“laws”来概括物理/软件规则/社会规则/科学机制等）；L3 Evolver 在预测被新证据打脸时，能触发模型更新与自我修正，而不是静态生成。
- Laws（约束维度）：全文意图用“是否显式建模/遵守约束”把纯生成式视频/文本模拟与可用于规划控制的模型区分开。
方法上不是提出新训练目标或新架构，而是把已有工作按“是否支持决策、是否能长期一致、是否能在分布外证据下更新”重新归类，并讨论每一层需要的训练信号来源（被动数据 vs agent 采样）、误差累积与校正、以及评测应从像素/文本相似度转向任务回报、约束违背率、长期一致性等。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇综述/立场型工作，全文不以提出新模型为目标，因此没有核心的统一实验曲线或可复现的 SOTA 数字。主要“结果”是对既有文献的结构化整理与评价维度的提炼，而不是参数量/数据规模/指标提升的实证贡献。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 重点看 taxonomy 定义的那几页：L1/L2/L3 的边界条件写得是否“可判定”，尤其是 L2 对“rollout respects laws”的要求，以及 L3 对“evidence-driven revision”的触发与闭环。
- 看作者如何把不同模态（视频生成、RL world model、LLM text simulator、机器人动力学、AI4Science surrogate）映射到同一框架：哪些被归为 L1 但在原社区被称为 world model，哪些被作者认为必须到 L2 才算“agent-usable”。
- 如果关心 pretrain：优先关注文中关于“评测口径从生成质量到决策质量”的论证，以及 L3 与 continual learning / online adaptation 的接口讨论。预计 30–45 分钟能抓住主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fragmentation of the term “world model” across RL, vision, LLM-based agents, robotics, and AI-for-science, and proposes an operational capability taxonomy that separates mere prediction from decision-usable simulation and evidence-driven self-revision.
summary_en.importance: It is not a new pretraining method paper; its value to foundation-model pretraining is mainly conceptual and evaluative. It sharpens the distinction between (a) generative fidelity and (b) decision utility under long-horizon rollouts and constraints, which is directly relevant when designing objectives/benchmarks for interactive multimodal pretraining. It also elevates “model revision under new evidence” (their L3) as a first-class capability, aligning naturally with continual pretraining and online adaptation loops.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is a “levels × laws” taxonomy.
- Levels: L1 Predictor learns one-step local transitions; L2 Simulator composes transitions into multi-step, action-conditioned rollouts that must respect domain constraints (“laws” broadly covering physical rules, software invariants, social norms, scientific mechanisms); L3 Evolver updates itself when predictions fail against new evidence, emphasizing persistent correction rather than static generation.
- Laws axis: used to separate models that can generate plausible trajectories from models whose rollouts are constraint-consistent and thus usable for planning/control.
The paper mainly re-organizes prior literature around decision-centric criteria (rollout consistency, constraint violation, error accumulation/correction, data collection via agents vs passive logs) rather than proposing a new loss, architecture, or scaling recipe.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey/position-style work, it does not present a new model with unified training runs, scaling curves, or headline numbers (params/data/performance deltas). The “evidence” is primarily structured literature analysis and proposed evaluation dimensions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with intent:
- Read the formal definitions/boundaries of L1/L2/L3; check whether the L2 requirement (“rollouts respect laws”) is operational enough to guide benchmarks.
- Focus on how they map video generators, RL world models, LLM simulators, robotics dynamics models, and AI4Science surrogates into the same grid; the disagreements with common community usage are where the paper is most informative.
- If you care about pretraining: prioritize the argument for shifting evaluation from generative similarity to decision utility, and the discussion of L3 as a continual-update loop. ~30–45 minutes for the main thread.

recommendation.zh: 适合扫 taxonomy，不要期待实验结论；L1/L2/L3 区分可用于整理内部 agent-world-model 需求。
recommendation.en: Skim the taxonomy rather than expecting empirical results; the L1/L2/L3 split is useful for organizing internal agent-world-model requirements.

paper.title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
paper.abstract: Interactive video generation models such as Genie, YUME, HY-World, and Matrix-Game are advancing rapidly, yet every model is evaluated on its own benchmark with private scenes and trajectories, making fair cross-model comparison impossible. Existing public benchmarks offer useful metrics such as trajectory error, aesthetic scores, and VLM-based judgments, but none supplies the standardized test conditions -- identical scenes, identical action sequences, and a unified control interface -- needed

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式视频世界模型缺乏统一评测条件的问题，使不同模型在相同场景、相同行为轨迹下可公平比较。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与评测协议统一。对做 world model、交互式视频生成和多模态统一建模的人有参考价值；对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值主要在评测设计，而不是方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldMark，核心是统一动作映射层，把共享的 WASD 风格动作词表转换成各模型原生控制格式；并构建分层测试集，在相同场景和轨迹上评估六类主流 interactive image-to-video world models，结合轨迹误差、美学分数和 VLM 评判等指标。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到覆盖六个主要模型、500 个评测实例，并强调 identical scenes、identical action sequences、unified control interface 的 apples-to-apples 比较。未给出具体模型名单之外的详细数值结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Alaya Studio、Shanda AI Research、东京大学等机构。未见可直接确认的顶级 LLM 基座团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of standardized evaluation conditions for interactive video world models, so different systems can be compared under identical scenes and action trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It is relevant to world models, interactive video generation, and multimodal unified modeling, but for LLM pretraining researchers the value is mostly in evaluation design rather than method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldMark introduces a unified action-mapping layer that translates a shared WASD-style action vocabulary into each model’s native control format, and builds a hierarchical test suite to evaluate six major interactive image-to-video world models under identical scenes and trajectories using trajectory error, aesthetic metrics, and VLM-based judgments.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions six major models and 500 evaluation cases, emphasizing apples-to-apples comparison via identical scenes, identical action sequences, and a unified control interface. No detailed quantitative results are given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Alaya Studio, Shanda AI Research, and the University of Tokyo, among others. No clearly identifiable top-tier LLM foundation-model lab background is evident from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 world model 或统一多模态生成，这篇的价值在评测协议而不在算法；正文只需看 action mapping 设计和 failure taxonomy。
recommendation.en: If you care about world models or unified multimodal generation, the value is in the evaluation protocol, not the algorithm; read the action-mapping design and failure taxonomy, then move on.

paper.title: Occupancy Reward Shaping: Improving Credit Assignment for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: The temporal lag between actions and their long-term consequences makes credit assignment a challenge when learning goal-directed behaviors from data. Generative world models capture the distribution of future states an agent may visit, indicating that they have captured temporal information. How can that temporal information be extracted to perform credit assignment? In this paper, we formalize how the temporal information stored in world models encodes the underlying geometry of the world. Lev

summary.core_problem: 离线目标条件强化学习里，稀疏奖励和长时延导致 credit assignment 很差，如何从世界模型中提取可用于塑形的时序几何信号。
summary.importance: 这是 RL 训练信号设计与世界模型利用方式的工作。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对“从生成模型中抽取更密训练信号”这一思路有一定启发，尤其对 pretrain↔post-train 接口和 reward design 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Occupancy Reward Shaping。先学习 occupancy measure 的生成模型，再借助 optimal transport 从该模型中恢复环境的几何结构，并构造目标可达性的 reward shaping 信号。作者给出理论保证：该塑形不改变最优策略。
summary.experiments: 在 13 个长时程 locomotion 和 manipulation 任务上评估，报告平均约 2.2x 的性能提升，并展示在稀疏奖励离线设定中的稳定收益。摘要未给出具体模型参数量或数据规模；baseline 应为标准 offline goal-conditioned RL 方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University、Princeton University 等。Benjamin Eysenbach、Jeff Schneider 在强化学习与世界模型方向有较强代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles poor credit assignment in offline goal-conditioned RL under sparse rewards and long horizons by extracting temporally meaningful geometry from a learned world model.
summary_en.importance: This is a reward-design and world-model utilization paper. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to how generative models can be turned into denser training signals, which matters for the pretrain↔post-train interface and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Occupancy Reward Shaping, first learns a model of the occupancy measure, then uses optimal transport to recover the geometry encoded in that model and convert it into a goal-reaching reward shaping signal. The paper also claims policy invariance: the shaping does not alter the optimal policy.
summary_en.experiments: It is evaluated on 13 long-horizon locomotion and manipulation tasks, with about 2.2x average improvement in sparse-reward offline settings. The abstract does not specify model sizes or dataset scale; the baselines are standard offline goal-conditioned RL methods.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Carnegie Mellon University and Princeton University, among others. Benjamin Eysenbach and Jeff Schneider are recognizable names in RL and world-model research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“从生成模型里抽 reward 而不是只拿来 rollout”这个角度值得记住；看方法图和理论保证就够，别把任务增益外推到语言域。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the idea of extracting reward structure from a generative model rather than just using it for rollouts is worth keeping; read the method sketch and invariance claim, not the task gains.

paper.title: X-Cache: Cross-Chunk Block Caching for Few-Step Autoregressive World Models Inference
paper.abstract: Real-time world simulation is becoming a key infrastructure for scalable evaluation and online reinforcement learning of autonomous driving systems. Recent driving world models built on autoregressive video diffusion achieve high-fidelity, controllable multi-camera generation, but their inference cost remains a bottleneck for interactive deployment. However, existing diffusion caching methods are designed for offline video generation with multiple denoising steps, and do not transfer to this sce

summary.core_problem: 少步数（few-step）自回归视频扩散世界模型在闭环交互推理时成本过高，传统“跨去噪步缓存”在蒸馏少步模型上失效。
summary.importance: 把缓存复用轴从“去噪步”转到“时间chunk”，属于推理加速方法；对做世界模型/视频生成部署的人有直接价值，对预训练方法本身是间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: X-Cache：训练无关加速；在连续生成chunk之间持久化每个block的残差缓存（cross-chunk block caching），并用双指标门控决定复用/更新缓存，以适配闭环交互（不能用未来条件）与few-step模型（步间冗余不足）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型/硬件/加速比与质量退化曲线；预期报告吞吐/延迟改善与生成质量保持（多摄像头驾驶视频）。
summary.authors_note: 来自小鹏（XPeng）AI Infra 团队，偏工程部署与系统优化。

summary_en.core_problem: Few-step autoregressive video-diffusion world models are too expensive for closed-loop interactive inference, while step-wise diffusion caching fails after distillation.
summary_en.importance: An inference acceleration method shifting caching from denoising steps to temporal chunks; directly useful for world-model/video-gen deployment, only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: X-Cache is training-free: persist per-block residual caches across consecutive generation chunks (cross-chunk block caching) and apply dual-metric gating to decide reuse vs refresh, tailored for closed-loop generation without future conditioning and for few-step models with little inter-step redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete model/hardware, speedup numbers, and quality trade-offs; expected to report latency/throughput gains and fidelity preservation on multi-camera driving video generation.
summary_en.authors_note: From XPeng AI Infra team; engineering/deployment oriented.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“把缓存轴从step换到chunk”这个思路对少步扩散/世界模型部署很实用；只看方法与消融即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the step-to-chunk caching shift is a practical idea for few-step diffusion world-model serving; read method + ablations only.

paper.title: Beyond State Consistency: Behavior Consistency in Text-Based World Models

summary.core_problem: 文本环境中的 LLM World Model（WM）训练与评估长期依赖“状态一致性”（next-state 文本相似度/EM 等），但全文指出这会系统性地与真实下游行为目标错位：即便单步预测文本很像，回放到真实环境时也可能导致 agent 决策改变、任务失败（metric inversion）。论文要解决的核心问题是：如何让 WM 的训练目标与“在真实环境中会采取同样动作”的功能一致性（functional/behavior consistency）对齐，并给出可训练、可度量的替代信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练/持续学习本身不是直接贡献（更偏后训练与交互式建模），但对“用 LLM 作为环境/模拟器”的数据与目标设计有明确启发：1）指出 token-level/文本相似度监督在交互式序列建模里会产生目标错配与评估虚高；2）提出一种可操作的、与决策保持相关的 step-level reward 设计（BehR），可作为 WM 的 RL 训练信号；3）用任务级 Pairwise Consistency Ratio（CR_pw）把 WM 质量与真实环境可复现的行为绑定，减少离线评估对弱 agent 的校准偏差。整体贡献属于“训练目标与评测范式纠偏”，对做交互数据预训练、模拟器蒸馏/压缩、以及 agentic pretraining 的研究者有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法主线是把 WM 学习从“重建状态文本”改为“保持决策分布”。理想目标是 predicted state 与 real state 在给定历史下诱导相同的 action distribution，但真实分布不可得，于是构造可计算代理：
1）冻结一个 Reference Agent（可理解为固定策略/评估器）。
2）定义 Behavior Consistency Reward（BehR）：在同一步 t，对日志中的真实下一动作 a_{t+1}，分别计算其在真实状态 s_t 与 WM 预测状态 \hat{s}_t 下的对数似然（或概率），用两者差异/比值形成奖励，直接奖励“预测状态能否保留同一动作选择”。这使训练信号聚焦于 decision-critical 信息，而非表面 token 重合。
3）训练：将 BehR 作为 step-level reward，用 GRPO（文中提到 Group Relative Policy Optimization）对 WM 进行强化学习式优化，得到 BehR-WM。关键点是：优化目标不再是 next-state LM loss，而是让 WM 生成的状态在 reference agent 下对 logged action 的支持度接近真实环境。
4）评估：提出任务级 Pairwise Consistency Ratio（CR_pw）：统计在真实环境中“单独成功”的任务里，有多少在 WM 中生成动作序列并回放到真实环境后仍成功，用于衡量 WM 的长程可复现性。并讨论 BehR-WM 对离线评估校准差距（calibration gap）的改善，以及作为 lookahead planning simulator 的初步效果。
全文的关键论证是：BehR 能在“Drop Irrelevant vs Drop Target”等决策关键扰动下避免 metric inversion，说明它比文本相似度更贴近行为后果。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段包含定性与部分定量结论，但缺少完整实验表格数字（如模型规模、数据量、CR_pw 绝对值提升等在片段中未出现）。已明确的实验设计与发现包括：
- 决策关键扰动测试：构造 Drop Irrelevant（删除非关键内容但不改变正确动作）与 Drop Target（删除目标对象导致动作应改变）。结果是：传统文本指标与“content-only LLM judge”会把 DT 评得更轻（因为大部分 token 未变），出现 metric inversion；BehR 是唯一能正确排序（DI > DT）的指标，并且可作为 dense training signal。文中称完整 7 种扰动与 32B reference-agent 复现实验在附录 F/F.2。
- 训练目标对比：文中声称用 surface/structured rewards 替换 BehR 不能恢复同样的任务级收益（提示 BehR 的对齐性是关键）。
- 长程一致性：在主要设置中，BehR 训练“显著提升”CR_pw，同时单步预测质量保持稳定或提升；跨设置迁移更不均匀，尤其在接近天花板（near-ceiling）时收益异质。
- 下游：BehR-WM 缩小离线评估对弱 agent 的校准偏差，并在 lookahead planning 上有初步正向结果。
由于你要求基于全文给出具体数字，但当前提供的“Full Content”截断在方法段开头且未包含结果表/超参/规模信息，因此无法可靠填入参数量、数据规模、提升幅度等硬数字；若补充论文 PDF 的实验章节/表格（§5-§6 与附录），我可以把 CR_pw、单步指标、不同 reward 的对照与消融数字逐项补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25-40 分钟）：
1）先读 Introduction + Figure 1：理解“metric inversion”为什么在交互式 WM 中致命。
2）读 Preliminaries 里 DI/DT 扰动与 Table 1：这是全文最关键的动机证据，说明为什么要从 state consistency 转向 behavior consistency。
3）跳读 Method：抓住 BehR 的定义（真实状态 vs 预测状态下对 logged next action 的似然对比）、reference agent 的角色、以及为何用 GRPO 优化。
4）若时间允许，直接看 §5（Results）里 CR_pw 的主结果与 reward 替换对比（文中强调这是 BehR 必要性的证据），再看 §6 的 calibration gap 与 planning 初步实验。
5）想深挖：重点看附录 F 的 7-perturbation 与 32B reference-agent 复现，判断 BehR 是否对 reference agent 的能力/偏好敏感，以及是否存在“reward hacking”（WM 生成让 reference agent 更偏向 logged action 的文本，而非更真实的状态）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based world models in text environments are commonly trained/evaluated via state-consistency (token-level likelihood, EM, textual similarity). The paper shows this can be behaviorally misaligned: a prediction that looks textually close may omit decision-critical details, causing the downstream agent to take different actions and fail when trajectories are replayed in the real environment (metric inversion). The core problem is to align world-model learning with functional/behavioral consistency—i.e., preserving the agent’s decisions—using a tractable training signal and a task-level metric.
summary_en.importance: Not a direct pretraining/scaling-law contribution, but highly relevant to agentic/interactive modeling and simulator-style LLM training. It (1) diagnoses objective/metric mismatch in sequential interactive settings, (2) proposes a decision-preservation reward (BehR) that can be optimized with RL, and (3) introduces a task-level replay-based metric (CR_pw) that ties WM quality to real-environment success reproducibility, reducing offline-evaluation calibration artifacts. For researchers exploring environment modeling, simulator distillation, or agentic pretraining curricula, it’s a useful reframing of what “good prediction” should mean.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method reframes WM learning from “reconstruct the next observation text” to “preserve the action distribution induced by the state.” Since the full action distribution is inaccessible, it builds a step-level proxy:
1) Freeze a Reference Agent.
2) Define Behavior Consistency Reward (BehR): for the logged next action, compare its likelihood under the reference agent when conditioned on the real state vs the WM-predicted state; reward states that keep the logged action equally (or more) likely, focusing learning on decision-critical content.
3) Optimize the WM with an RL algorithm (GRPO is used) using BehR as dense step reward, producing BehR-WMs.
4) Evaluate with Pairwise Consistency Ratio (CR_pw): among tasks that succeed when executed directly in the real environment, measure the fraction that remain successful when the action sequence generated in the WM is replayed in the real environment—capturing long-horizon functional fidelity.
The paper also discusses reduced offline-eval calibration gap and preliminary lookahead-planning benefits.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt includes the key experimental constructs but not the full results tables/scale details. What is clearly described:
- Decision-critical perturbation test (DI vs DT): standard text metrics and content-only LLM judges rate the decision-breaking “Drop Target” perturbation as less severe (metric inversion), while BehR correctly ranks DI above DT and remains usable as a dense training signal. A broader 7-perturbation study and a 32B reference-agent replication are said to be in Appendix F/F.2.
- Objective comparison: initial evidence that replacing BehR with surface/structured rewards does not recover the same task-level gains.
- Long-horizon fidelity: in the primary setting, BehR training substantially improves CR_pw while keeping single-step prediction quality stable or better; transfer is more heterogeneous in near-ceiling regimes.
- Downstream: BehR-WMs reduce offline-evaluation calibration gap and show preliminary promise for lookahead planning.
However, numeric details (model sizes, dataset scale, absolute CR_pw gains) are not present in the excerpt; to report exact numbers I’d need §5–§6 tables/figures from the PDF.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 min):
1) Introduction + Fig. 1 for the metric-inversion intuition.
2) Preliminaries + Table 1 for the decisive evidence that text similarity fails while BehR tracks behavioral severity.
3) Method section for the exact BehR definition, the role of the frozen reference agent, and how GRPO is applied.
4) Then jump to Results (§5) focusing on CR_pw and the reward-target ablations; optionally §6 for calibration-gap and planning.
Deep-dive angle: check Appendix F for robustness across perturbations and sensitivity to the reference agent (potential reward hacking / preference imprinting).

recommendation.zh: 它纠正了一个常见坑：文本相似度的 world model 评测会反转真实行为质量；建议只看 BehR 与 CR_pw，立刻用于你自己的模拟器蒸馏评估。
recommendation.en: It calls out a real trap: text-similarity WM metrics can invert true behavioral quality; focus on BehR and CR_pw and apply them immediately to your simulator distillation/eval.

paper.title: Do LLMs Build Spatial World Models? Evidence from Grid-World Maze Tasks

summary.core_problem: 论文探问：LLM 是否真的能构建“空间世界模型（spatial world models）”来支持规划与推理，还是主要依赖对特定输入格式/提示的表面启发式。作者用网格迷宫（grid-world maze）作为受控环境，检验模型在多步路径规划、空间抽象与跨表示一致性上的能力。
summary.importance: 空间世界模型是机器人导航、具身智能、自动规划系统的关键前提。如果 LLM 的空间能力强依赖输入表示（token 化邻接表 vs 可视化网格）或强依赖 CoT 指令，那么其“可迁移的规划能力”可能被高估：在真实系统中表示变化、上下文干扰、连续查询记忆等都会导致性能崩塌。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建迷宫任务评测框架：迷宫规模从 5×5 到 9×9；提供两种等价但形式不同的输入表示——(1) 带特殊 token 的邻接表（便于符号化解析），(2) 人类可读的视觉网格（Figure 1）。提示策略包括标准提示、CoT、显式 reasoning；并设置 k-shot（0/3/5）以研究 in-context 示例的增益与上下文长度干扰。评测指标不仅看“精确路径正确率”，还包括编辑距离、路径有效性、以及对推理文本质量的分析；另外加入定向的空间探针（proximity/directional queries）来分解能力。
summary.experiments: 评测模型包括 Gemini-2.5-Flash、GPT-5-mini、Claude-Haiku-4.5、DeepSeek-Chat。主要观察：①强表示依赖：同一迷宫结构下，从邻接表切换到视觉网格会出现 2–5× 的准确率下降；例如 Gemini-2.5-Flash + CoT 在 5×5 邻接表上 86%，但在视觉网格上仅 34%，且在更大迷宫上进一步崩塌（文中摘要提到视觉网格下可降至 16–34%）。②强提示依赖：没有明确推理指令时，多数模型几乎无法完成任务；Claude-Haiku-4.5 在 5×5 邻接表 base prompt 近乎失败，但 CoT 可恢复到 78%。③跨轮次不积累：模型往往把连续空间查询当作独立问题，无法复用先前已计算的信息，即使问题重复。④“推理质量≠任务成功”：文本推理看似合理不一定对应正确路径，出现准确率与推理质量解耦。整体结论是：当前 LLM 的空间规划更像在狭窄条件下工作的表示特定启发式，而非稳健、格式不变的空间抽象世界模型。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：(1) Introduction：三条研究问题（表示依赖、few-shot/上下文、推理透明性）与“世界模型 vs 表面匹配”的判据。 (2) Method：两种输入表示的构造细节（邻接表 special tokens、视觉网格编码）、任务定义（规划 vs 推理）、指标（exact accuracy/edit distance/validity）与 k-shot 设置。 (3) 关键结果图表：优先看“表示切换导致性能崩塌”的对比图（邻接表 vs 网格）、不同提示（base/CoT/reasoning）下的曲线、以及随迷宫尺寸扩展的泛化曲线；再看“连续查询不复用”的实验与推理质量分析。创新点抓手：用等价表示对照来检验格式不变性；把 CoT 作为必要条件而非锦上添花来刻画能力边界；提出准确率与推理文本解耦的证据。
skim（泛读）：(1) 读 Introduction + Abstract 把握结论；(2) 快速扫 Figure 1（两种表示）与主要结果表/图（尤其 5×5~7×7 的邻接表高分 vs 视觉网格低分）；(3) 只读结论段关于“表示依赖、提示依赖、跨轮次不积累”的三点总结。
summary.authors_note: 作者的论证策略是用“表示等价但形式不同”的对照实验来检验是否存在真正的空间抽象：若有世界模型，应对表示变化更稳健、对提示不那么敏感、并能在连续查询中复用内部状态。实验显示这些性质普遍不成立，从而支持“当前 LLM 空间规划能力受限且脆弱”的结论，并给出一个可复现的平台化基准（SpatialBench）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates whether LLMs actually build internal spatial world models that support planning and reasoning, or whether their maze-solving success is driven by brittle, representation- and prompt-specific heuristics. Grid-world mazes provide a controlled setting to test multi-step planning, spatial abstraction, and invariance across equivalent representations.
summary_en.importance: Robotics navigation and autonomous planning rely on robust spatial world models. If LLM spatial performance collapses under representation changes (tokenized adjacency lists vs visual grids), requires explicit CoT to function, or fails to reuse information across sequential queries, then their real-world planning reliability is likely overstated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors design maze tasks over 5×5 to 9×9 grids with two equivalent input formats: (1) tokenized adjacency lists with special markers, and (2) human-readable visual grid layouts (Figure 1). They vary prompting (standard, chain-of-thought, explicit reasoning) and k-shot context (0/3/5) to study in-context learning vs context-length interference. Evaluation includes exact path accuracy, edit distance, path validity, and analyses of reasoning quality; additional targeted probes test proximity/directional understanding.
summary_en.experiments: Models evaluated include Gemini-2.5-Flash, GPT-5-mini, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and DeepSeek-Chat. Main findings: (1) strong representation dependence: switching from adjacency lists to visual grids yields a 2–5× accuracy drop; e.g., Gemini-2.5-Flash with CoT reaches 86% on 5×5 tokenized mazes but only 34% on visual grids (and can fall to ~16–34% on visual formats per the abstract). (2) strong prompt dependence: without explicit reasoning instructions, most models largely fail; Claude-Haiku-4.5 nearly fails on 5×5 tokenized mazes with base prompting but recovers to 78% with CoT. (3) poor cross-turn state reuse: models treat sequential spatial queries as independent and fail to leverage previously computed information, even for repeated questions. (4) dissociation between reasoning text and success: “good-looking” reasoning does not reliably predict correct paths. Overall, results suggest narrow, format-specific competence rather than robust, format-invariant spatial world modeling.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep): (1) Introduction for the three research questions and the world-model vs pattern-matching criteria. (2) Method for the exact construction of adjacency-list tokens vs visual grids, task definitions (planning vs reasoning), metrics (exact/edit-distance/validity), and k-shot settings. (3) Core results figures/tables: prioritize adjacency-list vs grid comparisons, prompt ablations (base vs CoT vs reasoning), and scaling with maze size; then read the sequential-query reuse experiment and reasoning-quality analysis. Key innovations: equivalence-based representation controls to test invariance; framing CoT as a boundary condition for capability; evidence for accuracy–reasoning dissociation.
skim (light): read Abstract + Introduction; glance at Figure 1 (representations) and the main performance comparison plots/tables; read the concluding bullets on representation dependence, prompt dependence, and lack of cross-turn reuse.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s central methodological move is to test abstraction via representational equivalence: a true spatial world model should be relatively invariant to input format, less dependent on explicit CoT, and able to reuse computed spatial knowledge across turns. The observed brittleness supports the conclusion that current LLM spatial planning is fragile, and the work contributes a reproducible evaluation platform (SpatialBench).

recommendation.zh: 网格迷宫是干净的诊断题，但很容易被提示格式牵着走；只看跨表示一致性与提示敏感性实验，别把单一格式高分当世界模型证据。
recommendation.en: Grid mazes are a clean probe but heavily format-sensitive—skim the cross-representation consistency and prompt-sensitivity results; don’t treat one-format wins as “world model” proof.

paper.title: PhysInOne: Visual Physics Learning and Reasoning in One Suite

summary.core_problem: 缓解物理世界视频/动态场景的“物理一致性”训练数据稀缺问题，并系统评估/提升基础模型在物理现象上的学习与推理能力。
summary.importance: 数据/Benchmark贡献：提供大规模、物理可控且标注完备的合成视频数据（2M视频、71类物理现象），可用于物理一致的视频生成与预测；同时揭示现有基础模型在复杂物理动力学上的能力缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PhysInOne合成数据套件：覆盖力学/光学/流体/磁学等现象，包含多物体交互与复杂背景；提供3D几何、语义、运动、物理属性与文本描述等多粒度GT标注；用其对基础模型进行微调以提升物理合理性，并在多任务上进行统一评测。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：200万视频、153,810个动态3D场景、71种现象；应用评测覆盖物理感知视频生成、长短期未来帧预测、物理属性估计、运动迁移；摘要声称微调后物理可信度显著提升并暴露复杂动力学建模不足，但未给出具体模型参数量、基线与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the scarcity of large-scale, physically consistent training data for dynamic real-world videos and providing a systematic way to evaluate and improve foundation models’ learning and reasoning over physical phenomena.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a large, controllable synthetic video suite with comprehensive annotations (enabling physically grounded video generation/prediction) and exposes capability gaps of current foundation models on complex dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents PhysInOne, a synthetic data and evaluation suite spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, magnetism, and multi-object interactions in complex scenes, with multi-level ground truth (3D geometry, semantics, motion, physical properties, and text); uses the suite for unified multi-task evaluation and for fine-tuning models to improve physical plausibility.
summary_en.experiments: Reports dataset scale of 2M videos, 153,810 dynamic 3D scenes, and 71 phenomena; evaluates tasks including physics-aware video generation, short/long-horizon future prediction, physical property estimation, and motion transfer, claiming notable gains from fine-tuning while noting remaining failures on complex dynamics (without detailed quantitative breakdown in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: glance：把“物理一致性”做成大套件数据很实用，但结论高度依赖合成分布；只看任务划分与leaderboard缺口，别深信绝对分数。
recommendation.en: Glance: the suite is handy, but take results as distribution-bound; skim task taxonomy + leaderboard gaps to see where current models break, don’t over-trust absolute numbers.
